items.statement: Specialty chemicals tolling arrangement with one renowned global chemical company, cost-plus pricing
items.quote: The customer is one of the renowned chemical manufacturing company. And as of now, the arrangement with self-tolling agreement is there for manufacturing of certain quantity.

items.statement: API order book visibility of 4-6 quarters for major products (ibuprofen, paracetamol, metformin)
items.quote: So, the order book means around 4 months to 6 months for every big customer and average order book size is around 4 quarters to 6 quarters.

items.statement: Exports contributed ~28% of H1 FY27 revenue, driven by non-ibuprofen APIs and ethyl acetate penetration
items.quote: Exports contributed approximately 28% of revenue, during the first half of financial year '27 reflecting the continued contribution of our international business.

items.statement: Higher working capital utilization due to increased operations and input prices; peak short-term borrowing ~INR200 crores as of Sep 2026, no further borrowing expected

items.quote: We received certificate of suitability from EDQM for Fenofibrate-Process II, taking our total CEP approvals to 22. Additionally, we received a GMP certification for our formulation CDMO facility.

items.quote: Overall blended, we think it is company as a whole 1:1.75 near about.

items.quote: I think considering there's so much dynamism in the current situation, forecasting 2, 3 years, prices of the Ibuprofen from there is risky for me.

items.statement: Reiterated full-year guidance of mid-teens revenue growth and substantial profitability improvement

items.quote: Our Pharmaceutical business continued to progress, supported by the recovery in our established API portfolio and sustained execution by increase in volumes in our CDMO business.

items.statement: Received Swissmedic GMP Certificate for Bangalore facility; US FDA reinspection targeted end FY27; 28 customer audits passed
items.quote: I am pleased to share that our quality remediation program in our Pharma business is well on track, and we have received a Certificate of GMP Compliance from the Swissmedic Agency for our Bangalore facility recently.

items.statement: Pharma regulatory approvals secured in China and Brazil for 2 established products

items.quote: In the diabetes portfolio, in the gastro portfolio, in the CNS portfolio, in the cardio portfolio. We have a couple of molecules every year we're launching and commercializing. And oncology is a new area that we'll be launching very shortly as well.

items.quote: See, the issue is that the war situation is maybe having some impact. If the war situation normalizes, we should be able to achieve that. But otherwise, it may be 100 basis points here and there, not more than that.

items.statement: Expect to become debt-free within next 2 years unless major capex arises
items.quote: You can fairly assume in the next 2 years, we should be definitely a debt-free company, unless any decisions taken otherwise.

items.quote: So, I was saying INR153 crores does not include the impact of the INR90 crores which you have received.

items.quote: Yes, because here this quarter, as Jammu has been capitalized, and because of this Jammu capitalization, the depreciation has increased. It will continue coming going forward.

items.quote: So yes, if you were to ask me whether end of FY29 should we see the entire portfolio of mosquitoes to cross 100 odd crores , it could be realistic, right?

items.quote: E -commerce and quick commerce channels penetration remained a key highlight, registering over 50% growth year on year in Q2

items.quote: Second part, we have successfully concluded which you have given to notes to accounts also on 13th October 2026, we have also closed the deal of the second plot.

items.quote: So, if it comes on our production, so it could be in the tune of INR 20 crores to INR 25 crores annually we can get it for the next 10 years

items.quote: Commodity prices are not softening, they're hardening. Will H2 be very easy? No, it's going to be more difficult than H1.

items.quote: As far as inorganic is concern ed, it is a discussion that happens off and on, and as a result, these are internal discussions and if should there be ever opportunities that are of interest, we would definitely consider due diligence, etcetera.

items.statement: Will provide 2-3 year CAGR growth projection and category-wise capital allocation plan around February-March after 10 quarters of consistent growth
items.quote: What would be our CAGR directions in the future is something that we are compiling together, and precisely the reason why we said that somewhere probably around February - March is where we would be best suited

items.quote: Similarly, Jammu is settling down, and we'll see how it is settling down, and then we'll again reassess our situation and there could be an opportunity of one or two plants coming up for surplus asset

items.quote: If at all there are any gains because of eit her short supply of Panasonic or anyone else in the market, it will only emerge in the next quarter because deals and market shares come in with a lag

items.quote: Revenue for the quarter stood at INR 428.2 crores, registering a growth of 10.7% year-on-year.

items.quote: A key focus area is our recently introduced portable liquid mosquito vaporiser, which combines the convenience of a rechargeable design with effective mosquito protection.

items.quote: The dry cell market in India was mainly zinc till about two and a half years back, 95% of the market was all zinc. Whereas globally, most of the dry cell markets have shifted towards alkaline.

items.quote: In our consumer lighting businesses, we would easily reach anywhere between 35,000 to 50,000 outlets of electrical outlets in India.

items.statement: No major capex on the cards currently; Jammu plant investment ~INR 200 crores already made
items.quote: Unless until there are any major capex comes, but at this point there is no major capex on the card.

items.quote: We have made almost a similar investment in Capex. The Capex investment is almost as similar as what we've done the full year last year for six months already.

items.quote: We would like to keep up net. Net should be a lakh ton when we enter 2930.

items.quote: Margins remain lowish to the flattish, but now we are seeing that some of this will start picking up.

items.statement: Seaways EBITDA margin 30-35% to 40% reasonable range
items.quote: 30 -ish percent, 30-35%, to 40% is what we think is a reasonable number.

items.statement: Supply chain margins slightly up

items.quote: And we have the promoter holding has subsequently gone up to 70%.

It can actually come down as we continue to optimize in terms of resources, etc. However, having said this, it all depends as to what is the kind of new business that we get and how many new lease we may have to take to support growth. But the current guidance is, whatever current lease that we have, we're going to be in the same range.

items.statement: International BPM grew 12.6% YoY in Q2 and now contributes 83% of BPM revenue
items.quote: International BPM continues to be a key growth driver, growing 12.6% year-on-year in Q2 and now contributing approximately 83% of the BPM revenue compared to 75% in the corresponding quarter last year.

items.statement: Tech & Digital revenue grew 12.9% YoY in Q2 with segment margin of 43.9%
items.quote: Our Tech & Digital business continued its growth momentum, delivering 12.9% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2, with segment margin improving to 43.9%.

items.statement: New business ACV of INR37.2 crores in Q2, up 86.5% YoY; H1 ACV of INR82.6 crores more than doubled YoY
items.quote: During Q2, we secured new business with an annual contract value of INR37.2 crores, growing 86.5% year-on-year. For H1, our new business ACV reached INR82.6 crores, more than doubling compared to the last year.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded to 30.2% in Q2 from 24.4% YoY and 27.5% QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margin expanded to 30.2% compared to 24.4% in Q2 last year and 27.5% in the previous quarter.

items.statement: BPM segment margin improved to 15.6% in Q2 from 11.6% YoY and 11.9% QoQ
items.quote: In the BPM segment, quarter 2 segment margins stood at INR17.5 crores with a segment margin improving to 15.6% compared to 11.6% in Q2 last year and 11.9% in the preceding quarter.

items.statement: Tech & Digital segment margin at 43.9% in Q2 and 43.4% for H1
items.quote: In the Tech & Digital, quarter 2 segment margin was INR18.3 crores, which winding strong segment margin of 43.9%.

items.statement: H1 new ACV of INR82.6 crores (INR66.5 crores BPM + INR16.1 crores Tech & Digital) more than doubled YoY
items.quote: For H1, our new business ACV reached INR82.6 crores, more than doubling compared to the last year. This includes INR66.5 crores from BPM and INR16.1 crores from Tech & Digital.

items.statement: Q2 new ACV of INR37.2 crores includes one Europe Tech & Digital deal of ~INR7 crores and one BOT model BPM deal of ~INR16.8 crores with potential to grow 4x
items.quote: On the Tech & Digital, I have 1 deal, which is basically a Europe client that we look at, which is about close to INR7 crores. This is a multiyear contract, which is on auto renewal because and T&D typically works that way doesn't have periods that we look at. And here, it's the segment margins that we follow. So typically, we'll be looking at somewhere about a 60% plus gross margin on this deal.

items.statement: ROU assets increased to ~INR140 crores due to new office with longer lease commitment replacing old office
items.quote: Why the ROU has increased is because we have replaced the old office with the new office, new office comes with the longer date of commitment, and therefore you see that lease liabilities are increasing.

items.statement: Launched Buzzily 2.0 in May 2026, Alldigi 360 (full HCM SaaS suite) and Alldigi 360 Analytics (AI analytics module) in October 2026
items.quote: We have -- in the month of May 2026, we launched Buzzily 2.0. And recently, in October, we launched 2 more products, Alldigi 360 and Alldigi 360 Analytics.

items.statement: TaxSpanner partnership live since last year; targeting 10-12 lakh Indian employee records for IT return filing; revenue impact visible after Q4
items.quote: However, we were bit late in terms of the previous financial year. So it was just early lukewarm response that we had last year. But this year, we should be able to capitalize on it. Given that I have close to about more than 10 to 12 lakh employee records in India. We will try and target in terms of how many employees can use TaxSpanner in terms of the IT returns that they can file. So I don't ha

items.statement: New BOT model deal with 1,000+ FTEs expected to grow 2-3x; assisted captive/build-operate-transfer service launched
items.quote: One of our -- we've started with one of our clients. and it is already in progress as we speak today, it's relationship over 1,000 FTEs, which is expected to grow at least by another 2 or 3x. So that's a new service plan that we've added, and we are bringing in AI here as well in terms of our recruitment, training and why we do this.

items.statement: AI and technology embedding puts Alldigi on par with competition in market; growth depends on sales execution
items.quote: the technological embedding and AI infusion is not going to immediately help us in terms of growth percentage. However, it puts us on par with competition in terms of the market. So when we go into a potential client today or an existing client, we are on par with competition in terms of where we stand in terms of adoption of technology and all of the features that is available using technology.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased due to business acceleration and conversion of unbilled to billed; DSO days expected to decrease further
items.quote: Yes, Raghu, you are absolutely right, both the factors are showing acceleration in the business, which of course, leads to higher receivables. The second point is also what I talked about converting whatever unbilled as billed and therefore more receivables and we continue to receive those as we progress. Because the way we report our DSOs is billed plus unbilled together.

items.statement: Cash and liquid funds INR127.2 crores as of Sep 2026; sequential reduction due to dividend payment
items.quote: Cash and liquid funds stood at INR127.2 crores at the end of September 2026. The sequential reduction largely reflects the dividend paid during the quarter, while the underlying business continued to generate healthy cash flows.

items.statement: Board approved buyback of up to 4.8 lakh equity shares at INR1,000 per share (INR48 crore) subject to approvals
items.quote: I'm also pleased to announce that the Board of Directors of the company has approved a proposal to buy back shares of up to 4.8 lakh equity shares at INR1,000 per share, representing an INR48 crore in share consideration subject to applicable approvals.

items.statement: Appointed new Chief Business Officer for BPM; expanded international sales team with experienced BPM leaders for US and Southeast Asia; established SMB and enterprise sales teams for Tech & Digital
items.quote: We've appointed a new Chief Business Officer for the BPM business. We've expanded our international sales team, and we now have experienced sales leaders from the BPM industry leading the U.S. sales team. And there is an established SMB sales team and an enterprise sales team within the Tech & Digital. We've also expanded our sales capability on the BPM side into Southeast Asia.

items.statement: PAT grew 50.9% YoY to INR26.6 crores in Q2; PAT margin 17.3% vs 12% YoY; H1 PAT up 37.5% to INR44.7 crores
items.quote: PAT for quarter 2 2027 stood at INR26.6 crores, increasing by 50.9% year-on-year basis and 46.7% sequentially. PAT margin expanded to 17.3% compared to 12% in the quarter 2 of last year and 12.1% in the quarter 1 of 2027.

items.statement: NPS integration with payroll platform at early stage; too early to comment on revenue potential or 401(k)-like opportunity
items.quote: In terms of your NPS integration, it's too early to say how the response is going to be. The 401(k) comparison to U.S. would not be an apple -to-apple comparison because that has been a very long existing process, and it is at a different scale. So if you a sk me 401(k) benefit is an entire industry and the service by itself in the U.S., maybe NPS can go there, but it is too early to comment

items.statement: Revenue conversion from new ACV wins depends on client implementation timelines; BPM ramps in 3-4 months, Tech & Digital takes longer
items.quote: Traditionally, what we've seen is the BPM, once it starts, the revenue starts coming in better, we should be able to complete the overall ramp-up within about 3 to 4 months. But the T&D sector is a little different. It takes a longer incubation time because there are multiple other factors and technology that the client is using is also coming into picture.

items.statement: Management expects enterprise EBITDA margin to stay in the 17%-18% band for FY27 and FY28, with no meaningful expansion due to revenue mix shift toward lower-margin data center business.
items.quote: Yes, I think that is what I would expect. I mean, if there is a meaningf ul change because some part of the business accelerates a lot more or a little bit less than what we expect, then we will come back and sort of comment at the end of Q3. But yes, I think that is what I would expect right now

items.statement: Management declines to provide revenue growth guidance, stating a player of their size should not give guidance at this stage.
items.quote: No, I don't think so. I don't think there is any player of our size. I mean, you or any o f the investors can educate me if you need to, but we looked at this across the market. At a board level, we discussed this as well, and we don't think a player of our size should be giving guidance at this stage

items.statement: Commercial activity in banking and fintech has picked up meaningfully with several large deals in advanced stages and multiple proofs of concept running across Asia and Europe.
items.quote: Commercial activity has picked up meaningfully, with several large dea ls in advanced stages and multiple proofs of concept running across Asia, across Europe, led by our agentic AI workflows and AI -native platforms in transaction banking trade finance

items.statement: Data center business is seeing extraordinary demand for high-density compute from hyperscalers and AI clouds, with new mandates driving record order book additions.
items.quote: In data centers, rapid AI workload growth is creating extraordinary demand for high-density compute, and we are deepening our footprint through new mandates with leading hyperscalers.

items.statement: Middle East deal action is meaningfully back, with hopes to announce significant wins in the region before year-end.
items.quote: We do see deal action coming back in the Middle East. In fact, we do hope over the next quarter or two to announce some significant wins in the region.

items.statement: Banking and fintech margins are at or slightly above expectations; transit margins trending up; data center margins below enterprise average but expected to improve as proprietary products are added.
items.quote: On the banking and fintech side, I think we had a very strong H1. In general, margins are more or less where we expect them to be or slightly better. On the transit side, again, over the full year, margins have been trending up even beyond this year, and they'll continue to trend up.

items.statement: Enterprise margin expected to stay flat at current levels in H2 due to data center revenue growing 70%-80% and diluting mix, offsetting improvements in banking and transit.
items.quote: I think at a margin level, my expectation would be we more or less stay at the level where we are. Under the hood, the banking side will, of course, improve as we go into H2. The transit side will also improve slightly as we go into H2. But then you'll see the mix change to a level where because data center will probably grow 70%-80%, if not more, this year. If that happens, I think the mix will e

items.statement: Order book exceeds INR 2,000 crores; data center portion now north of 30% of total, with overall split roughly two-thirds TIG and one-third banking and fintech.
items.quote: We head into the second half backed by an order book of more than INR 2,000 crores, a deep pipeline, and accelerating execution.

items.statement: Data center order book is north of 30% of total; overall split is probably two-thirds TIG and one-third banking and fintech.
items.quote: Yes, so it has picked up. I would say it is north of 30% now. Overall, I think the split is probably two-thirds, one-third now between the TIG side and banking and fintech side.

items.statement: Approximately 70%-75% of the order book is executable over the next 4-6 quarters; AMCs and recurring revenues are largely excluded from the order book.
items.quote: I would say the way one should look at the order book that exists right now, it used to be 80%. It's probably now 70%, 75% of it is executable over the next 4-6 quarters, I would think.

items.statement: Company is integrating backward to manufacture critical components for data centers and transit, controlling the stack end-to-end for quality, timelines, and unit economics.
items.quote: Building on our proven transit manufacturing footprint, we are integrating backward to manufacture critical components for both next-generation data centers and mass transit networks.

items.statement: Data center capacity ramp is a key variable; projects are 12-14 months with increasing pressure to shrink timelines to 12-18 months.
items.quote: Typically, what we are seeing is these are 12, 14-month projects these days. There is an increasing pressure on timelines that we see at least on that business, where earlier clients were more prepared for a long gestation for projects, while now they are typically getting shrunk to 12 months or less, or 18 months or less.

items.statement: R&D intensity peaked in H1 FY27 and will moderate; bulk of AI-native product build-out is complete, freeing capacity for revenue projects.
items.quote: We believe the incremental intensity of this R&D ramp that we went through, it peaked in H1 and will moderate going forward.

items.statement: Token costs for third-party AI coding tools are not expected to rise; company is building in-house coding agents to eliminate token costs and improve performance.
items.quote: I feel a scenario where in the next three, four months, we would probably be on completely in -house models. will actually not really be using, at least public closed weight model s, right? We building out our own infrastructure. It gives us an opportunity also to build out agents which are overfitted to our own software and hence deliver a performance which is better than the frontier model anywa

items.statement: Data center revenue share of TIG business rising from ~33% last year to 40%-50% this year; TIG share of overall mix also climbing.
items.quote: I think data center business was a third of the TIG business last year. This year, it would probably be something between, I do not know, 40% and 50% thereabouts this year, right? That is how the mix is sort of changing on that side.

items.statement: New AI-native banking products (Verdict, Infinity OS, Lexsi Labs) launched; will ship brand-new AI-native software every quarter this year.
items.quote: With our foundational architecture in place, we will ship brand-new AI-native software every single quarter this year, sometimes more than once in a quarter, helping clients turn this technology shift into measurable business results.

items.statement: Transit business expanding globally with Finland win; targeting European and US markets with proven IP and partnerships.
items.quote: You would have seen the win in Finland. Increasingly, we will go after European markets and U.S., and we feel we have got the partnerships, we have got the IP, we have got the capability now to really scale that business globally.

items.statement: Current borrowings rose to INR 150 crores from INR 50 crores in March due to large data center deals; cash declined to ~INR 83 crores; expected to normalize by year-end.
items.quote: On the borrowing side, I think it's a point in time pressure because of one or two very, very specific deals, especially on the data center side, because of which. These are very large contracts, and we have not delivered contracts of this scale before at least, and it takes some basic retooling in the enterprise to be able to deliver these well.

items.statement: Targeting 60%-70% OCF-to-EBITDA conversion for FY27, with collections skewed to Q3 and Q4; data center unbilled revenue under control in Q3.
items.quote: I think something between 60% and 70% is doable, and I think that's what we will sort of stay focused on.

items.statement: Short-term borrowing increase is temporary due to large data center contract execution; no significant long-term cash pressure expected.
items.quote: Over the long run, I don't expect them to put any significant pressure on cash, but over the short run, you do see the borrowings expand because we do need to keep executing while we are ironing out sort of those issues, right?

items.statement: H1 FY27 R&D capitalization tapered off as major AI-native product builds near completion; future R&D spend expected to be expensed unless new large build-outs arise.
items.quote: The capitalization essentially is a function of a point in time, I need to do really fresh build-outs, right? Which we decided to do sometime around, I would say Q1 of last year or Q2 of last year, and then it slowly accelerated through the year, last year, where we said we will build out a brand new AI-native version of every single Aurionpro product.

items.statement: Cybersecurity identified as a growing threat and opportunity; practice established four quarters ago, building capabilities over next four quarters.
items.quote: We set up the cybersecurity practice now four quarters back. We went in for the certification and stuff. Basically, we will build out a fairly strong set of capabilities on the cybersecurity side.

items.statement: Data center project execution carries working capital and billing timing risks in early stages, but managed with discipline and factored into profitability.
items.quote: obviously, there is a little bit of working capital requirement, I think, relat ive to the size of the business and the size of the opportunity and the size of the profit you can make in it. It is not super significant. But right now, there is a little bit of stress because we are starting off the projects and we are trying to sort of iron out some kinks in terms of how you bill and when you bill

items.statement: Company remains capital-light; will invest limited capital where return on capital is highest across segments, with transparency on incremental investments.
items.quote: We have traditionally been a very capital-light business, and we will continue to be a capital-light business. The question is, look at where the capital is going and see how you actually meaningfully allocate the limited capital we have to make most of it, right?

items.statement: FY27 sales guidance maintained at INR11,200 crores including Zentech transaction
items.quote: Our FY27 sales guidance remains INR11,200 crores, including the Zentech transaction.

items.statement: H1 FY27 total sales achievement INR4,200 crores, 37.5% of annual guidance
items.quote: Together these take our total sales achievement for the first half of year to INR4,200 crores or 37.51% of our annual sales guidance of INR11,200 crores.

items.statement: Residential demand strong in South and West; no slowdown seen; consolidation benefits branded developers
items.quote: I don't see that we have any kind of slowdown or some people use the word phasing out of the demand. I don't see that, and it will continue to be there.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 27%; project-level weighted average EBITDA margin ~30%
items.quote: EBITDA was INR289 crores, representing margin of 27%.

items.statement: Hebbal project requires ~INR700 crores construction capex; Aerocity Phase 2 needs ~INR450 crores over 4 years
items.quote: Hebbal, after the land cost, it will require close to INR700 crores for the 1.3 million-odd square feet that we are developing over there.

items.statement: Gross debt down INR180 crores to INR3,763 crores; net debt down INR470 crores to INR2,366 crores; net D/E 1.26x
items.quote: Gross debt declined by approximately INR180 crores to INR3,763 crores, while net debt reduced by INR470 crores to INR2,366 crores.

items.statement: FY27 collection guidance INR6,000 crores; operating surplus target >INR1,000 crores
items.quote: We had given guidance that we'll be doing a collections of about INR6,000 crores for the year as a whole and operating surplus. We had done last year about -- we'll be crossing INR1,000 crores mark as operating surplus.

items.statement: Ongoing portfolio 33.61 msf; planned launches 14.5 msf with GDV ~INR22,600 crores
items.quote: At the end of September, our ongoing portfolio comprised of 33.61 million square feet. We also had a planned launch program of 14.5 million square feet with estimated GDV of appr oximately INR22,600 crores

items.statement: Miami ultra-luxury pre-launch at INR1.55 lakh/sq ft; 3 transactions during demolition phase
items.quote: The current price on which we are doing transactions is all in the range of INR1.55 lakh per square feet.

items.statement: H1 FY27 handed over 1,722 homes (977 in Q2); consistent delivery priority
items.quote: We handed over 977 homes covering approximately 0.97 million square feet during the quarter, taking first half handover to 1,722 homes.

items.statement: H1 FY27 added development opportunities GDV INR14,100 crores across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Greater Noida
items.quote: During H1, we added development opportunity with an estimated GDV of INR14,100 crores across Bengaluru, Mumbai, Greater Noida.

items.statement: Average price realization rose 32% YoY to INR11,607 per sq ft in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Average price realization rose 32% to INR11,607 per square feet and customer collections grew by 24% year -on-year to INR1,301 crores.

items.statement: Redevelopment saves ~60% initial capital outlay vs land purchase; cost ~40% of land value including tenant compensation
items.quote: if we go and buy and do a redevelopment versus buying a land, we incur, including the tenants and the members, cost and corpuses that we pay, the cost comes to around 40% of the overall land value.

items.statement: Bangalore approvals delayed due to system upgrade; Winworth Cochin RERA in 2-3 days; Grand Hills launch Q4; Hennur Road RERA this month
items.quote: Winworth-3 that is in Cochin, and we should be able to get RERA in the next 2, 3 days. And so it should be a launch in this quarter itself. Then we have Grand Hills. Grand Hills, we've already received the development plan approval and which in all probability that we should be able to launch that without fail in the fourth quarter.

items.statement: Consolidation reduces developers to 10-20 per city; Puravankara brand strength insulates from demand shrinkage
items.quote: we always talked about the consolidation that we used to be 200, 300 developers and now we have maybe 10, 20 developers in each city doing the work.

items.statement: Cuffe Parade launch may slip to April-May next fiscal; some South projects may push to next year
items.quote: There might be a chance that Cuffe Parade might move to April -May for next financial year.

items.statement: Purva Zentech monetized 5.46 lakh sq ft at INR626 crores; full consideration received except INR57-60 crores deferred
items.quote: we monetized approximately 5.46 lakh square feet of commercial office space at Purva Zentech for an asset value of INR626 crores

items.statement: H2 FY27 lubricant volume growth expected at 2x-3x industry average of 3-4%, targeting near double-digit growth
items.quote: We expect H2 to have the normal 3%, 4% growth which lubricant industry takes in terms of average lubricant growth, and we will do 2x to 3x that.

items.statement: AdBlue volume growth guidance maintained at 10-15% double-digit for H2 FY27 and next financial year
items.quote: So, we estimate that we should grow our AdBlue volumes by double-digit 10% to 15% is what our guidance has been in the past. So, we stick to that going forward.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin at 11.8%, near guided 12-14% band; per-litre margins protected despite inflation
items.quote: And also, at the same time, it is important to note that we have been able to maintain our margins in more or less near to the guided band of 12% to 14%. The margins for the quarter are 11.8%.

items.statement: Core lubricant volume grew 16% YoY in Q2 FY27 to 47,000 KL; H1 volume up 17% to 95,000 KL, 3-4x industry growth
items.quote: Overall, our core lubricant volume was 47,000 KL versus last year 40,500 KL, which means we have added 6,500 KL during the quarter, and that gives us 16% growth.

items.statement: AdBlue volume dipped to 33,000 KL in Q2 due to monsoon; H1 flat at 73,000 KL
items.quote: AdBlue in this quarter, we all know that this was a monsoon quarter. So, there were some lesser movements of vehicles during this quarter, especially the truck movements are slightly lower because of monsoons.

items.statement: B2C/B2B revenue split roughly 55:45 historically, shifted to 50:50 in Q2; personal mobility 21% of volume, PCMO share <5%
items.quote: So B2C, B2B ratio has been in and around 55 -45, 55% being B2C and 45% being B2B, roughly. In this quarter, it was slightly around, let's say, around 50-50.

items.statement: Targeting synthetic products to reach 10% of portfolio over next 3-4 years
items.quote: So just to tell you, that is another endeavor, which hopefully, in the second half, we will see definitely some traction. Yes, this is a range which we want to, over a period of next 3 to 4 years, make it synthetic range about 10% of our portfolio.

items.statement: OEM franchisee workshops grew high double-digit; ~7,000 workshops across CV, car, tractor, industrial OEMs
items.quote: we have a large number of OEM franchisee workshops, about 7,000 numbers with OEMs who have been with us, and we have a very good portfolio of OEMs right from the commercial vehicle to the car OEMs, to the tractor OEMs, to industrial OEMs right across

items.statement: B2B industrial segment grew high double-digit; ~1/3 of incremental growth from new customers
items.quote: And the B2B industrial segment also was a very good segment for us in this quarter, again, going into high double digit. We continue our focus to also look at new customers. And I think some of the B2B industrial customers that came in, nearly 1/3 of the i ncremental growth is from new customers

items.statement: Distribution outlets grew 16% YoY, expanding from ~90,000 base
items.quote: We used to talk about 90,000 outlets, but that's growing by about 10% to 15%. Every quarter, we try to take it up over previous year. And we've seen a 16% growth in terms of our number of outlets.

items.statement: Three price hikes taken in B2C channel since September 2025; OEM contracts have quarterly/monthly price variation clauses; B2B negotiated separately
items.quote: If we to give you an idea, in channel business, which is our B2C, we have taken 3 price increases so far. In OEM businesses, which is a good part of our business, we have quarterly price variation clauses.

items.statement: Base oil costs include CIF freight/insurance; sea freight rates up due to Strait of Hormuz disruptions, but no incremental impact beyond CIF pricing
items.quote: We have our most of the purchases on CIF basis. So, all these are built in the base oil cost or the global price indices. There is no additional incremental impact which we see because our prices are always a CFR, CIF basis.

items.statement: Additive costs strengthening; additive companies taking price hikes
items.quote: Some of our other cost components like additive, et cetera, have been strengthening further in terms of cost and additive companies have been taking some price hikes.

items.statement: Chennai expansion on track for completion by end of Q3 FY27; Silvassa expansion delayed 1-2 months to Q1 FY28; total capex ~INR 60-62 crore (INR 55 crore + INR 5-7 crore incremental)
items.quote: We were estimating INR 55 crore earlier, which was announced. And we see that there is an incremental need of INR 5 crore to INR 7 crore, which the Board has sanctioned recently. So now the total capex for expansion is around INR 60 crore, INR 62 crore.

items.statement: Tirex revenue INR 33 crore in Q2 FY27 (78% YoY growth from INR 18 crore); expanding into mining, construction, private buses
items.quote: I think Tirex, 78% growth in revenue. Of course, the bases are low, but still we have done, I think last year was INR 18 crore, now we have done about INR 33 crore plus.

items.statement: Exports ~10% of lubricant business in last 6 months, up from prior levels due to global supply-demand
items.quote: In the last six months, exports have gone up because of the global supply situation as well supply-demand situation. We have been able to export even higher amount. So, as we speak, currently, it is in the range of around 10%.

items.statement: Gross working capital days stable at 95-105 days; absolute values up due to price inflation; near peak if prices stabilize
items.quote: In terms of number of days, we are still in the usual, our band of gross 95 to 105 days. So, in terms of number of days, we have not seen any meaningful increase. But yes, absolute values have gone up here because of the pricing.

items.statement: Inventory adjustments INR 109 crore (Q1) and INR 88 crore (Q2) due to higher prices and tactical buying for supply security
items.quote: Plus, we have had certain extra buying to secure supplies because sometimes when we get a cargo and we want to secure for future, we have been trying to buy those tactical buying also.

items.statement: Cash balance ~INR 1,200 crore; prioritizing M&A in lubricants, industrial, EV mobility adjacencies; dividend payout 65-70% if surplus cash
items.quote: We have been cognizant of the fact that we carry INR 1,200 crore of cash on the balance sheet. And the plan is to clearly have a war chest for M&A opportunities within the lubricant space, within our current business, adjacencies around that.

items.statement: Dividend payout increased to 65-70% last year; will return surplus cash if no immediate M&A deployment
items.quote: Over the years, we have been increasing our dividend payouts. And last year, I think we had around close to 65%, 70% dividend payouts.

items.statement: Actively exploring M&A in lubricants, industrial segment, EV value chain; ElectreeFi SaaS gaining traction with new OEMs
items.quote: We keep looking, we have done some investment, as you all know. And we are exploring opportunities in and around those EV businesses and the value chain. And also, we keep ourselves open to looking at M&A opportunities.

items.statement: Agri demand weakness seen in October; West Asia crisis and crude volatility pose cost pass-through risk
items.quote: There is a little bit weak demand coming in from the agri season as we look at this month. And that is, of course, something which we will have to factor in.

items.statement: Valsad plant fire: ~4-5 days production lost, inventory covered by insurance; no supply disruption expected; extra shifts planned
items.quote: So, the stocks are covered under insurance. And obviously, the entire fire has been since doused and we see that close to 4, 5 days of equivalent of production has been lost in terms of inventory.

items.statement: Expects H1 FY27 EBITDA margins to sustain in H2 FY27, close to 19.8%
items.quote: we expect the margins in the first half to be -- the margins to sustain or we expect to do on similar lines going forward in the next second half, there and thereabout.

items.statement: Projects FY28 revenue around INR4,000 crores with EBITDA margin at least 15%, likely higher
items.quote: Last call you mentioned that we will be somewhere around INR4,000 crores mark in terms of revenues and margins will be somewhere around 15% to 16%.

items.statement: Expects yarn spreads of INR130-145 per kg for next 3-4 months
items.quote: the spreads between 130 and 145 going ahead. We see it somewhere here. Abhishek Shankar: Okay. Munish Avasthi: At least for next 3 months, 4 months

items.statement: Odisha Greenfield project construction complete, machinery erection underway, commercial production in 30-40 days, full commissioning by March FY27
items.quote: the construction is of the first phase is complete and the erection of machines is going on. So we expect to start the commercial production in next 30 to 40 days, and we intend to complete the project by March '27.

items.statement: Peak long-term debt expected at INR700-750 crores by March FY27, working capital debt under INR200 crores

items.quote: Importantly, our customers are working to consolidate their supplier base. items.quote: Put simply, across these two funds raised post our IPO, we have taken in about INR398 crores of equity. Over the same period , revenue has grown from INR500 crores to INR9,000 crores plus, roughly 18x.

items.quote: I know many of you have questions about the fundraise we announced recently. In line with the regulatory guidelines, I am not allowed to speak about its specific purpose or the use of proceeds.

items.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%. Because we billed only making charges, i t adds 110 basis points to gross margin while needing almost no working capital.

items.statement: Star Mangalsutra fraud incident: INR10.7 crores involved, INR3.35 crores recovered, balance fully provided in Q2 FY27
items.value: INR10.7 crores fraud, INR3.35 crores recovered
items.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra , disclosed in July. Of the INR10.70 crores involved, INR3.35 crores has been recovered, and the balance is fully provided this quarter.

items.statement: AUM crossed INR5,000 crores for the first time in recent quarters, showing 10% QoQ growth

items.quote: We are at 24.9%, up from 24.6% compared to Q1.

items.quote: NIM has improved to 13.6% compared to 12.5%, which is output of both improvement in the yield as well as reduction in the financial cost.

items.quote: GNPA has come down to 2.5% against 3.6%. NNPA has reduced to 0.5% against 0.68%.

items.quote: Today, if we see the X-bucket collection efficiency, which at a point in time was as low as 96.2% over last 2 years at a particular point in time, today is at 99.6%.

items.quote: Our AUM, like I've earlier explained, between 31 and 90 if we have to look at it on a consolidated basis, is at 0.55% compared to 0.73% end of June.

items.quote: So I would say that at this point in time, we are aiming for at least near-term aim is to reach a INR10,000 crores mark by March '28.

items.quote: We should get to the ROA of 3.5% to 4%, which is what we have stated. And we're very confident that, that looks like will play out. ROE accordingly, with a 4x gearing should be closer to 14%, 15%, thereabouts.

items.quote: The gross always, I said 2.5% to 3%, and we are holding good because even if you have a 99% - 99.5% collection efficiency, even if you flow 0.5%, you flow 6% during the course of the year, 50%, if you are able to collect, it's going to be around 2.5% to 3% gross.

items.quote: Tenure will be 7 to 10 years, ideally 7 to 8 years with some exceptions around 8 to 10 years. The LTV is going to be about 60%. In some cases, may go up to 65%. And pricing, again, we are looking between 19% and 22%.

items.quote: Fortunately, our book is about INR600 crores in these 2 states put together, of which about 96% of the portfolio is in current status, 3% is in the GNPA.

items.quote: Price-sensitive OEM segment was slow to respond initially. Also, due to price increases taken in Q1, many OEMs had made alternate import arrangements, impact of which continued into Q2FY27.

items.quote: Our annual foreign trip scheme meet with our top 150-plus channel partners in Hong Kong and Macau in August has helped to further reinforce our connect with our partners.

items.quote: The working capital cycle has improved by 5 days versus the 30th of June numbers, while the net debt has further reduced to INR133 crore.

items.quote: EPCG for the quarter was roughly INR4 crore.

items.quote: Abnormal conditions in the Middle East continue to persist, impacting the availability of containers and vessels, leading to higher delivery costs for our end consumers.

items.quote: Crude prices have again gone up. People are expecting the geopolitical situation to get disrupted again very soon. It is very hard to say where the chemical prices will stand at this point of time.

items.quote: We are very close to finalizing our targets, you know, and, fundraising is definitely going to be there by February, end of Jan, beginning of February of 2027.

items.quote: So you can keep it as at a similar levels of what Q2 is, but after Q4 from the next year, it would be slowly diminishing but not at a single go.

With this, we also need to reorient ourselves more in favor of value, given the macroeconomic reality in the Country and a strong K-shaped economy that India is turning into

items.statement: PBT of INR 5.7 crore in Q2 vs loss last year; H1 PBT of INR 29 crore vs loss of INR 24 crore previous year
items.quote: This is one of the best Q2 operating EBITDA numbers that we have seen and the same helped us post profit before taxes of INR 5.7 crore for the quarter against a loss last year. Your Company delivered a PBT of INR 29 crore in H1 versus a loss of INR 24 crore in the previous year.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance revised to around INR 600 crores from earlier INR 650 crores due to project deferment
items.quote: Out of INR 650 crores top line, a little drop would be there because earlier, in the beginning, we thought our new project MCC 12,000 metric tons capacity will come a little early, but some deferment would be there. Now, more or less, around INR 600 or so we can reach.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at around 18% for full year, with H2 expected to be at least 18% or better
items.quote: The overall guidance also we have given around 18%, but second half, at least, we are expecting even better, at least 18%, even better than 18%, so that it will balance out.

items.statement: FY28 revenue expected to exceed INR 800 crores with new MCC capacity adding over INR 200 crores top line
items.quote: Next year, this 12,000 metric tons capacity is expected in Q2 end. Maybe one or two months here and there would be there. After that, 12,000 metric tons into INR 250, 12,000 into 90%, its operational also around 10,800 metric tons into INR 225, if you take both, there is almost more than INR 200 crores top line will come, INR 243 crores.

items.statement: Total CapEx for 12,000 MTPA MCC expansion and CCS facility at Dahej estimated at roughly INR 200 crores (INR 100 crores MCC, INR 90 crores CCS)
items.quote: Around INR 100 crores for MCC and around INR 90 crores for CCS. Maybe for the total CapEx, that would be roughly INR 200 crores.

items.statement: INR 29 crores spent so far on combined MCC and CCS projects at Dahej SEZ
items.quote: Total all put together is around INR 30 crores, nearly INR 29 crores.

items.statement: 12,000 MTPA MCC expansion and CCS facility at Dahej SEZ expected to commission in Q2 FY28, taking total MCC capacity to ~30,000 MTPA
items.quote: 12,000 metric tonne-per-annum of MCC expansion of Dahej SEZ is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY28, taking a total MCC capacity to approximately 30,000 metric ton-per-annum.

items.statement: Current MCC capacity utilization ~80% at Dahej and Jhagadia; expected to increase by 10% after safety equipment installation by Nov 15-20
items.quote: In the half year, there is almost 79.91%, around 80% in the Dahej unit, and the Jhagadia unit around 79%. Overall, nearly 80% utilization is there. Another 10% there will be increase from another 15 days, from 15th to 20th of November.

items.statement: API capacity of 100 kL can support up to INR 100-150 crores revenue with value-added products
items.quote: API, presently, we have the capacity of 100 kL. That 100 kL, it can give easily give up to INR 100 CR, and then some value addition products, if we manufacture them, INR 120 cr to maximum INR 150 cr also we can achieve.

items.statement: API order book expected to reach INR 100-120 crores in FY27 with H1 at INR 38 crores and strong Q3-Q4 expected
items.quote: Order book, see, half year, we have reached INR 38 crores, and next third quarter and fourth quarter would be good, and so nearly INR 100 crores we can reach. Even now, if there is a good order in fourth quarter, then we can reach another INR 10 or 20 crores also, up to INR 120 crores also, is a possibility in API.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 14.72%; H2 margins expected to improve on higher special/co-processed grade mix and fixed cost absorption
items.quote: We are expecting because in the second half, there will not be further increase in fixed overhead costs. There will be increase in revenue, and the margins also will be on higher side. And sales mix also is going to change. The co-processed variants and then special grades will be on higher side in the next six months.

items.statement: MCC average realization improved from INR 216.42/kg in H1 FY26 to INR 252.16/kg in H1 FY27; Q2 realization INR 262.83/kg vs Q1 INR 241.36/kg
items.quote: Gradually, it is improving. Even the margins average price realization, if you see, in Q1 it is 241.36, and Q2, it is 262.83. And then an average for the entire H1, it is 252.16, whereas previous year, H1, it was 216.42.

items.statement: Special and co-processed MCC grades currently ~20% of mix, targeting 50% increase in Q3-Q4 to drive higher revenue and margins
items.quote: Now, within Q3 and Q4, almost, it is 50% increase would be there to the existing. Existing is around 20%. And there is much increase we are seeing in Q3 and Q4. That is the reason we are expecting higher revenues as well as the margins.

items.statement: Demand for MCC and CCS very high; orders exceed production capacity; supply is the only constraint
items.quote: But always for us, ther e is a good demand, and Sigachi is known for quality and customer satisfaction, means timely supply of the materials, and then also addressing their pain points in the operational, flow of material in capsulation or tableting, and all those things, we neve r faced. We have high demand, right now, the supply is the only constraint

items.statement: Preferential issue of INR 200 crores called off due to share price surge; fund raise via debt or equity to be announced at appropriate time for CapEx
items.quote: But later on, it sharply went up to almost INR 39, and we received many calls. We missed the opportunity, and then at this point of time, it's not wise to dilute at this rate. Then the promoters also thought, “okay”, they were the maj or beneficiaries out of that issue, even though they have discussed with the people, and then they have seen the best interest of the company and shareholders, the i

items.statement: Current debt very low; peak debt level not yet decided; bankers supportive for debt at competitive rates
items.quote: Right now, we have not yet decided, but our bankers, they are very supportive, and then even if we want to take the debt, that is available easily at competitive price also. At the same time, we can raise equity also, which we are discussing. Even right now, it is very less, on meager side debt is there.

items.statement: MCC volume produced and sold in H1 FY27: 7,128 metric tons; Q2 volume ~3,600-3,700 tons vs Q1 ~3,500 tons
items.quote: And then coming to the volume, it is almost about there is 7,128 metric tons of capacity we have produced and sold.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 segment revenue: MCC INR 91.22 crores (70%), API INR 16.67 crores (13%), O&M INR 13.93 crores (11%), allied ~7%
items.quote: The MCC segment contributed INR 91.22 crores, while the O&M and API segments recorded revenues of INR 13.93 crores and INR 16.67 crores respectively.

items.statement: Lower capacity utilization in H1 due to safety audits and equipment installation post Hyderabad plant accident; safety prioritized over production
items.quote: The thing is, after Hyderabad plant accident, we have concentrated more on safety audits, internal, external, and customer audits more on this. That's why when the concentration is on this, the production concentration was less. The main intention is the safety. Safety is the first priority.

items.statement: API revenue deferred from Q2 to Q3 as customers requested dispatch in third quarter
items.quote: Only thing is, In Q2, the revenue has been deferred to the third quarter. That is the reason some of the customers they were requested to dispatch in third quarter. That is the reason. In the third and fourth quarter, we are expecting good revenues.

items.statement: New PureCoat coating portfolio launched with four offerings: PureCoat Flavor, TiO2 Free, Pearl, and NP using natural polymers
items.quote: On the innovation front, we further strengthen our PureCoat coating portfolio with the launch of four new offerings: PureCoat Flavor for odor masking, PureCoat TiO2 Free, PureCoat Pearl featuring natural silicate or silica-based pigments with iron oxide, and PureCoat NP, developed using natural polymer like pullulan as an alternative to synthetic polymers.

items.statement: US subsidiary performing well and contributing to revenue growth
items.quote: And, our US subsidiary is doing good. And API also, we are expecting more margins and revenues from Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: New API products sparsentan and bempedoic acid trials completed; higher margin value-added products targeted for Q3-Q4 sales
items.quote: As of now, we are doing sparsentan and bempedoic acid also. We have done trials, and which gives higher margi ns. That is the reason. As of now, 100 kL capacity is

items.statement: Express volume growth for FY27 expected at upper end of 20-30% range, potentially beyond
items.quote: as things stand, I don't really see any reason for us to revise our estimate of growth. In fact, we are at the moment, beyond the upper end of the 20-30% that we had guided at the start of the year.

items.statement: Express service EBITDA margin for FY27 expected around 17%
items.quote: I think it's safe to say that FY27, 17% sounds absolutely where we will end up.

items.statement: Aggregated transportation margins to expand 130-150 bps YoY in FY27
items.quote: Our estimation is that overall aggregated transportation margins should expand by 130-150 basis points even conservatively between FY26 and FY27.

items.statement: E-commerce volume growth guidance of 15-20% for FY27 remains reasonable
items.quote: I don't see any particular reason for our guidance on e-commerce in general growing volume terms somewhere between 15-20% being, very, very off.

items.statement: October volumes slightly ahead of forecast despite macro volatility
items.quote: the month of October has also been a pretty good month for us. And we're ahead of where we actually expected to be as of this month.

items.statement: PTL margins to expand YoY in FY27
items.quote: PTL margins should expand between FY26 and FY27.

items.statement: Express margins at least equal to FY26 levels, with potential upside from PTL volume growth
items.quote: Express, it should be at least equal to FY26 levels, let me put it that way.

items.statement: Price revisions started mid-to-late Q1, fructified in Q2 across Express and PTL
items.quote: we started making them towards the middle end of Q1. We had spoken about this in Q1 that a lot of them would fructify in Q2 and you can see that has taken place across both the Express and the PTL businesses.

items.statement: Same-day/next-day delivery business north of Rs 200-500 Cr revenue, expanding fulfillment centres in top 15 cities
items.quote: were we to split it out, this business would probably look like a Rs. 300, 400, 500 Cr business, all things put together.

items.statement: Delhivery Local ARR crossed Rs 200 Cr, targeting Rs 240-250 Cr by FY27 exit, CM breakeven possible in Q4 FY27
items.quote: Our aim was to really get to maybe Rs. 240-250 Cr ARR by exit of this financial year. As things stand, we've already crossed Rs. 200 Cr and are growing faster than we originally expected.

items.statement: International Saver business at ~Rs 140 Cr ARR, grew 55% QoQ Q1 to Q2 FY27, service EBITDA breakeven
items.quote: The Saver business that we had launched, are today hitting probably close to Rs. 140 Cr ARR in this business. It's actually grown 55% QoQ between Q1FY27 and Q2FY27 and has also broken even at a service EBITDA level.

items.statement: Economy plus express international shipping opportunity estimated at Rs 900-1,000 Cr over 3-4 years
items.quote: Our estimation is that over the next three or four year period, the economy plus express shipping revenues for Delhivery could end up being a low four digit crores. This could be a Rs. 900-1,000 Cr kind of opportunity for us.

items.statement: Investing in automation (AGVs, robotics) and AI initiatives; 40% stake in Falcon Autotech gives cost curve visibility
items.quote: we are also 40% shareholders in Falcon Autotech, we understand how the cost curve for automation works. And we do believe we're at that cost in terms of new robotic systems that we otherwise would simply have been unable to deploy maybe three or four years ago.

items.statement: Express shipments 325 million in Q2 FY27, up 32% YoY
items.quote: Our express business delivered 325 million shipments in Q2FY27. So, we are up about 32% YoY.

items.statement: PTL freight 545K metric tonnes in Q2 FY27, up 14.2% YoY
items.quote: The PTL business delivered 545K metric tonnes of freight, up about 14.2% YoY.

items.statement: Revenue from services crossed Rs 3,066 Cr in Q2 FY27, up 20% YoY
items.quote: Overall revenue from services for the company crossed Rs. 3,000 Cr for the first time at Rs. 3,066 Cr for Q2FY27, which is up 20% YoY.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA Rs 123 Cr (4% of revenue) and PAT Rs 41 Cr in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA came in at Rs. 123 Cr or 4% of revenue with PAT of Rs. 41 Cr.

items.statement: AI-driven automation to further compress working capital cycle via faster billing and claim resolution
items.quote: Automation will certainly help in further improving our collection cycle because faster billing, more accurate billing and faster claim resolution, AI driven automation will help in all of these things and hence our receivables can further improve.

items.statement: Unbilled receivables are an accounting construct, not reducible by AI
items.quote: Unbilled is more of an accounting concept where a shipment which is not completed it's a life cycle in the network, a partial revenue has to be accrued as per accounting rules and hence it shows up in unbilled.

items.statement: Labour environment increasingly volatile due to availability, regulation, minimum wage revisions, and climate impact on productivity
items.quote: the labour environment in India has been steadily becoming more volatile and more challenging. One of the reasons, obviously, is labour availability has been challenging. Seasonal fluctuations in labour availability are pretty large. The second issue is regulation for the workforce has changed quite a lot. And it's quite volatile overall, minimum wages keep getting revised. There's a whole bunch o

items.statement: Market share intact in forward logistics; reverse logistics share declines in peak due to quality selectivity
items.quote: when you look at the forward logistics space overall, and we look at our volumes on forward logistics, our market share is intact. On reverse logistics, as I mentioned, in the peak period, our overall share of the reverse logistics market does decline a little bit.

items.statement: D2C market share grown or constant across all customer sizes; volume growth robust
items.quote: we're easily the market leader in that and our market share in the worst possible cases remains constant, but in all likelihood, our market share has probably grown in that segment over the year.

items.statement: Financial services business in early stage; spent year on regulatory setup to enable fleet owner lending and insurance
items.quote: A lot of this year has been spent on getting ourselves set up regulatorily to be able to expand this business. We're in the business of eventually being able to extend, through partners, loans to fleet owners who can then attach their vehicles into the Delhivery network.

items.statement: US midterm elections and fuel price volatility cited as near-term macro risks
items.quote: frankly, US midterm elections are on Tuesday. So, let's see how things go.

items.statement: Rapid commerce folded into larger fulfillment network; service continues via integrated fulfillment centres
items.quote: It's been folded back into this and the service continues to persist exactly as it did.

items.statement: AI initiatives saving $1 million annually via Delhivery Maps vs Google APIs; improving claims reduction and sales productivity
items.quote: Delhivery Maps, which over the last two quarters, the sophistication it has reached is already saving us a million dollars a year, compared to using Google APIs.

items.statement: Price revisions started mid-to-late Q1 and fructified in Q2 across Express and PTL; PTL yield increase driven by contractual revisions and value-added services, not just inflation.
items.quote: On price hikes, see the immediate price revisions that had to be made in response to inflation and fuel costs, and in some cases, changes to the labour code, we started making them towards the middle end of Q1.

items.statement: PTL contracts have 96-97% revenue covered by automatic fuel/wage inflation adjustments; Express contracts also carry inflation provisions pegged at different rates.
items.quote: On PTL, I think 96-97% of the revenue of PTL is anyway covered by automatic adjustments in the event of inflation of fuel prices or wages so there's direct coverage.

items.statement: Less than 30% of PTL yield increase came from cost-linked price revisions; majority from yield improvements.
items.quote: The answer is that less than 30% of the increase in yield, for example, in PTL has come as a consequence of underlying cost inflation linked price revision.

items.statement: Express yield up Rs 2.40 sequentially in Q2 FY27; less than half due to inflation-linked commercial revisions.
items.quote: the express yield is about 2 rupees 40 paisa higher as of 2QFY27 versus 1QFY27. Again, less than half of that is due to inflation linked commercial revisions.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA loss guidance Rs 130-160 Cr; H1 loss Rs 67 Cr tracking at lower end; FY28 loss expected broadly in same range unless contribution margins improve further.
items.quote: our guidance envelope for this was a little wide when we started the FY, Rs. 130 to 160 Cr itself is a fairly wide range. As you can see, I think our first half has been Rs. 67 Cr, which at least as things stand puts us more at the lower end of that range.

items.statement: Supply chain services pipeline remains robust; two new Q1 businesses stabilised and expanding; e-commerce starts up 50%+ YoY; enterprise side conservative due to cost unpredictability.
items.quote: Our ecommerce starts within supply chain services have actually gained pace that business is up, I think, probably 50% plus, YoY.

items.statement: Delhivery Local (in-city LCV) crossed Rs 200 Cr revenue run rate.
items.quote: There is Delhivery Local, which is our in-city LCV business that has crossed a revenue run rate of 200 crores.

items.statement: Non-marketplace Express segments growing 40-45%+ YoY even in weak quarter; gaining share via integrated fulfillment model and SDD/NDD leadership.
items.quote: our growth rates, even in a relatively weakish quarter, have never been lower than 40-45%.

items.statement: PTL TAM estimated at Rs 90,000-100,000 Cr (5x Rs 15-20k Cr organised market) driven by unorganised segment, migration from slow to fast PTL, and FTL-to-PTL shift.
items.quote: I think this is a Rs. 90,000-100,000 Cr opportunity at the bare minimum basis, what we know so far, possibly even larger than that.

items.statement: Express market expected to grow 15-20% volume CAGR medium term; Delhivery aims to grow at minimum that rate while gaining share via network quality and tech investments.
items.quote: we think will continue to grow at that 15-20% kind of range that we have said in the past in volume terms. That is one we definitely in any case, our belief is that we should continue to grow at a minimum of that if not higher as we continue to gain share.

items.statement: Fuel price hike pass-through lag will be significantly smaller going forward as contracts revised; no crystal ball on future diesel prices.
items.quote: our contracts are revised now to make sure that the lag effect is significantly smaller.

items.statement: Industry consolidation expected as efficient frontier requires asset-heavy investment; Delhivery's 15-year engineering expertise and integrated network create differentiated ability to gain share regardless of consolidation form.
items.quote: Logistics is one of the easiest businesses to enter and one of the hardest businesses to scale. And our belief is that as we get larger as our investments in technology and in engineering pay off, we have a differentiated ability to continue to gain scale and to continue to actually gain share in the market irrespective of what the market's growth rates are.

items.statement: Expect cost growth to return to low single digits within next one to two quarters after one-time step-up
items.quote: Once they are in place - which we expect within the next one to two quarters - we expect subsequent cost growth to return to our historical levels, which have been in the low single digits.

items.statement: Expect FY27 to show impact of investments in improved growth rates and expanded market share
items.quote: Overall, we have a strong set of growth initiatives in place, and we expect financial year FY27 to start showing the impact of these investments, both in terms of improved growth rates and expanded market share across our key segments.

items.statement: Global tech funding for 2026 on track to be highest in decade driven by mega AI rounds
items.quote: Total dollars invested in the private markets are rising - global tech funding for 2026 is on track to become the highest in the decade, driven primarily by mega AI rounds.

items.statement: Deal volume at 10-year low both in India and internationally
items.quote: Deal volume, however, is at a 10-year low, both in India and internationally.

items.statement: Global M&A rebound stronger, 2026 could be second-highest year after 2021 peak
items.quote: On global M&A, the rebound is much stronger: 2026 continues with very good momentum, and the current run-rate suggests this year could become the second-highest year after the 2021 peak, both in terms of global M&A deal value and IB advisory fees.

items.statement: No margin expansion in Q2 due to growth investments; historically convert up to 80% of incremental revenue to incremental EBITDA
items.quote: Q2 we did not see margin expansion because we are investing in growth. But historically, as Tracxn Technologies Limited – Q2 FY27 Earnings Call Transcript 2 soon as growth accelerates, margins improve quickly - we have converted as high as 80% of incremental revenue into incremental EBITDA

items.statement: Deferred revenue at end of Q2 FY27 was 38.1 crore, up 9% year-on-year
items.quote: Deferred revenue at the end of Q2 FY27 was 38.1 crore, a 9% year-on-year increase.

items.statement: Completed most of sales team expansion, onboarded nearly 56 of 60 planned closing-sales members by September 2026
items.quote: We are pleased to share that we completed most of this expansion as of September 2026 - we have onboarded nearly 56 of the 60 planned closing-sales team members.

items.statement: Sales and marketing now nearly 30% of total headcount, up from 25% same quarter last year
items.quote: Sales and marketing today account for nearly 30% of total headcount, up from 25% in the same quarter last year - a meaningful shift towards sales-led growth.

items.statement: India ASP about half of international geographies
items.quote: A lot of the growth also happened in India, where the ASP is about half of what it is in international geographies.

items.statement: Launched Tracxn MCP for AI tools listed on Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces, AI Assistant on platform, and agentic workflows combining in-house data with Tracxn data
items.quote: The Tracxn MCP is now listed on the Claude and ChatGPT marketplaces, and it also works with tools like Gemini and Cursor; we've also enabled faster responses and lower token consumption.

items.statement: Launched coverage of stealth companies, Talent Signals, estimated revenues for private companies, valuations of historical M&A deals, expanded headcount data to 3.4M entities, UK private-company financials to 5.2M entities (16x since March
items.quote: One that recently went live is our coverage of stealth companies - something clients had been consistently asking for, to source early-stage deals before their public launch - and this is already showing good early results.

items.statement: Customer accounts grew 13% YoY to 2,419; users grew 16% YoY to 6,854; all reported accounts are paid
items.quote: We closed September 2026 at 2,419 accounts, a 13% year-on-year increase. The number of users reached 6,854, a 16% year-on-year increase.

items.statement: 49% accounts from investment industry, 45% corporates, remainder others; top 5 markets by accounts: India, US, UK, Singapore, Germany
items.quote: At the end of Q2, 49% of our accounts were from the investment industry - primarily private-market investors such as venture capital funds, private equity funds, investment banks, family offices, accelerators and incubators. 45% were corporates - primarily corporate development, M&A, innovation, strategy and sales teams, as well as consulting companies.

items.statement: Strategy to become best-in-class in each segment within few quarters to gain market share quickly against larger platforms like CB Insights and Harmonic
items.quote: Even against the larger platforms, you basically have to become best-in-class in that segment, and I don't think that's a long process - probably just a few quarters - and you are able to start gaining market share very quickly as soon as that happens.

items.statement: 48% of H1 FY27 revenue from outside India; customers in over 50 countries
items.quote: In terms of geographical split, 48% of H1 FY27 revenue was from outside India. We have customers spanning over 50 countries, and our top five markets by customer accounts are India, US, UK, Singapore and Germany.

items.statement: FCF for H1 FY27 was negative 6.1 crore; cash and cash equivalents nearly 86 crore
items.quote: FCF for H1 FY27 was negative 6.1 crore, and cash and cash equivalents stood at nearly 86 crore.

items.statement: Investment banking vertical India revenue grew 11% QoQ (annualised run-rate well over 40%), gained ~1% incremental market share monthly for last 12 months
items.quote: If you look at the last quarter, Q2, this segment's revenue grew 11% on a QoQ basis - an annualised run-rate of well over 40%, up from the roughly 20% growth rate we saw last financial year.

items.statement: India revenue grew nearly 7% QoQ (annualised run-rate ~30%); H1 FY27 India revenue grew nearly 20%
items.quote: This quarter, Q2, India grew nearly 7% on a QoQ basis, which is an annualised run-rate of 30%.

items.statement: Corporate sales India revenue grew nearly 23% year-on-year in Q2
items.quote: Corporate sales, for instance, serves the sales teams of large corporates for business-development use cases, and in this segment India revenue grew nearly 23% year-on-year in Q2.

items.statement: Plan to nearly double closing-sales team from 34 at beginning of 2026 to around 60 by end of December 2026
items.quote: We set out at the beginning of the year with a plan to nearly double our closing-sales team, from 34 at the beginning of 2026 to around 60 by the end of December this year.

items.statement: One-time cost step-up from investments in data and sales across international business units; expect cost growth to normalize in 1-2 quarters
items.quote: These investments have also led to a one-time cost step-up. Once they are in place - which we expect within the next one to two quarters - we expect subsequent cost growth to return to our historical levels, which have been in the low single digits.

items.statement: Organic search traffic over 17M visits in H1 FY27, current run-rate nearly 30M; Tracxn Lite crossed ~350K user sign-ups; press mentions over 2,100 in H1 FY27, grew 30% QoQ
items.quote: First, organic search traffic: we continue to see high and increasing volumes, with over 17 million visits during the first half of the year, and the current run-rate is nearly 30 million.

items.statement: U.S. Safeguard Section 201 measure on quartz surfaces effective 15 Aug 2026 with 25% additional duty on ~13M sqm quota and 50% above quota, tapering to 19%-47% by year 4; India and UAE not exempt
items.quote: Effective 15th August 2026, the measure will remain in place for 4 years through tariff quota. In the first year, the import of approximately 13 million square meters will attract an additional duty of 25% while the volumes above the quota will attract a tariff of 50%.

items.statement: Export revenue ~96% of total; US market ~72% of India's quartz exports; no exemption from US safeguard duties for India or UAE
items.quote: Our revenue mix remains export-oriented while export contributing to approximately 96% and domestic market around 4%.

items.statement: Raw material prices up 25%-50% translating to ~10% average selling price impact; freight cost on imported raw materials increased nearly 5x
items.quote: Prices of certain raw materials increased by 25% to 50% translating into estimated average impact of around 10 % on selling prices. In addition, the freight cost on imported raw materials increased nearly 5 folds.

items.statement: Unable to pass on most cost increases to customers; absorbed majority of cost; passed on only certain freight cost via FOB terms
items.quote: See, overall if you see the pricing, we have not been able to pass on much of the cost to the customer. Most of the cost at this point of time is already being absorbed by the company.

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 2.17% vs 12.69% in Q1 FY27 and -6.65% in Q2 FY26; H1 EBITDA margin 7.66% vs 3.42% in H1 FY26 (+424 bps)
items.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 1.3 crores compared with an EBITDA loss of Rs. 3.6 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. The EBITDA margin was 2.17% compared with a negative margin of 6.65% in Q2 FY’26 and 12.69% in Q1 FY’27.

items.statement: Targets quarterly revenue run-rate of Rs 70-80 crore; realistic timeline Q4 FY27 if geopolitical situation stabilizes
items.quote: But I mean, if we talk about more realistic terms, then let's put it as Q4.

items.statement: H1 volume ~1/3 of annual capacity (~1.14M sqm); already at cash break-even; expects profitability to increase dramatically with better utilization once geopolitical situation stabilizes
items.quote: So, we are already at cash break-even. We are not making any cash losses in H1. And so, if you are seeing, the utilization level is already highlighted in the speech. So, once the geopolitical situation stabilizes, we are able to utilize our capacities in a better manner, we see the profitability increasing dramatically from here.

items.statement: Marquartz selling price 20%-30% higher than regular products; expects volumes to grow further; domestic launch ~70% from India factory, 30%-35% from UAE
items.quote: The average selling price of marquartz from a regular product category, it is, the selling price is up by about 20 % to 30 %.

items.statement: Board approved conversion of AED 3M (USD 10.86M ~Rs 110.44 cr) unsecured loan to Global Surfaces FZE into equity on 10 Aug 2026; reclassified as advance towards equity subscription pending ODI/FEMA filings
items.quote: The B oard on the recommendation of the Audit Committee approved the conversion on 10th August, AED 3 million USD10.86 million aggregating and equivalent to approximately Rs. 110.44 crores

items.statement: Receivables rose Rs 17 cr since March due to dispatch disruptions in March and May; expects normalization by end of Q3 FY27 (90-150 day turnaround)
items.quote: So, the reason why the receivables rose by Rs. 17 crores are because of the geopolitical situation. We had a disruption in the month of March and May. So literally in March and May, the dispatches were really not there.

items.statement: ~70%-75% of H1 operating cash flow came from higher payables (approximate)
items.quote: I believe about 70%-75% H1 revenue came from higher payables.

items.statement: Majority of loan to FZE already converted to equity; conversion process 2-3 months; financial effect immediate
items.quote: Majority of the loan is already converted to equity. And the process time for conversion of the loan will be approximately 2 months to 3 months. But it is already, since the approval is already done, it is already, it's with immediate effect.

items.statement: H1 FY27 revenue Rs 125 cr (-2.6% YoY); EBITDA Rs 9.6 cr (2.2x YoY); EBITDA margin 7.66% (+424 bps); PAT loss Rs 5.3 cr vs Rs 5.1 cr loss in H1 FY26
items.quote: For the first half of FY’27, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 125 crores, marginally lower by 2.6 % on year -on-year basis. EBITDA, however, more than doubled to Rs. 9.6 crores from Rs. 4.4 crores in H1 FY ’26 and EBITDA margin improving by 424 basis points to 7.66 % from 3.42% .

items.statement: Building domestic presence in India via expanded marketing team and dealer network launch in Q3 FY27; domestic dispatches commenced Nov 2026
items.quote: We have also strengthened domestic market presence in India through expanded marketing team and commencement of domestic dispatches from November 2026.

items.statement: Near-term operating environment challenging due to US trade measures uncertainty and regional geopolitical situations inflating input and trade costs
items.quote: Looking ahead, the near -term operating environment is expected to remain challenging particularly given the uncertainty around the U.S. trade measures and regional geopolitical situations related to inflated input and trade costs.

items.statement: Expects H2 FY27 EBITDA margin around 15% despite Q3 impact from HPHT allocation changes
items.quote: Having said that, we remain confident of maintaining an EBITDA margin of around 15% for H2.

items.statement: Volume growth may moderate slightly from earlier 12% target but profit contribution will exceed expectations
items.quote: As of now, we don't expect this to surpass what we said to you earlier. There may be some slight moderation in the volume, but profit side, it will be a good contribution beyond your expectation.

items.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 646 bps YoY to 16.5%
items.quote: The EBITDA margin expanded by 646 basis points to 16.5%.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 388 bps YoY to 14.2%
items.quote: EBITDA margins also expanded by 388 basis points to 14.2%.

items.statement: EBITDA per SCM increased to INR 7.73 in Q2 FY27 from INR 4.89 in Q2 FY26
items.quote: EBITDA per S CM increased to 7.73 from 4.89 in Q2 FY26.

items.statement: H1 FY27 total sales volume grew 10% YoY to 120.16 MMSCM; CNG up 23%, commercial PNG up 61%
items.quote: H1 FY27 volume grew by 10% to 120.16 MMSCM. Growth was primarily driven by CNG and commercial PNG, which grew 23% and 61% respectively, during H1FY27

items.statement: Q2 FY27 volume reached all-time high of 61.23 MMSCM, up 12% YoY
items.quote: During Q2 FY27, total sales volume reached all-time high to 61.23 MMSCM, up by 12% YoY.

items.statement: Namakkal & Trichy volume share increased from 6% in FY26 to 11% in H1 FY27
items.quote: This contribution from Namakkal & Trichy has increased from approximately 6% from the total volume in FY26 to 11% now in this H1 FY27.

items.statement: FY27 capex plan of INR 250-260 crore on track; INR 111 crore spent in H1 (INR 54 crore Q1, INR 57 crore Q2)
items.quote: Overall company has taken up INR 250-260 crores to be spent in this financial year. And we are already progressing well as planned. We may even surpass this plan, but we assure you that this is on track and will be met through.

items.statement: INR 137.08 crore of IPO proceeds remain for Namakkal & Trichy network development
