items.statement: Yarn capacity utilisation improved to 84% in Q2 FY27 vs 81% YoY and 70% QoQ
items.quote: Our capacity utilization improved to 84% during this quarter compared to 81% in quarter 2 FY26 and 70% in the preceding quarter.

items.statement: Fabric capacity utilisation improved to 82% in Q2 FY27 vs 77% YoY; H1 FY27 at 81% vs 73% YoY
items.quote: Capacity utilization has improved to 82% from 77% in the corresponding last year. And for H1 FY27, our capacity utilization stood at 81% as compared to 73%.

items.statement: Garment capacity utilisation at 74% in H1 FY27 vs 78% YoY; installed capacities fully utilised given available labour and full order book
items.quote: So capacities, the installed capacities are fully utilized at the moment in the sense when I say fully utilized to the extent that we have available labor on the machines and the order book is completely full.

items.statement: Surat garment facility expected to be de-notified by Jan-Feb and operational by Q1 next fiscal year (April)
items.quote: So we are still in the process of getting our customs NOC. We are in an SEZ. So we expect that should be possibly complete by November end. So as I said before in the last call, we're probably on target to bring that live by first quarter of next financial year, let's say, by April.

items.statement: Healthy order book in both garments and fabrics; Q3 FY27 order visibility encouraging
items.quote: The second half is typically stronger for our business, and we do expect that the demand and our order book position, which is already a very healthy order book, both in garments and fabrics, will support this performance.

items.statement: Garment division has strong order book particularly in jackets; order pipeline from new EU/UK clients like C&A (INR5 cr this year, INR20 cr+ next year) and Reserved
items.quote: However, on the product front, our order book remains strong and particularly in jackets, we have a strong order book.

items.statement: Domestic textile sector seeing gradual improvement in production and domestic order activity; broader manufacturing environment encouraging
items.quote: During quarter 2 FY27, the Indian textile sector witnessed a gradual improvement in production levels and domestic order activity. The broader manufacturing environment also remained encouraging and our capacity utilization improved during the quarter, indicating resilience in the underlying demand environment.

items.statement: Structural shift toward man-made fibres and blended fabrics offers significant growth opportunity; India's penetration low vs global share
items.quote: We believe this structural shift represents a significant growth opportunity for the Indian textile manufacturers and especially Banswara Syntex. Globally, synthetic and blended fabrics account for a substantially higher share of clothing consumption, part icularly in segments such as sportswear, formal wear and fast fashion, whereas India's penetration in these segments is relatively low

items.statement: UK and EU FTAs providing boost to export garment business; seeing increasing demand and interest in India as sourcing destination
items.quote: We are also seeing increasing demand and increasing interest in India as a destination given the free trade agreements. And looking ahead, the U.K. and EU free trade agreements have provided us an additional boost to our export business, and we are looking forward to even stronger demand in the rest of the year.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 10.2% from 9.1% in Q1; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 9.7% vs 8.5% YoY
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin increased by 23.9% quarter -on-quarter to INR36.5 crores, (Wrongly said, this should be read as , Our EBITDA increased by 23.9% quarter -on-quarter to INR36.5 crores) with the EBITDA margin improving to 10.2% from 9.1% in quarter 1.

items.statement: Margin improvement driven by better realisations and higher value-added product contribution; stretch yarn internal consumption up 150 tons/month to 450-500 tons/month
items.quote: This improvement was driven by better realizations and a higher contribution from value-added products.

items.statement: Expect to pass on raw material cost increases in H2 FY27 to support margin target
items.quote: So what you're going to see now in the next half of the year unfolding is hopefully our ability to pass on this. And that is why we're still maintaining our overall prediction that we have made for the year.

items.statement: Polyester prices increased 25-30% due to West Asia crisis and oil price increases; PTA and MEG prices also up; freight costs increased exorbitantly
items.quote: Our polyester prices have increased by 25% to 30%.

items.statement: Raw material price increases not fully passed on to customers yet across yarn, fabric and garment divisions; lag in pass-through
items.quote: The point is, Nirbhay ji, here that the amount of raw material price increase, we have not been able to pass on fully to the customers yet. This is still happening in yarn and in fabric and in garment. There is always a delay between the prices increasing and what we are able to pass on.

items.statement: Focus on value-added products over volume; stretch product sales in fabrics up 30-40% YoY; internal yarn consumption now ~40% of production
items.quote: We have increased the sale of our stretch products significantly in our fabrics. And this has gone up by almost about 30%- 40% as compared to last year. So we are consuming almost now stretch yarns about 450 to 500 tons per month internally, which used to be only at the level of about 300 tons, has increased by about 150 tons per month.

items.statement: Onboarded C&A (UK) with INR5 cr pipeline this year, INR20 cr+ potential next year; onboarding Reserved (Poland, 300-400 stores); in process of onboarding Marks & Spencer; Next already onboarded in UK
items.quote: Happy to say C&A now is fully on board, and we can see an order pipeline already of about INR5 crores, which we will execute in this year. And next year, the potential is to definitely go INR20 crores plus. So that's just from one customer, which is C&A.

items.statement: UK garment business currently ~INR20 cr, expected to more than double next year with new client wins
items.quote: So we should have from our current levels of about INR20 crores where we are getting in garment business in the U.K., we expect that to more than double next year.

items.statement: India synthetic textile players compete with China; India has monopolistic fibre supply situation but still capturing market share with better margins
items.quote: We are among the major players in the synthetic part, which we have to compete very effectively against China. And we have a monopolistic situation here in terms of the fiber supply. So in spite of that, we are doing fairly well, and I think we will be able to capture more market share with better margin.

items.statement: Europe biggest growth opportunity due to EU FTA expected operational by June-July next year; UK FTA already operational; Japan and others with existing FTAs also growing
items.quote: I would say the biggest growth opportunity is actually going to come from Europe because the FTA is expected to come into operation maybe by June or July of next year, for sure. And already, the orders and the interest from the customers is the most

items.statement: Export orders facing vessel availability and logistical challenges; freight costs increased exorbitantly
items.quote: Our customers do face some challenges due to vessel availability and logistical challenges. However, on the product front, our order book remains strong and particularly in jackets, we have a strong order book.

items.statement: Net debt increased INR43.28 cr in H1 FY27 to INR515 cr due to working capital requirements from raw material price increases
items.quote: Our net debt stood at INR515 crores as of 30th September 2026. This has increased by INR43.28 crores during the first half, primarily due to the working capital requirements, and this is a consequence of the raw material prices increasing as well, that has been one of the major factors.

items.statement: Focus on reducing slow-moving yarn inventory, improving debtor position and reducing cycle time to bring down working capital gradually each year
items.quote: To improve the total working capital, we have to improve on 3 levels, and this is on our inventory management, which is what we are saying that slow -moving inventories need to be pushed out faster, which we are already working on very seriously at all 3 fro nts and expect to see some improvements here.

items.statement: Garment division revenue target INR360-380 cr for FY27; with Surat facility, pathway to INR550-600 cr over next 2 years
items.quote: We should close the year between INR360 crores to INR380 crores of sale overall on garment this year, which would be a growth from last year. And if Surat can be on board next year, we should be on target to add another INR75 crores to INR100 crores turnover additional in the following year.

items.statement: Surat facility to add INR150-200 cr top line over 2 years once fully operational
items.quote: So Surat once it's fully operational, Surat will give us an additional top line of INR150 crores to INR200 crores, which will take about 2 years to fully operationalize.

items.statement: European/UK garment client margins expected at 12-15%
items.quote: And the margins within those businesses and geographies should be between 12% to 15%

items.statement: Near-term challenges: raw material price volatility from geopolitical environment, power cost increases, freight cost escalation, vessel availability issues, lag in cost pass-through
items.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face some near -term challenges for raw material price volatility due to the geopolitical environment. We have had an increase in the polyester prices because of the West Asia challenges.

items.statement: Design & Build annual revenue growth target of 50-60% for FY27
items.quote: we have set a target of 50 to 60%, and that is a target that we all are geared up to achieve. The kind of order book that we already have in place right now really support that claim that we are making that we will certainly be able to achieve our targeted growth of 50 to 60% under the Design & Build vertical.

items.statement: Design & Build order book exceeds 300 crores supporting FY27 growth target
items.quote: that is primarily because of the kind of order book that we already have, which is more than 300 crores plus. And I think that both the next quarters, that is quarter 3 and quarter 4 would be really promising for this particular vertical, and we will certainly be able to achieve targets.

items.statement: Leasing vertical target margins: corporate level 25%, center level 30%
items.quote: on a corporate level, with regards to the Leasing vertical, we'll be able to make at 25%, while at center level, we'll be able to make 30%

items.statement: Design & Build vertical target margin 18-22%
items.quote: while on the Design & Build, we'll be able to make between 18% to 22%.

items.statement: Furniture Manufacturing target margin 24-25% at optimal capacity
items.quote: And at Furniture Manufacturing at an optimal manufacturing capacity, again, around 24%, 25%.

items.statement: Leasing occupancy maintained at 90%+ across portfolio with committed capacity additions
items.quote: we generally have more than 90% plus occupancy acros s. And the occupancy has always been stabilized and improving positively and maintain at 90% quarter on quarter and year on year

items.statement: Asset sale and leaseback transaction with Sanvritti Alpha generated 39-40% return on capital
items.quote: we generated around 3 9 to 40% on return on capital on these transactions. So this is a very important part of our strategy where we are monetizing an asset and also this would enable us to reduce our debt

items.statement: Ultrafresh Modular Solutions acquired via 54 crore share swap at 1.49x FY26 revenue
items.quote: the acquisition that we carried out, in fact, was at about 1.49 times of their FY26 revenue. So in that sense, the acquisition was fairly justified.

items.statement: Ultrafresh acquisition adds 160+ touch points in Tier 2/3 cities and Nalagarh manufacturing facility
items.quote: Also, it gave us access to the network that they have created through more than 160 touch points that they have across the Tier 2, Tier 3 cities in India.

items.statement: Proposed demerger separates asset-light leasing and Design & Build into listed EFC (I) Ltd, owned property assets remain in EFC Ltd subsidiary
items.quote: Under the proposed arrangement, the leased premises managed office operation will be housed within EFC (I) Limited, that is a standalone listed company, while the owned property operation will remain within EFC Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary of EFC (I) Limited.

items.statement: Design & Build working capital cycle 60-120 days with 5% retention typical
items.quote: we are certainly be able to kind of, number one, like I said, maintain the working capital cycles of anything around about 90 days to 120 days because that is the time the entire projects get realized not just from the milestones point of view, but also the retention, which are generally around 5% of the total project value.

items.statement: Arm's length pricing enforced via internal competition and Big 4 validation for inter-company transactions
items.quote: they have to compete with the other 2, other 3, I mean, suppliers who will also give their quotations and pricing. And once obviously, the L1, the best quotation will always bring the order. So, this is very clear that we have a very transparent way of operations where arm's length pricing is established through big four financial institute big four accounting firms who really helps us in setting

items.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue 332 crores (+30% YoY), EBITDA 134 crores (+21% YoY), PAT 77 crores (+36% YoY)
items.quote: Our consolidated revenue from operations stood at 332 crores compared with approximately 255 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, representing a year-on-year growth of 30%. Our EBITDA stood at approxima tely 134 crores, registering a year -on-year growth of 21%, while our profit after tax increased to approximately 77 crores compared with 57 crores in the corresponding quarter last year,

items.statement: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue 650 crores (+30% YoY), EBITDA 257 crores, PAT 148 crores (+43% YoY), EPS 10.11
items.quote: For H1 FY27 we reported consolidated revenue of approximately 650 crores compared with 474 crores in the corresponding period last year, representing growth of approxi mately 30%. Our EBITDA increased from approximately 213 crores to 257 crores, while profit after tax increased from approximately 103 crores to 148 crores

items.statement: Leasing Q2 revenue 168 crores (+30% YoY), H1 revenue 322 crores
items.quote: During Q2 FY27, the Leasing segment reported revenue of approximately 168 crores compa red with 129 crores in Q2 FY26, representing growth of approximately 30%. For H1 FY27, Leasing revenue stood at approximately 322 crores compared with 252 crores in corresponding period last year

items.statement: Design & Build Q2 revenue 129 crores (+16% YoY), H1 revenue 230 crores
items.quote: This segment reported revenue of approximately 129 crore during the quarter compared with 112 crore in the corresponding quarter last year, representing growth of approximately 16%. For the firs t half, revenue stood at approximately 230 crore compared with 196 crore in H1 FY26

items.statement: Furniture Manufacturing Q2 revenue 35 crores (+149% YoY), H1 revenue 63 crores
items.quote: Our Furniture segment reported revenue of approximately 35 crores in quarter 2 FY27 compared to 14 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, representing growth of approximately 149%. For H1 FY27, revenue stood at approximately 63 crores compared with 27 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Material and services price increases pressured Q2 margins but annualized margins expected to hold
items.quote: also naturally, this quarter, in particular, there has been quite substantial increase in the prices of materials, prices of different services that has been availed. And that obviously has contributed a little bit of pressure. But like I said, on an overall basis, we'll certainly be able to maintain those margin levels

items.statement: Asset monetization via sale and leaseback reduces debt and generates capital returns
items.quote: when we acquire this property, we take these properties on LRD or LAP structure. And then when we create value, we are not able to just kind of get rid of that asset-backed debt, but also create this value, which we are able to do through the asset sale and leaseback of these properties that we acquire.

items.statement: All three verticals on track for FY27 annual targets; Design & Build H2 execution expected to accelerate
items.quote: all the 3 verticals, which is Leasing vertical, which is Furniture vertical, and Design & Build vertical, are fairly on track in terms of achieving the targets. Let's say, the Leasing vertical has already achieved the numbers that it is targeted to achieve on a proportionate basis. And the same is the case with Furniture vertical as well.

items.statement: Integrated model across leasing, design & build, furniture creates competitive advantage vs single-vertical peers
items.quote: At EFC, we are bringing capabilities from this different business vertical together. This allow us to offer customers a more comprehensive solutions, gives us opportunity to improve efficiency across the group.

items.statement: Furniture strategy targets institutional, commercial, residential, projects and export segments
items.quote: we have kind of captured across the commercial place, Design & Build and also supplying different types of furniture products, whether it is for residential purposes, commercial purposes, projects, exports and so and so forth.

items.statement: Enterprise and GCC demand shifting toward flexible, managed workspace solutions with multi-location support
items.quote: Large enterprises and GCCs are increasingly looking for partners who can offer not only quality office infrastructure, but also flexibility, consistent services and ability to support their expansion across locations.

items.statement: Proposed demerger scheme filed with NCLT, confident of approval
items.quote: the proposed scheme remains subject to applicable approvals and implementation requirements, but we are very confident that the proposal will soon go through the NCLT, receive the NCLT approvals.

items.statement: Ultrafresh share swap issued EFC shares at Rs 270 fair value per Big 4 valuation
items.quote: the share swap was carried o ut where the EFC shares was also valued at a price of Rupees 270 per share, which is the fair value that was arrived at by the big four valuation agencies

items.statement: Quarterly margin variations expected due to project execution timing differences
items.quote: except for the quarters, which in a quarterly basis, it may kind of go up and down primarily because of there are differences in the project execution cycles, project expenses that has to be incurred and those timing differences may kind of bringing a bit of variations in the margins.

items.statement: Apollo Cash has disbursed over 65 crores and 1.6 lakh loans since launch with 5 lakh+ app downloads
items.value: 65 crores disbursed, 1.6 lakh loans, 5 lakh+ downloads
items.quote: So I think we've already disbursed almost 65-plus odd crores, almost 1.6 lakh total number of loans disbursed, 5 lakh plus downloads, and, you know, many more happening every single day.

items.statement: Monthly disbursement run-rate is 20-22 crores with headroom to double or triple without external capital
items.quote: I think, for us, given the traction that we are at right now, about, you know, I think 20- 22-odd crores of lending which is happening roughly every single month in this space, we have a bit of headroom.

items.statement: Engineering team grew 3X in one quarter; tech team now 43% of total headcount and growing
items.quote: In fact, our engineering team alone, in just one quarter, has grown 3X. Now, we all know our DNA is tech, so this tech mix will show up eventually.

items.statement: Hired Head of Marketing Swaujas Chatterjee from fintech; Head of Engineering expected next quarter; all senior hires have 5+ years digital lending experience
items.quote: We're also expecting our Head of Engineering to join us soon, so maybe in the subsequent quarter, here on the earnings call, you will get to know more about the lead hire there as well.

items.statement: Provisions made to borrow ~100 crores from debt market; leverage near zero with room to scale before tapping lenders in a couple of quarters
items.quote: I think we've already made provisions for, you know, our ability to borrow about 100-odd crores from the debt market, if required, to some degree or the other.

items.statement: Apollo Cash revenue (processing fees, interest) now landing fully on own books vs partnership model, driving P&L uplift
items.quote: So, one of the structural advantages that we have with Apollo Cash versus, you know, the partnership business that we've been doing for a few years now, is that here, the processing fee and the interest and, you know, every line of revenue which is coming from the customer is landing on our book.

items.statement: Targeting 10x scale from current levels over coming quarters to a year; focusing on platform security, underwriting v2, and marketing efficiency before spend
items.quote: Our goal is to go, you know, 10x from here in a reasonable amount of time over the coming quarters and a year or so, right?

items.statement: Loan tenures of 3-6 months currently, exploring 9-12 months; early repayment common but may reduce with larger tickets
items.quote: Typically, when we give out loans to our borrowers, right, I think we do 3 months and 6 months, and, you know, potentially we will be exploring 9 months and 12 months as well.

items.statement: Next underwriting model version aims for better approval rates, significantly better risk rates, and smarter loan allocation using Apollo Cash-specific data
items.quote: Number one, have better approval rates. Number two, to definitely have significantly better risk rates. And finally, smarter loan amount allocation, where we are getting much better at identifying higher quality customers and giving them the loan amount that they deserve.

items.statement: 60x scale-up in 6-7 months since Feb 2026 launch with zero paid marketing; strong product-market fit indicated
items.quote: So, I think just in a matter of 6-7 months, there's been a scale-up of almost 60X.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target INR4,300-4,500 crore; H2 needs INR2,580 crore after H1 INR1,722 crore
items.quote: On our last cal l, we indicated that the financial year 2027, our revenue will be INR4,300 crores to INR4,500 crores. We are still standing by with that number

items.statement: EBITDA margin band 11-13% until polymer plant commissioning; 14-16% thereafter
items.quote: So EBITDA margins will always remain between 11% to 13%. Once our polymer gets on stream by December 2027, in the next year we will like to give you a band of 14% to 16%.

items.statement: Tax shield from carry-forward losses lasts until Q1 FY29; normal tax expected from then
items.quote: As on 31st March, our carry-forward loss was INR1,432 crores, Right? Going forward, the manner in which we are growing and the projections we have done, I think quarter 1 of 2029 we will have to start paying tax.

items.statement: Firm order book INR3,735 crore at quoted value (~INR4,300 crore at current prices); H1 inflow INR2,217 crore, book-to-bill 1.29x
items.quote: Our firm order book at 30th September stands at INR3,735 crores at quoted value and around INR4,300 crores at current market prices under the price variation clause.

items.statement: INR32,000 crore live enquiries for MV and EHV cables to be finalised in next 90 days
items.quote: We have presently INR32,000 crores worth of enquiries which are live to be finalized in the next 90 days by various customers across the country.

items.statement: Data centre cable revenue target INR750 crore in FY27 from existing orders; scanning 66 cities, 230+ developers
items.quote: In the current year, we are expecting to do INR750 crores out of our top line from data centre customers, for which we already have the orders from there.

items.statement: Building 1,000 km/month single-core 3.3 kV solar cable plant, commissioning in 18 months
items.quote: Demand from solar parks is strong enough that we are building a 1,000 kilometre a month single-core 3.3 kV cable plant which will get on stream in the next 18 months.

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 12.9% (up 240 bps YoY); contribution margin fell to 16.9% from 18.7% due to higher LME aluminium inflating revenue base
items.quote: EBITDA including other income was INR133 crores, up 189%, at a margin of 12.9%.

items.statement: EHV cables carry 5-6% margin premium over MV and ~10% over LV cables
items.quote: So the differential is usually 5% to 6% between a medium voltage and EHV cable and almost 10% between an LV and EHV cable.

items.statement: Data centre cables earn at least 2% extra margin due to stringent pre-qualification entry barriers
items.quote: So obviously there is a entry barrier there. So this entry barr ier leaves at least 2% extra margin for you

items.statement: Total incremental capex ~INR366 crore across 6-7 projects focused on margin improvement, not volume expansion
items.quote: whatever additional amount of capex we are doing, which is broadly around INR366 crores over six, seven projects. They are all projects aimed at increasing the margin, right?

items.statement: Current capacity utilisation ~45% of fully commissioned balancing equipment level
items.quote: So capacity utilization is approximately 45% of what it will be when the entire balancing equipment is operationalized.

items.statement: Served ~670 customers in H1; key wins: Adani Electricity Mumbai, GETCO 66 kV, PGVCL INR1,370 crore 11 kV coastal underground, TBCB AL59 supply
items.quote: We served around 670 customers in the first half of 2027 across utilities, EPC players, data centres in the industry.

items.statement: Export cables: aluminium for Africa, copper for Europe/US markets
items.quote: If you are targeting Africa, it is aluminium cable. If you are targeting Europe and US, it is copper cables.

items.statement: Finance cost INR12 crore is LC discounting/bank charges on higher volumes, not debt cost; lender NOCs in process; fresh bank lines being tied up
items.quote: The INR12 crore s of finance cost you see in this quarter is almost entirely LC discounting and bank charges on a much larger volume of business, a cost of trade, not, not an actual debt

items.statement: QIP July 2026 raised INR1,614 crore to meet minimum public shareholding requirement
items.quote: The QIP in July, we completed and raised INR1,614 crores entirely due to the fact that we have to bring down our minimum shareholding.

items.statement: Conductor volume growth: 6,850 km dispatched in Q2; real volume growth 60-70% YoY excluding metal price impact
items.quote: On actual production, kilometres of cables and tons of conductors made and dispatched, our growth is well above 60% to 70% year-on-year basis. Conductor dispatches were 6,850 kilometres in the quarter.

items.statement: Polymer backward integration expected to add INR120 crore EBITDA at current volumes (margin >INR50/kg on 84,500 tpa capacity); 30% post-tax IRR
items.quote: Presently, we have certain data which tells us that in this compound, the margin is more than INR50 a kg. And at our current volumes, this will really leave an additional EBITDA of INR120 crores when we use it on a captive consumption basis.

items.statement: First-mover advantage: 11 MV cable lines already operational vs peers' 2-3 year lead time; polymer plant will be 6th of its kind globally for super-clean XLPE
items.quote: I'm sure there are competitors who are going to add the line. They will take two, three years to reach the number I already have. And by that time, I would have doubled my numbers.

items.statement: New COO (Ashwani Saraf) and CFO (Kundip Thakker) onboarded; succession planning and director's office established for next-gen leadership over 5-7 years
items.quote: We have a new Chief Operating Officer and a new CFO, both of whom have a fantastic industry experience. We have now started working on succession planning and a director's office has been made so that in the next five to seven years, we get our Gen Next to come on board.

items.statement: Key risk: geopolitical/government policy risk in infrastructure sector; but management sees geopolitical risk as positive for new energy demand
items.quote: every business has a risk, especially when it comes to infrastructure business, which is the power, road, or businesses which at the end of the day are 60%, 70% dominated by government or controlled by government, there is always a geopolitical risk which is associated.

items.statement: Sustainable gross margin around 55-56%
items.quote: You can take it around 55%, 56%.

items.statement: Footwear volume growth 5-10% yearly
items.quote: That will be nearly 5% to 10% on a yearly basis.

items.statement: Export general expected to continue double-digit growth
items.quote: And further, we are expecting it will continue to improve in double digit.

items.statement: Topline growth around 20% expected to continue in coming quarters
items.quote: It should remain continued, and we are also expecting better than -- in coming quarters, you will see even better than this.

items.statement: U.S. automotive market weak for last 2 quarters; customers not buying new cars; OEMs revised projections
items.quote: Basically, market is not responding well in U.S. for last 2 quarters. And the customers are not going for buying the new cars. Therefore, the automotive companies have revised their projections.

items.statement: Export OEM volume Y-o-Y not positive due to U.S. market; Q-o-Q 5% growth
items.quote: And the OEM, 13.5% Y-on-Y and 5% on Q-on-Q basis. And export Y-on-Y. in fact, it is not a positive growth, volume because of certain reasons of U.S. market.

items.statement: Good OEM supply orders in hand from U.S.; started contributing to export sales; growth momentum expected to continue next 2-3 years
items.quote: And in this context, we have -- as we already informed to you also that we have some good OEM supply orders in our hands from U.S., which we have already started making good contribution to our export sales and revenue and overall business profitability. And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in next 2, 3 years.

items.statement: Export OEM orders from Ford and Chrysler increased from 2 to 5 models
items.quote: In the U.S. We have received the very good amount of orders or quantity, mainly Ford and Chrysler. And customers are same, but they have increased their requirement on other models also. So suppose, earlier, we were supplying materials for 2 models. Now they have given us orders for 5 models.

items.statement: BMW and Mercedes-Benz taking material at near full projections; expected to continue and slightly increase
items.quote: BMW and Mercedes -Benz, they are taking material as per their requirement and they have touched almost full projections. So we are expecting that, that will be continued and a little bit increase.

items.statement: Discussions ongoing with Volkswagen (VW) for U.S. orders; conversion to purchase order takes 2-3 years
items.quote: Other than those, we are also talking and trying to catch them is VW, okay? Volkswagen. But hopefully, because when discussion starts and getting the orders, it takes 2, 3 years.

items.statement: Gross margin fluctuates with raw material and crude oil prices; sustainable around 55-56%
items.quote: Sustainable margin, we have already informed you that a little bit, it is varying because of raw material prices and crude oil prices. So that's why it is -- sometimes, it is going up and sometimes it's going down. Otherwise, the gross margin would be simi lar to what we are showing in the last 2, 3 quarters

items.statement: Consolidated margin higher when consolidated revenue exceeds standalone due to warehouse margin addition
items.quote: Whenever the consol revenue is higher than the stand-alone revenue, definitely, your margin will be higher because percentage will also add in the stand-alone. So that will be improved.

items.statement: Freight costs peaked at COVID levels but declining 20-25% from peak; will pass on only if increase is stable and permanent
items.quote: But now it has gone to a very peak level, which we have seen during COVID. But now it is getting down. And hopefully, in next 2, 3 months, it will be -- I think it has to be a normal level. So this is not stable.

items.statement: Not currently discussing price pass-through with customers as freight costs are declining
items.quote: That's why we are not -- even in this position, see how much impact will be there to talk with the customers to pass on. That's why when the cost is stable and increase is permanent, then we can talk. But right now, we don't.

items.statement: New machinery expected November-December; installation in March quarter; production start Q1
items.quote: The machinery and equipment part is expected in November end and December and we'll try to start installation in March quarter. And hopefully, it will start in Q1.

items.statement: Planning new plant in South India; Mexico plant in pipeline but not concluded
items.quote: Definitely, we are thinking and have plan in mind for setting up the new plant in India, especially in South region. And if we go outside India, then definitely Mexico. And that is in pipeline and not yet concluded.

items.statement: PU capacity utilization at 25%; breakeven at 40%
items.quote: PU, it's not, in fact, generating profit just -- but we are managing because of some tax benefits and all. But still we are operating at 25% capacity utilization. And to get the breakeven, we need to operate at 40%.

items.statement: Focus on automotive exports; domestic footwear less focus due to price competition; footwear volume and value both increased
items.quote: Since as we already discussed in previous quarters that we are more focusing on automotive and especially on export automotive market.
