items.quote: So we should have a 14, 15 lakh kind of a capacity on the IDU side. 15 lakh, 1.5 million, 1.6 million, kind of a number, peak capacity.

items.statement: Strong order book for H2 FY27 with expected optimal capacity utilization across segments
items.quote: The order book looks very encouraging and we should be able to achieve the numbers that we have been talking all along.

items.statement: Commercial refrigeration (deep freezers) seeing strong order book and 70-80% capacity utilization expected in H2
items.quote: In the coming 6 months, we have a very strong order book and we see almost full capacity utilization or at least 70%, 80% or optimal capacity utilization of the existing capacity in commercial refrigeration.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain range-bound at 9-10%; PAT improvement targeted towards 3% net margin
items.quote: EBITDA, we have been consistently saying that will remain range-bound between 9% and 10%. I think, yes, of course, the bottom line, which is PAT, is something that we are very keen on trying to improve.

items.statement: Compressor margins currently lower than other segments due to import competition; expected to improve with backward integration from Q4 FY27
items.quote: compressor for the moment is not giving higher margins because of the simple fact that we are competing with the imported prices. So obviously the margins are lower than what we have in the other

items.statement: Cost pass-through to brands for room ACs expected to be visible in Q3 FY27
items.quote: It's an ongoing process, I think, but the effects of that will start to be visible in Q3.

items.statement: Pass-through ongoing across all products; other products relatively stable in last 6 months
items.quote: Pass-through is happening in all products across. Actually, the price is now for the other products been a little more stable in the last 6 months.

items.statement: AC segment revenue share in Q2 FY27 estimated at 30-40% of overall revenue
items.quote: I think AC in general has been lesser. I think it is between 30% and 40% of the overall.

items.statement: Anchor AC client contributes 40-50% of AC revenue; 3 new clients added (Tier 1 & Tier 2); targeting 1-2 more
items.quote: The anchor client will continue to be about 40% to 50% of the overall number that we will do. Rest of it, we have 3 that we have been able to add, and we hope that we'll be going forward, probably 1 or 2 more get added.

items.statement: Compressor customer additions ongoing; most refrigeration brands buying small quantities initially
items.quote: As far as compressor is concerned, I think that addition is an ongoing process because of the fact that currently we are the only OEM/ODM that is supplying to the market.

items.statement: Inventory built up in H1 FY27 for RAC season; expected to normalize in H2 as season progresses
items.quote: Yes, mostly. It will normalize is what I can say as of now. It will get normalized as we move forward because the season has started.

items.statement: RAC inventory ramped up for season starting October; import allowances expiring Oct-Nov driving build-up
items.quote: And inventory, we have started ramping up inventory for RAC season because October onwards the season starts taking off. And also import allowances on some material are expiring in -- are expiring in November and October.

items.statement: Net debt INR 400 crore including INR 150 crore OCDs from True North in subsidiary VCPL; target debt/equity below 1x
items.quote: Out of the total number that you've spoken about, almost INR 150 crores out of that is in the form of OCD that the subsidiary VCPL has issued. We do have a plan where we would want to replace that with the bank debt.

items.statement: Bank debt at 8.25-8.4% average cost; OCDs to be replaced with bank debt over next 15-16 months
items.quote: Otherwise, the rest of it is all bank debt ranging between 8.25% to 8.4%, the average cost of borrowing.

items.statement: Future equity raises possible if debt reaches saturation while maintaining 30-35% growth; no timeline given
items.quote: As long as we keep looking at a 30%, 35% growth, I think additional capital, external capital will be required. And as I said earlier, that the endeavour has always been to keep the debt equity to below 1 or close to 1.

items.statement: Promoter holding reduced from ~65% to 44% over 2-3 years; no fixed floor for promoter stake, growth prioritized
items.quote: So there's no real number that is there on the minds of the promoters as of now. I think growth of company is paramount, and as time progresses, as the situation unfolds, I think decisions will be taken accordingly.

items.statement: PLI receipts: INR 20 crore expected in Q4 FY27 (accrued quarterly); another INR 20 crore in FY28
items.quote: This year also, we are expecting that Q4 we should receive INR 20 crore which was due for this year. And there's another year left. So the next year we will get INR 20 crores additional.

items.statement: EMS controller content ~INR 3,000 per INR 20,000 AC (50% of BOM); currently partially in-house
items.quote: About INR 3,000 out of a INR 20,000 air conditioner is the cost of EMS. Which we are partially doing in-house and partially buying, but we intend to take most of it in-house once the expanded capacity is live.

items.statement: No new capex planned beyond current commitments; all required capex for peak revenue already invested or tied up
items.quote: No further CapEx, so whatever CapEx has been planned, I think that's there ongoing, and that is what we require as far as our numbers are concerned.

items.statement: Compressor capacity utilization at 70-75% currently (28 lakh capacity); expected to reach 80% in Q3-Q4 FY27
items.quote: Compressors, we are almost at about 70% utilization as we speak, 70%, 75% as of now, and it is expected to touch about 80% as we progress Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: New compressor capacity (60 lakh) expected to run at 40-60% utilization in FY28
items.quote: For that capacity, we are expecting between 40% and 60% kind of a utilization going forward in the year '27-'28.

items.statement: AC additional capacity expected to hit 50-55% utilization in FY28
items.quote: Next year we are anticipating that we should be able to hit a number of around 50%, 55% of capacity utilization on the additional capacity that we have put in place for the year '27-'28.

items.statement: Compressor captive consumption minimal (~1-1.2 lakh of 28 lakh capacity); nearly all sold externally
items.quote: Out of the 28 lakh capacity that we have, I think our capacity, our captive consumption will not exceed maybe let's say about one lakh, 1.2 lakh this year.

items.statement: Compressor backward integration at 10-25% value add currently; targeting 60% within a year
items.quote: Compressors, we are sitting at, depending on the model, between 10% and 25% of value add today, we would want to take it to up to 60% in the next maybe a year or so.

items.statement: AC IDU backward integration at 85-90%; ODU at ~60%; targeting in-house controller boards for IDU
items.quote: IDUs, we are almost 85%, 90% backward integrated. ODUs, we are at about 60% kind of a backward integration. We are looking to expand our backward integration, one in IDU, with the help of having in-house controller boards.

items.statement: Star Eltech Chennai facility on hold due to lessor issues; no new similar arrangements expected this year
items.quote: Star Eltech is currently on hold. It has not progressed from where it was. This is something which is not in our control. This is more to do with the lessors over there.

items.statement: Supply chain improving but not yet at pre-disruption levels; normalizing gradually
items.quote: Supply chain is better than Q4 last year with all the disruptions. But yes, not as smooth as before, but it is getting there. So things are normalizing a little bit.

items.statement: Depreciation expense fell QoQ due to ROU asset reduction from vacating leased warehouse
items.quote: I think it's more to do with the right of use, not because of the depreciation on assets. So, one lease property that we were using, we have -- we've vacated that lease and moved that warehouse in-house because of the new construction.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 presales guidance of INR 5,000 crores; 41% achieved in H1 FY27
items.quote: I'm happy to mention that we've already achieved 41% of our full year presales guidance of INR 5,000 crores in the first half of FY '27.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 collections guidance of INR 3,000-3,100 crores at 70-72% efficiency
items.quote: And the collection should pick up to about INR 3,000 crores to about INR 3,100 crores in the whole of the year of FY '27.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 launch GDV guidance of INR 8,000 crores
items.quote: These are the launches which is planned to take us to the number of about INR 8,000 crores that we have targeted for the current year.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 operating cash flow guidance of INR 700-800 crores
items.quote: But for sure that we feel that INR 700 crores to INR 800 crores of the OCF we should be able to garner for the whole of this year.

items.statement: Strong demand in Luxury and Super Premium segments driving 84% YoY presales growth in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Presales performance is driven by strong momentum from Luxury and Super Premium category and establishes and strengthens our brand recall as a premium developer.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 presales of INR 1,423 crores (highest ever quarterly); H1 FY27 presales of INR 2,041 crores
items.quote: We delivered presales of INR1,423 crores and collections of INR 541 crores in this quarter. This is the highest ever quarterly presales.

items.statement: Q3 FY27 Urbania tower launch with GDV of INR 886 crores; total launches till date ~INR 3,128 crores
items.quote: In Q3 FY '27, we have also launched our tower at Urbania with a GDV of INR 886 crores. With this, till date, we have launched close to GDV INR 3,128 crores of new launches.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded to 14.5% from 7.1% YoY; H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 17.8% vs 8.2% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 14.5% from 7.1% in Q2 FY '26 and PAT grew to INR 101 crores from INR10 crores in Q2 FY '26.

items.statement: Urbania LA Fam tower achieved 16% EBITDA margin on GDV of INR 1,300+ crores
items.quote: we have been able to make the EBITDA margins of 16%. And that is what we have picked up into as a one line item, which is in the PAT number.

items.statement: Embedded EBITDA margin on sold inventory 24%, expected to rise to 33% on unsold inventory driven by Virar JDA project (61% margin on unsold portion)
items.quote: So fundamental ly, that is the one which is driving the EBITDA in the unsold from 24% to 33

items.statement: H1 FY27 construction spend increased 21% YoY to INR 547 crores; ~12 msf under development across 19 projects
items.quote: Our construction spends have increased from INR 452 crores in H1 FY '26 to INR 547 crores in H1 FY '27. This is a 21% growth year-on-year on a half yearly basis.

items.statement: H1 FY27 land and approval investments of INR 425 crores (41% YoY growth); FY27 total expected ~INR 1,000 crores
items.quote: Our land and approval investments in the projects have increased to INR 425 crores in this half year compared to INR 302 crores in H1 FY '26. This reflects a 41% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Completed 4 RERA projects in H1 FY27 (1.39 msf) 9-15 months ahead of RERA timeline
items.quote: We have completed 4 RERA projects in H1 FY '27 with a total construction area of 1.39 million square feet. The projects are completed 9 to 15 months ahead of its RERA time line.

items.statement: Signed contract with Robin Village Development (Tiong Seng subsidiary) for in-house precast plant to enable faster, cleaner construction
items.quote: Very, very happy to announce that we have implemented the innovative construction technology of precast by signing a contract with Robin Village Development, which is a subsidiary of Tiong Seng from Singapore to set up our in-house plant.

items.statement: Commercial foray: 25HQ Prabhadevi (200k sq ft Grade A, lease model); Thane 1.1 msf construction starting FY27; 2030 target INR 10,000 crores commercial portfolio
items.quote: And then Thane, which we've been talking about for quite some time has now come of age, and we should be doing about 1.1 million square feet, construction for which should begin in the financial year.

items.statement: H1 FY27 sales: 93% sustenance (INR 1,900 crores), 7% new launches (INR 140 crores from Ozone Skye)
items.quote: H1 FY '27, except from the Ozone Skye, which is INR 140 crores, the balance is the sustenance sales. So the INR 1,900 crores is the sustenance sales and INR 140 crores is from the new project launch.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 collections INR 541 crores; H1 FY27 collections INR 1,141 crores; H2 expected to double H1 run-rate
items.quote: Our collections remained at INR 541 crores in Q2 FY '27 and INR1,141 crores in the first half of FY '27.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 operating cash flow INR 125 crores; H1 FY27 OCF INR 193 crores
items.quote: We've generated an OCF, operating cash flow of INR 125 crores during Q2 FY '27 and INR 193 crores overall in H1 FY '27.

items.statement: Sep-26 gross debt INR 838 crores (D/E 0.28x), cash INR 705 crores, net D/E 0.04x; AA- rating stable outlook from CRISIL and ICRA
items.quote: As of 30th September 2026, our gross debt stood at approximately INR 838 crores with a gross debt-to-equity ratio of 0.28:1. This is well within our stated guidelines.

items.statement: Target cash buffer INR 250-300 crores; no equity raise needed in immediate future; construction finance to fund post-launch mismatches
items.quote: To answer your question that how much of our cash will be adequate cash at our current level of operations, we feel that about INR 250 crores, INR 300 crores should be more than enough basically to have a cash buffer with us.

items.statement: Mt K Kapital second fund of USD 450 million announced with Marubeni Corporation
items.quote: I'm pleased to mention that the fund management vertical undertaken by Mt K Kapital continues its expansion with the announcement of a second fund of USD 450 million. This is our venture with the Japanese partner, Marubeni Corporation.

items.statement: H1 FY27 added 2 new projects (GDV INR 547 crores); since FY23 added 27 projects (GDV INR 31,079 crores), 21 redevelopment, 23 in Luxury/Super Premium/Premium/Emerging Premium
items.quote: To drive our future growth, the company has added 2 new projects to its portfolio in the first half of FY '27, having an estimated GDV of INR 547 crores. These strategic additions reinforce the company's leadership in cluster redevelopment.

items.statement: Close to closing 3 large redevelopment projects in western suburbs (~INR 1,000 crores GDV each)
items.quote: We are close to closing 3 large projects with GDV of about INR 1,000 crores each in only the western suburbs very, very shortly.

items.statement: Virar JDA project: sold portion revenue share 28%, unsold portion 71% with 61% EBITDA margin driving mass market margin improvement from 16% to 31%
items.quote: My composition of the JDA revenue, which is there on the sold part is only 28%, wherein on the unsold part, it is 71%. So there is a bigger proportion of the revenue and the EBITDA, which has to come on the unsold part of the Virar and there I get the EBITDA margin of 61%.

items.statement: Dindoshi and Om Nagar cluster launches deferred to H1 FY28; launch guidance maintained via GTB Nagar, Avinash Towers, Thane, Dombivli launches in Q4 FY27
items.quote: So we are looking at Dindoshi in H1 of '28. So that's the kind of planning that we are doing to ensure that we go to the market with Dindoshi and also Om Nagar.

items.statement: FY27 net revenue growth expected in high teens despite higher base in H2 from GST 2.0
items.quote: In spite of the current geopolitical situation, we are confident that we will continue to grow in high teens in FY27, despite post GST 2.0 higher base in Q3 and Q4 of FY27.

items.statement: Export revenue guidance of INR180 crores for FY27, confident of crossing it
items.quote: Last time we had given a guidance of that we will be from INR145 crores, we will touch INR180 crores and we are very confident will be crossing that.

items.statement: Export growth expected >25% YoY on average for FY27, faster growth expected next year
items.quote: as I said that our exports will grow more than 25% year-on-year on an average. So, that we are achieving in this year. And even next year we have the clarity to grow even much faster, you know.

items.statement: EBITDA margin adjusted for aluminium prices at 13.5% or slightly higher
items.quote: We are maintaining what I suggested, because if you adjust the abrupt aluminium prices, our margins will come to 13.5% or a little more.

items.statement: Capex budgeted INR700 crores for FY27 and INR500 crores for FY28
items.quote: This year we have already budgeted INR700 crores but, of course, if the machines come on say 7th April, this number may flow on next year, but it will be around this number on a complete expansion path and even next year we'll be putting in INR500 crores.

items.statement: 19th plant commissioned for friction material expansion, 20th plant (4th Bangalore plant) commissioning 14-15 Jan 2027
items.quote: we have commissioned our 19th plant for the expansion in the friction material, the brakes. And 20th plant will be commissioning very soon, likely on 14th January or 15th January 2027.

items.statement: Previous plant with INR380 crores investment running at 90% capacity utilization
items.quote: the previous plant, which we had put, with an investment of about approximately INR380 crores, that is now running on full capacity of 90% capacity utilization.

items.statement: Regular supply of HPDC alloy wheels to Japanese customer started 3 Aug 2026, FY27 revenue INR80 crores, FY28 orders up to INR240 crores
items.quote: from 3rd August, since we started the commercial production, the supplies are going regularly on daily basis every month, you know? And this year, we will be able to supply as I had mentioned earlier about INR80 crores on the alloy wheels, and next year, the orders are up to the tune of INR240 crores.

items.statement: Indian OEM alloy wheel supply in final testing stages, breakthrough expected next financial year
items.quote: As regards the other Indian customers, as I mentioned, as far as being a safety item, it is in the final stages of the testing. And once that breakthrough comes, so that additional supplies will come only in the next financial year.

items.statement: EV revenue grew 98% YoY in Q2 FY27, EV kit value INR1,250-1,300 vs ICE INR950 (1.3-1.4x multiplier)
items.quote: EV also we are performing. We have grown in EV by 98% YoY in Q2 FY27.

items.statement: EV penetration expected to reach 20% of two-wheeler market in next 2 years from current 10%
items.quote: I think EV in the next 2 years, it should enjoy 20% of the total market.

items.statement: Honda contributes ~35% of total revenue, content per vehicle slightly higher than other customers
items.quote: Honda being the leading customer, it still enjoys about, I think, 35% of our total revenues.

items.statement: EV revenue contribution 5.9% of H1 FY27 vs 4.8% in H1 FY26, kit value higher for EV (INR1,250-1,300) vs ICE (INR950)
items.quote: our EV revenue is 5.9% because we are growing in the other segments. And plus, one of our initial main customer, Ola, as everybody knows, is not doing that well at the moment.

items.statement: Aftermarket revenue ~11% of total revenue, growing faster than brake segment
items.quote: Our aftermarket is growing as per the growth of the company, and it generally outgrows the brake segment. And it normally, of the overall revenue, it constitutes about 11%.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA INR185 crores (30% YoY), margin 11.8% (lower due to alloy price pass-through), absolute EBITDA growth in line with net revenue growth
items.quote: Achieved EBITDA of INR185 crores with 30% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 11.8%. However, EBITDA margin percentage appears lower due to pass-through alloy prices.

items.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA INR348 crores (31.3% YoY), margin 11.9% (lower due to alloy price pass-through)
items.quote: We achieved EBITDA of INR348 crores with 31.3% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin at 11.9%. However, EBITDA percentage lower due to pass-through alloy prices.

items.statement: HPDC alloy wheel margins same as ALPS segment, close to company EBITDA margins
items.quote: Our EBITDA margins are very close in each of the segments.

items.statement: Other expenses elevated due to 35% minimum wage increase in Haryana and other states impacting contractual labour charges
items.quote: The major part of the other expenses is contractual labour charges that was increased due to heavy increase in minimum wages in Haryana and other states.

items.statement: Export revenue rose 133.3% YoY to INR70 crores in Q2 FY27, 74% YoY to INR109 crores in H1 FY27
items.quote: Export revenues rose by 74% year-on-year to INR109 crores compared with INR63 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Net revenue growth 29.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 (ex-alloy pass-through 23% and wheel assembly reduction 5%) vs industry production growth 16.5%
items.quote: We continue to outperform the two-wheeler industry, achieving net revenue growth of 29.5% compared with industry vehicle production growth of 16.5%.

items.statement: H1 FY27 net revenue growth 27.6% YoY (ex-alloy pass-through 27.1% and wheel assembly reduction 5.1%) vs industry production growth 19.5%
items.quote: We continued to outperform the two-wheeler industry, achieving that revenue growth of 27.6% compared with industry weaker production growth of 19.5%.

items.statement: Advanced braking system revenue grew 46% YoY in Q2, 47% in H1; ALPS grew 69% in Q2, 72% in H1; safety control cables grew 33% in Q2, 27% in H1
items.quote: Revenue from advanced braking system grew by 47% year-on-year, while aluminium lightweighting precision solutions and safety control cables recorded revenue growth of 72% and 27%, respectively.

items.statement: Debt-equity ratio maintained ~0.5x, debt-to-EBITDA ~1x, capex funded from internal accruals, no debt repayment concern
items.quote: our debt equity ratio always remains around 0.5x, you know, which is very well controlled. even the debt to EBITDA we like to keep around one year of EBITDA only.

items.statement: Half-yearly EBITDA INR348 crores indicates strong internal cash generation for capex funding
items.quote: I think you should make out that our half yearly EBITDA numbers are INR348 crores so there is enough cash generation.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased due to higher sales and higher aluminium prices
items.quote: Increase in sales as well as increase in aluminium prices.

items.statement: Second captive solar plant 11.55 MW in Bikaner operationalized October 2026
items.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan operationalized in October '26, as promised earlier.

items.statement: Passenger vehicle revenue grew 79% YoY in Q2, 67% YoY in H1 FY27
items.quote: See, in passenger vehicle, we have grown by 79% in this quarter, you know. And overall, also we have grown in the half year also, we have grown by 67%.

items.statement: Margin trajectory in H2 FY27 same or slightly better if aluminium prices remain stable at current high levels
items.quote: The margin trajectory will be the same if the aluminium prices remain high like this. So it is not going to fall, it is going to be little better or remains the same.

items.statement: Two-wheeler industry expected to grow ~10% in FY28 after strong FY27, customers bullish and expanding capacities
items.quote: I think it should still grow at 10%. The industry should grow at 10%.

items.statement: Management declined to provide forward-looking financial targets
items.quote: I can, I can give you a number, as I've been, I know I cannot give any future looking statements.

items.statement: Board approved 114 crore expansion including 100 crore for shelling and cardanol plant plus 14 crore staff housing
items.quote: The total project cost will be around 100 crores, including the land and manufacturing unit, and the staff housing colony will be for 14 crores. This is still a total of 114 crores.

items.statement: Shelling capacity to expand from 140 to 200 metric tons per day with 60 ton addition on adjacent land
items.quote: This will be increasing to 200 tons per day capacity from 140 existing. So, the additional capacity is of 60 metric ton.

items.statement: CNSL plant designed for 150 tons input, currently running at 100 tons from 140 ton shelling output
items.quote: The plant is designed for 150 tons, which is in line with what we want to do for with the capex, which is of additional 60 tons, so this is the 200 tons when we do, it should give us 140 tons of shell, and the lab plant capacity is 150 metric tons.

items.statement: EBITDA per kg stable at 7 rupees despite revenue growth; percentage margins decline as raw cashew prices rise
items.quote: The prices are 150 rupees per kilo of raw Cashew nuts and the value addition margins are 27 rupees. Minus the operating cost, which is 20 rupees, our EBITDA per kg would remain 7 rupees.

items.statement: Short-term borrowings rose from 111 to 232 crores due to higher raw material prices, longer transit times, and delayed Diwali; finance cost flat at 8.39 crores
items.quote: The borrowing at H2 end of FY26 was 111 crores. The end of H1 FY27 was 232 crores. These are terminal numbers on that date. The impact.is really seen in the finance cost from a finance cost perspective the finance cost was 8.36 crores for the H2 of FY26. The finance cost for H1 of FY27 is 8.39 crores.

items.statement: Working capital cycle extended to 110-112 days transit time from 35-45 days; inventory buildup from price rise and Adhik Maas
items.quote: What is your cycle time, working capital cycle time? Now, if the transit, which was 35 to 45 days, has increased to 110, 112 days, then the transit cycle also will take additional working capital.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow due to working capital investment; long-term debt may fund fixed capex while working capital debt tracks cashew prices
items.quote: If you are investing more then the cash flow will not be positive. Yeah? If you are not investing, then the cash flow will be positive. So, what is that we want? We want to invest and grow or we want positive cash flow.

items.statement: Kernel realization averaging 735-738 rupees; derived from raw cashew price, shell prices, and packing costs linked to crude oil
items.quote: So, we have on an average a kernel realization of around 735 to 738. The realizations depend upon 3 aspects one is the raw cashew nuts , second is the shell prices that we get in the market and then finally how the processing cost and the packing material cost is behaving.

items.statement: Sourcing from African origins via merchant traders in UAE, Singapore, Europe; not direct farm buying due to country regulations
items.quote: We contract with merchant traders who are either in UAE, Singapore, or Eu rope, basically within maybe UK or Switzerland. These are the merchant traders’ offices, so the contract remains within the Well-defined legal frameworks

items.statement: Transit time from West Africa increased to 110-112 days from 35-45 days due to Red Sea routing
items.quote: What transit time used to be around 35 to 45 days from West African countries , increase up to 110 to 112 days.

items.statement: Operating across food, fuel, feed, fertility segments; targeting Middle East exports for premium grades 180s and 240s
items.quote: we are working in the four segments of raw cashew nuts, or rather than cashew nuts, which is in the food, fuel, feed, and fertility si de. And that's where the 2037 is that we are looking

items.statement: Export margins lower than domestic; India better price payer; Vietnam dominates China supply; export driven by liquidity for premium grades
items.quote: Export doesn't give you great margins. Let me put it this way. India is the better price payer. However, there are different reasons why you export. One is that with the prices going up significantly, the higher quality grades like 180s and 240s see the demand destruction in India very easily.

items.statement: CNSL and solar plants in final stages; commercial production expected mid to end December subject to approvals
items.quote: Both are in the final stages. We are expecting this to be completed, subject to approvals and all those stuffs. Maybe mid or end of December, I can take conservatively as the start times.

items.statement: Management acknowledges past timeline misses; now giving 30-month conservative timeline for new expansion
items.quote: We have learned also from a management perspective that when you give internal timelines, It is something that is something that the larger group takes us as clearly, as you know, non-negotiable, and you can see that, you know, the project that we have now given has been given with a 30 months' timeline.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 95-97% currently; volume growth requires capacity expansion
items.quote: Yeah. 95 to 97 percent.

items.statement: Long-term target 1000 metric tons capacity by 2037; additional 800 tons over 10 years seen as achievable
items.quote: See, this is Ten years from now, that we are talking about additionally 800 metric tons capacity. From where we see in a larger play of things, yes, this is very much achievable.

items.statement: Direct farm buying in Africa not feasible due to auction systems, licensing, and legal entity requirements
items.quote: Africa farm you cannot buy directly. A lot of countries have their own auction systems. A lot of countries have their own licensing systems. And these. Things that you basically want to do is not technically possible for because of the rules and regulations.

items.statement: El Nino driving almond, walnut, pistachio prices up significantly; cashew relatively stable but supply needs to increase
items.quote: We all know that there is an El Nino which is there from a dry fruit perspective excluding the cashew all other dry fruits, which is almonds, walnuts, pistachio, everything has significantly increased. Much more, maybe some of them have doubled up as well. Cashew has not.

items.statement: H1 FY27 revenue 246 crores, up 42% YoY; EBITDA 23 crores with improved margins; PAT flat at 863 lakhs vs 870 lakhs
items.quote: So, we clocked the revenue of 246 crores. This is an increase of 42% compared to the last year. With an EBITDA of 23 crores, a more or less corresponding increase in EBITDA as well, our EBITDA margins have improved compared to the last year.

items.statement: Order book stood at Rs 331.61 crore as of September 30, 2026, to be built by March 31, 2027
items.quote: As of September 30th, 2026, our order books stood at Rs. 331.61 crores, representing business expected to be built up to March 31, 2027.

items.statement: Order book composition: Rs 132 crore product orders and Rs 199 crore services orders as of September 30, 2026
items.quote: Out of which 132 crore is product orders and 199 crore is the services order. So, this can be built before 31st of March, 2027.

items.statement: Infrastructure product business facing delivery delays and weekly price increases for the last year, expected to continue for another year
items.quote: currently the situation at the infrastructure products is slightly difficult because the delay in the deliveries, pricing going up every week, those are the challenges we saw coming up for the last one year and it will continue to be there for another one year as well.

items.statement: Services revenue grew 24.95% QoQ to Rs 130.99 crore in Q2 FY27, contributing 59.6% of revenue vs 51.92% in Q1
items.quote: Revenue from Services grew by 24.95% sequentially to Rs. 130.99 crore , while revenue from products stood at Rs. 88.78 crores, compared with Rs. 97.09 crores in Q1 of FY27. Services contributed 59.6% of revenue compared with 51.92% in Q1 of FY27, supporting the expansion in our EBITDA margin.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 263 bps QoQ to 10.20% in Q2 FY27 from 7.57% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: EBITDA stood at Rs. 22.45 crores, an increase of 45.6% quarter-on-quarter from Rs. 15.42 crores. And our EBITDA margin has expanded by 263 basis points from 10.20% to 7.57% in Q1 of FY27.

items.statement: Management does not disclose forward-looking numbers but expects quarter-on-quarter growth trend to continue in Q3 and Q4 FY27
items.quote: those are all forward-looking numbers. Okay. So, I'm not able to comment on that. But quarter -on-quarter, if you observe it, we are growing. So, our Q1 was better than Q4. Our Q2 was better than Q1. And hopefully, the same trend will continue in Q3 and Q4.

items.statement: Margins sustainable if revenue mix stays at approximately 60% services and 40% products
items.quote: So, until and unless this ratio or the mix of business remains the same, meaning approximately 60% of the services and 40% of the products. If the mix remains the same, I think the margins are definitely sustainable.

items.statement: Plan to invest approximately USD 5 million in cybersecurity expansion, hire around 100 cybersecurity professionals, and target 12% expansion in cybersecurity customer base
items.quote: We plan to invest approximately USD 5 million in this expansion, hire around 100 cybersecurity professionals, and target a 12% expansion in our cybersecurity customer base.

items.statement: SOC and NOC facility at Turbhe currently at just over double-digit percentage utilization, expected to reach full capacity by Calendar Year 2027
items.quote: currently, it is just over double-digit percentage. More and more, after quarter, you will see the percentage will keep on growing and within a year or so, I think we should be at the full capacity usage over by Calendar Year ‘27.

items.statement: Company is debt-free and plans to remain debt-free by March 2027; being selective in DaaS customer selection based on credit agency approval
items.quote: we are a debt-free company and we want to have a debt-free plan by March 2027 as well. Okay. When I'm saying working capital, it's more to do with the Daas, we are very much clear on which customer to select and whom to give this asset perspective. So, currently, we are being very choosy to do business with the DaaS as of now.

items.statement: Board approved interim dividend of Rs 2 per share for FY27, representing 20% of face value
items.quote: the Board of Directors has approved an interim dividend of Rs. 2 per share for FY27, which is 20% of the face value, balancing the shareholders' return with investment in strategic growth opportunities.

items.statement: Signed 3-year contract worth USD 3.15 million with Securonix in September 2026 as exclusive value-added distributor and joint go-to-market partner in India
items.quote: In September 2026, we strengthened our cybersecurity business by signing a 3-year contract worth USD 3.15 million with Securonix and became its exclusive value-added distributor and joint go -to-market partner in India.

items.statement: Received purchase order of approximately Rs 76.20 crore from NPCI in July 2026 for supply of servers with 7-year warranty to be executed over 18 weeks
items.quote: In July 2026, we received a purchase order of approximately Rs. 76.20 CR, excluding GST, from the National Payments Corporation of India, for the supply of servers with a 7-year warranty to be executed over 18 weeks.

items.statement: Managed services contracts typically 3-year tenure, some 5-year or 7-year; all managed services are recurring revenue
items.quote: most of the managed services order is basically 3-year contract. So, we try and book it for 3 years, most of the contracts. But there are certain contracts which are 5-year or 7-year also.

items.statement: Recognized as AWS Managed Service Provider, enhancing credibility for cloud managed services and helping win bigger contracts
items.quote: We have been recognized as an Amazon Web Services Managed Service Provider, an important milestone for our cloud business. This reinforces our ability to deliver managed cloud operations, infrastructure modernization, security optimization, and ongoing technology management, and to offer secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions to enterprise customers.

items.statement: H1 FY27 revenue declined 14% YoY due to infrastructure business challenges, but EBITDA improved due to managed services focus
items.quote: Yes, FY26 H1 and FY27 H1, there is a dip of 14% primarily because of the infrastructure revenue. There are challenges in the infrastructure business. And we all know that it's been there for last one year. And currently, if you see, it's going to go more and more tighter as the prices are skyrocketing.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA target raised to north of INR560 crore from earlier INR520-550 crore range
items.quote: We are also now talking about north of INR560 crore s as the EBITDA target for the year

items.statement: FY27 revenue expected to exceed INR6,000 crore vs earlier INR5,600-5,700 crore target
items.quote: we had targeted this year FY 2027 with a revenue of about INR5,600 crores, INR5,700 crores, but we are on course to do more than INR6,000 crore s for FY 2027

items.statement: FY28 revenue guided at INR7,200-7,300 crore and FY29 at INR7,700-8,000 crore
items.quote: For FY 2028, we are looking at a revenue of about INR7,200 crores, INR7,300 crores, and FY 2029, we should be close to about INR7,700 crores, INR8,000 crores.

items.statement: FY27 capex ~INR200 crore; FY28 capex ~INR400 crore with some spillover to FY29
items.quote: The capex for the current year is close to INR200 odd crores, and for the following year, it would be close to INR400 odd crores.

items.statement: Silvassa technical textiles capacity doubled from 9,000 to 18,000 MTPA, commissioned Aug 20, 2026, running at ~94-95% utilization
items.quote: our expanded technical textiles capacity at Silvassa commenced production on Au gust 20th, 2026, doubling our installed capacity from 9,000 metric tons per annum to 18,000 metric tons per annum

items.statement: Technical textiles expanded capacity fully stabilized and placed in domestic and export markets
items.quote: We are fully stabilized on the production, and we have placed our material well in the domestic as well as the export market.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue mix: polyester 87%, cotton 10%, technical textiles 3%; Standalone: polyester 77%, cotton 18%, technical textiles 6%
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, polyester contributed close to 87% of the revenue, cotton close to 10%, and technical textile close to 3%.

items.statement: Chinese FDY imports not a threat; landed Chinese material more expensive than domestic; minimal imports since BIS removal
items.quote: Chinese material is today more expensive than domestic material. If you look at it, since the time BIS has been removed, there's very little imports that has come into the country

items.statement: EU FTA will give India advantage vs Bangladesh for yarn, fabric, garment exports
items.quote: With the FTA coming in, yes, we will now be at an advantage in terms of yarn exports also, and more so with the fabric and garment exports.

items.statement: Gross debt ~INR1,350 crore by FY27 end; net debt ~INR1,150 crore; FY28 gross debt to reduce by ~INR120 crore
items.quote: Gross debt would be close to INR1,350 crores at the end of the year. Net debt would be close to INR1,150 crores. Next year, the gross debt should reduce by approximately INR120 odd crores.

items.statement: MP cotton yarn project (INR400 crore) on track; groundwork by early Jan 2027; production by end CY2027; full stabilization by end FY28
items.quote: We aim to start getting set foot on ground by early January, and we aim to get into production by end of the calendar year and stabilize fully by the end of the financial year.

items.statement: Silvassa utilization ~95%; Punjab utilization ~90% in Q2, targeting 95-96% in next two quarters
items.quote: Silvassa, we have been always operating at about 95%, and we have achieved that here. Punjab, as I said, the first quarter we operated around 76%, 77%. This time we are closer to 90%.

items.statement: Technical textiles addition to contribute ~INR80-90 crore incremental revenue in FY27 (half-year impact)
items.quote: Typically, this would give us an additional top line of about INR150 crore s, INR160 crores. So we should get about INR80 crores, INR90 crores additional for FY 2027

items.statement: Punjab EBITDA per ton improved from ~INR2,500-3,000 in Q1 to substantially higher in Q2; will rise further as utilization increases
items.quote: If you see the Punjab facility, the first quarter, because we were operating at only at about 76%, 77%, the EBITDA per ton was about close to INR2,500 per ton, INR3,000 per ton only, which is substantially higher this quarter.

items.statement: Company maintains disciplined capital allocation, balance sheet management, working capital and operational efficiency
items.quote: The company continues to maintain a disciplined approach toward capital allocation, balance sheet management, working capital, and operational efficiency.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guided at INR 190-200 crores supported by executable order book of INR 384 crores
items.quote: We remain focused on o ur projected financial year '27, revenue of approximately INR 190 crores to INR 200 crores. Our business has a natural execution cycle, sir, with a significant portion of project activity that concentrates much more in half-year, or in half-year 2, which has started now from October to March 31st

items.statement: Long-term ambition to reach INR 1,000 crores revenue by FY2030 through organic growth and diversification
items.quote: As discussed previously, the company has articulated an ambition of reaching INR 1,000 crores in revenue by Financial year 2030. This remains a long -term ambition and depends on the business opportunities, order inflows, execution capabilities, condition of the market and the company's financial health.

items.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 19.45% vs 21.38% YoY; PAT margin 12.66% vs 14.68% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 19.45% as compared with 21.38% in H1 Financial year '26. PAT margin 12.66% compared with 14.68% in H1 Financial year '26.

items.statement: Strong demand in CGD driven by PNG mandate; solar target 500GW by 2030; water infrastructure opportunities
items.quote: Since April and May that in this current business of CGD, already with PNG drive has taken place, and in the geography in India, wherever the piped natural gas is available and if our citizens are not using piped natural gas, there has been a compulsion mandate has already taken place by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas through their PNGRB which is regulatory board.

items.statement: CBG pilot plant operational at 97-98% capacity; commercial injection into Adani Total Gas pipeline expected before Diwali
items.quote: We already had a pilot project. We even had flared the compressed biogas for 60 days to see whether this monsoon weather makes any hindrance to run that plant or not. But it has done quite wel l, and calorific value, and 97% to 98% capacity has already been incurred. I hope before Diwali, we are definitely going to make this on the commercial

items.statement: UAE subsidiary Desco Global participated in ADNOC tender; price bid opening expected in 2-3 months
items.quote: Desco Infratech subsidiary, Desco Global has already participate d in the tender with ADNOC. So yes, I am waiting for the opportunity to open the price bid, and let's hope for the best that we even get that opportunity to work in Ras Al Khaimah moving forward in the next 2 to 3 months

items.statement: Focus on timely billing, certification follow-ups, collection efficiency and invoice discounting to improve cash conversion
items.quote: We are continuing to focus on timely billing, follow -ups on certification of the completed work, collection efficiency and the appropriate use of available finance and invoice discounting facilities.

items.statement: Other current assets increased due to PNG drive execution; certifications and billings started, cash conversion expected in 45-60 days
items.quote: Considering the nation's emergency and our participation into the same sector, we have executed state jobs, and certifications, billings, measurements already has started, and I am expecting it to be getting converted into cash in the next 45 to 60 days maximum.

items.statement: High-cost NBFC loans (16-17%) to be closed by 15 Dec 2027; restructuring to lower rates underway
items.quote: All those business loans that we took, we took in 2024 calendar year, and those are all about to get closed in 2027. So while calculating everything, the foreclosure charges and all, I think, it was getting a little bit heavier on us. So, we have decided to close that loan in 2027. So we have decided to close that loan in 2020 and we are expecting it to close by 15th of December maximum.

items.statement: Loan limit increased to INR 150 crores including bill discounting and trade payable limits; business loans to be restructured by 15 Dec 2027
items.quote: Sir, see, out of all these loans, we are having the cash bill discounting limits as well, trade payable limits as well, which we use to churn for 90 days. Those are just the term plans and which is going to be rare in our books. But all the business loans, we are definitely going to restructure by 15th of December maximum.

items.statement: Key hires: Arun Kumar (CGD pioneer), Shailesh Naik (Independent Director), Kalpesh Patel (Board member) for governance and execution
items.quote: Recently also, we have some of the pioneers who are one of the pioneers and key members who has established the CGD network in the nation, Mr. Arun Kumar, who is an execution excellence guy, Mr. Shailesh Naik, who is the Independent Director, and Mr. Kalpesh Patel, who has recently joined the board.

items.statement: GOBARDHAN scheme subsidies for CBG plants in drafting phase at state level; expected to improve profitability
items.quote: This new subsidy that has been enrolled in the central government, it is definitely going to benefit us moving forward considering the long-term growth. Since this subsidy is still in drafting phase in most of the states, and we are waiting for the government to declare the state-level subsidy.

items.statement: Middle East geopolitical tensions impacted UAE subsidiary; tenders now floating again with ADNOC participation
items.quote: Our Dubai subsidiary due to this Middle East geopolitical issues, it got on hold as there were some tensions that were taking place in that precise geography. But now tenders have already been floated, and your company, Desco Infratech has -- Desco Infratech subsidiary, Desco Global has already participate d in the tender with ADNOC

items.statement: Project execution capability now INR 50 crores+ per project; infra projects completed ~INR 340 crores
items.quote: Our infra projects completed approximately INR 340 crores and project size capabilities now stand at INR 50 crores plus.

items.statement: Profitability demonstrated; next priority improving working capital management and cash conversion quality
items.quote: We have basically demonstrated growt h in revenue and profitability. The next priority is improving the quality of that growth through better working capital management and conversion of the cash

items.statement: Diversifying from CGD into power distribution, solar EPC, compressed biogas, water treatment, and international EPC
items.quote: we are moving as an infrastructure energy -mixed EPC company such as city gas distribution, power and transmission d istribution, solar EPC solution , then, what we call, the water treatment

items.statement: Geopolitical uncertainties in Middle East monitored for impact on crude-linked material prices, logistics, procurement costs
items.quote: We are actually, basically conscious of the geopolitical uncertainties that has taken place already in Middle East and their potential impact on crude-linked material prices, logistics, procurement costs. But at present, we are closely monitoring these developments.

items.statement: Added 10 MT/day finished kernel capacity in May 2026, taking total installed capacity to 20 MT/day; targeting 40 MT/day by FY28
items.quote: In May 2026, we have added 10 metric ton finished kernel production capacity to the existing capacity of 10 metric ton finished kernel production per day, overall taking our total installed finished nuts production capacity to 20 metric tons per day.

items.statement: Ice cream installed capacity is 1 lakh liter per day; expect 37% utilization in FY27 and full utilization by Q1 FY29 yielding INR600 cr top line
items.quote: Current financial year, we expect to reach almost 37% of the ice cream capacity of the installed capacity. And as full capacity utilization, we are targeting in Q1 FY29, the full capacity utilization in ice cream can give us INR600 crores top line.

items.statement: Targeting ~50% revenue growth and ~50% EBITDA growth in FY27; H1 FY27 revenue grew 50% and EBITDA grew 63%
items.quote: As outlined in our investor presentation, we are targeting approximately 50% growth in top line and 50% growth in profitability in current financial year, that is FY27.

items.statement: Targeting consolidated revenue of INR1,500 crores by FY29 with equal contribution from nuts and ice cream divisions
items.quote: Further, we have set ambitious target of achieving consolidated revenue of INR1,500 crores for FY29, and all our efforts in capacity ramp-up, even distribution network expansion, and everything, new product launching in both the segment whatever we are doing is, by keeping this FY29 targets in the sight.

items.statement: Nuts EBITDA margin target 15-16%; ice cream EBITDA margin target 15-16% at full capacity utilization in FY29
items.quote: See, nuts business, EBITDA beyond 18% is very challenging, I tell you. So, our target EBITDA in nuts is 15% to 16%, or our target EBITDA in ice cream is also 15% to 16%. When -- in ice cream, when optimum capacity is utilized in FY'29.

items.statement: Expect nuts growth of 20-25% in next 2-3 quarters; ice cream growth nearly double nuts growth
items.quote: We expect next two to three quarters, 20% to 25% growth in the Nut segment, whereas in ice cream the growth will be much more than this, almost double the Nut segment.

items.statement: Deep freezer network at 18,752 units end Q2 FY27; target 27,000 by end FY27; products across 35,000+ retail touchpoints in 6 states
items.quote: As of end of Quarter 2 FY27, our deep freezer network stood at 18,752 units with the target of reaching to 27,000 deep freezers by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Added 85 new distributors in Q2 FY27, total 205; distributor retention rate ~95%
items.quote: During the quarter, we added 85 new distributors taking overall distributor count to 205. We have also maintained a distributor retention rate of approximately 95%.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 export shipment to Singapore USD384,000; planning US market entry next year and Japan exploration
items.quote: During this quarter, Quarter 2, we had a very good export shipment to Singapore. The shipment to Singapore during Quarter 2 amounted to USD384,000.

items.statement: Targeting USA distribution build-out over next 2-3 years for nuts; Japan also on radar
items.quote: Firstly, we'll start with USA by next year, and then simultaneously we'll explore Japan. But USA, we are very bullish for the expansion in USA for the Nut segment.

items.statement: Vivek Kumar Jain joined as Chief Business Officer effective Oct 23, 2026 with 25+ years experience in consumer goods
items.quote: Mr. Vivek Kumar Jain joined Krishival Foods as Chief Business Officer effective October 23, 2026, last month. He brings over 25 years of experience as an Industry Veteran with extensive exposure to consumer goods sector.

items.statement: Managed input cost pressures (El Nino, sugar, crude oil) via sound sourcing and inventory buildup; ice cream EBITDA 16% vs 8% target in Q2
items.quote: Even in ice cream, in this period we have seen expansion of EBITDA beyond our expectation as Quarter 2 is relatively less top-line growth because of monsoon for ice cream, there an also profitability has been maintained.

items.statement: Receivables spike due to September sales concentration (Diwali) and 3x ice cream sales growth; inventory buildup strategic due to El Nino and input cost pressures
items.quote: See, the receivable, peculiarly in this year, if you see the September month, out of our total sale for this quarter is almost INR85 crores something. Out of that, almost INR55 crores -- up to INR55 crores sale has come in the month of September.

items.statement: Inventory buildup strategic due to El Nino, drought, oil prices and crop patterns; piled up for cost management
items.quote: Regarding the inventory. So, regarding the inventory, so inventory as it is this year is a very peculiar because of El Niño effect and inflationary pressure and all the inputs, raw materials and everywhere we have gone on a strategy of having some buildup stock for everything.

items.statement: Borrowings to increase only in ice cream segment next year; nuts segment no further borrowing for 1-1.5 years; debt increase balanced by EBITDA and top-line growth
items.quote: Borrowings going forward, borrowings will increase only -- in ice cream segment. In the nuts segment going forward, there is no -- we don't see any increase in borrowing in next one year or 1.5 years.

items.statement: Mellow & Co. first FOCO outlet at Apte Road, Pune (1,400 sq ft) under commissioning; hub-and-spoke model targeting 15 spoke outlets in Pune then Navi Mumbai/Hyderabad
items.quote: After the launch of this outlet, we plan to expand to 25 FOCO outlets in the Pune and the vicinity.

items.statement: Melt N Mellow only player in last 3 years to expand general trade profitably across 5+ states; competition not expected to stall growth
items.quote: I tell this thing with pride that in last three years in India, in general trade, I don't think any player in India apart from Melt 'N' Mellow who has been successful in general trade expansion in more than five states with EBITDA positive -- EBITDA profitability.

items.statement: Nuts portfolio includes flavored cashews, almonds, pistachios, makhana, trail mixes; INR20 MRP affordable range expanding; ice cream adding zero added sugar options
items.quote: We are also expanding our affordable on-the-go offering through INR20 MRP range which include trail mixes, cereal mixes, salted nuts, mixed assorted nuts, roasted almonds, and assorted mixes.

items.statement: Nuts B2B focused on mithai ingredient partners (Prashant Corner, Meetha by Radisson, Haldiram Delhi, Home Sweet Gurgaon) with profitability similar to B2C
items.quote: Our B2B is only for mithai ingredient partners. So in the mithai ingredient partners, you get a good rate for providing good product to them.

items.statement: FY29 identified as inflection point for net profit margin expansion as operating leverage kicks in; current depreciation/finance costs high due to deep freezer expansion
items.quote: Financial year '29 is our inflection point. So, our -- this expansion, growth, everything will continue for next two years, and financial year '29 will be the inflection point.

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 40% YoY and PAT margin expansion to 150 bps over FY26
items.quote: On the top line for this financial year, we should grow by 40% over previous financial year. And on the bottom line PAT point of view, it should be growing by 1.5% from previous guidance of 1%.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded 515 bps YoY to 25.1% in Q2 FY27; management says margin sustainable and will grow due to permanent price reset and brand premium
items.quote: Gross margin improved by 515 basis points year-on-year to 25.1%. Our India business grew 45% year-on-year and our international business grew by around 40%.

items.statement: Demand healthy across India and international markets (US, Europe, Middle East); company ahead of full-year FY27 guidance on revenue and profitability
items.quote: Demand remains healthy across and our international markets, the United States, Europe and the Middle East, and we are ahead of our full year FY27 guidance on both revenue growth and profitability.

items.statement: New laptop prices up ~80% YoY (INR35-40k to INR65-72k); refurbished ASP up 11% in H1; management sees permanent price reset enabling higher refurbished pricing at 30-45% of new
items.quote: A year ago, the sweet spot for a laptop in India was around INR35,000 to INR40,000. That same computer today is now between INR65,000 to INR72,000.

items.statement: Q2 volume 225k units, H1 volume 374k units; laptops 78-80% of revenue; volume growth ~25% YoY in Q2
items.quote: So in the quarter 2, we have had a total volume of about 2,25,000-odd units. And for the first half, the number is about 3,74,000-odd units.

items.statement: Doubled India refurbishment space 2-3 quarters ago; expanded UAE from 3-4 to 8 facilities; headcount more than doubled since IPO
items.quote: In India, we have almost doubled our space almost 2, 3 quarters back. In UAE also, we have enhanced from 3, 4 facilities to almost 8 facilities.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization ~40-50%; can scale to ~1M units annually; hiring engineering talent to support refurbishment capacity expansion
items.quote: At the growth rate guidance that we have given, we still -- you can do the numbers as to we will still be below 1 million by the end of the year. What does that translate in terms of capacity and capability? We are still, I would say, from all that we have in place, we will still be in the 40%, 45%, 50% odd capacity utilization.

items.statement: Inventory elevated strategically; management expects elevated inventory for next 2 quarters; targets ~90 days inventory at new normal in 2 years
items.quote: Inventories continue to be elevated because the opportunity itself is presenting us in this manner. And is this likely to continue over the next 3 to 4 quarters? Probably not. But definitely, the way we are seeing, the way the commentary is there from the OEMs and the component manufacturers, clearly, we see that at least for the next 2 quarters, an elevated inventory is more beneficial from a bus

items.statement: Net debt INR427 cr end Q2 FY27; guided similar level for full FY27; no significant debt increase needed for guidance
items.quote: As you would have seen the numbers, the current net debt is about INR427-odd crores. We anticipate that this level of debt, which was about INR406 crores at the end of previous quarter, right? So the current level of debt is something which we anticipate is a fair number to assume going forward as well.

items.statement: Inventory and receivable increases funded substantially through accruals; equity plus debt guidance covers working capital needs
items.quote: Yes, it is substantially accruals driven. So if you look at the inventory and receivables and payables, all of this factored in, this stacks up with our equity plus the debt guidance that we have given.

items.statement: Electronics Bazaar brand now top-of-mind in multiple markets; customers ask for brand by name; 5,542 customer touchpoints (up from 5,130); 55 countries supplied (up from 49)
items.quote: As of the end of Q2 FY27, Electronics Bazaar supplies to 55 countries, up from 49 at the end of Q1. Customer touch points stand at 5,542, up from 5,130.

items.statement: Laptops 78-80% of revenue; ASP INR31k for laptops, INR19.5k for others; mix shift to higher configurations supporting realization
items.quote: Broadly, this proportion between laptops and others continues to remain in the same trajectory of between 78% to 80% being laptops and others being the rest of it in terms of revenue. Coming to ASPs for laptops for this quarter just concluded, it is about INR31,000-odd and for others, it's about INR19,500-odd.

items.statement: Management acknowledges inventory risk if memory prices crash but cites strategic buying at old prices, brand pricing power (30% to 45-50%), and real-time intelligence as mitigants
items.quote: In a kind of unlikely scenario, I would say, where memory prices come crashing down or the computer prices, which I don't believe for a moment will happen. In that situation, also since we are buying ahead of the curve, we have a significant cushion.

items.statement: Effective tax rate ~18% in H1 FY27 vs 10.6% FY26 due to higher India profit share; guided 14-16% for full FY27; PAT guidance factors this in
items.quote: From a guidance perspective for the full year, it will be fair to assume in your stack that the tax rate should be relative to 10.6%, 11% last year, it will be fair to assume a number somewhere between 14% to 16% from an assessment perspective.

items.statement: Inventory gains contributed 125-150 bps to gross margin expansion; balance from brand pricing power and realization improvement
items.quote: Of this, it will be fair to assume that somewhere between 125 to 150 basis points is on account of the advanced inventory strategic decisions that have been taken. And the substantial part is on account of our ability to enhance our price, have a better realization, get the proposition well established and well received.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target INR420-430 crore; 2-year aim: 20%+ revenue CAGR and 25%+ EBITDA margin
items.quote: With these investments, we have set ourselves a clear 2-year aim, revenue growth of 20%-plus CAGR and EBITDA margins of 25%-plus.

items.statement: SteriPort Line 3 expected to contribute INR60 crore in FY27; earlier guidance of INR110 crore annual revenue to be met with optimal utilization
items.quote: So we expect it to contribute about INR60 crores in the current financial year, that is FY '27, in top line. And we expect that our earlier guidance of about INR110 crore annual revenue will be met with the optimal utilization of the line.

items.statement: SVP expansion capacity rising ~52% from INR20.9 crore to INR31 crore; commissioning in Q1 FY28
items.quote: After SteriPort, our next expansion is in small volume parenterals, where capacity will rise by roughly 52%, from INR20.9 crores to roughly INR31 crores during Q1 FY '28.

items.statement: Future capex focused on product development, regulatory filings, automation; quantum INR7-20 crore
items.quote: So product development, dossiers, and regulatory filings and automation at the plant level. These are -- there is -- the quantum may not be as high as SVP also. This could be anything from INR7 crore, INR8 crore to INR20 crore, but these are all part of developing product pipeline.

items.statement: SteriPort Line 3 commissioned early September 2026, capacity up ~75% from INR6.6 crore to INR11.6 crore annually; full ramp-up by 20 Nov 2026
items.quote: We commissioned it in the first week of September 2026 at our existing Kheda facility, taking our SteriPort capacity up by about 75%, from INR6.6 crores per year to roughly INR11.6 crores.

items.statement: Overall plant utilization ~95-97%; SteriPort Line 3 at ~55% currently, reaching 100% by 20 Nov 2026
items.quote: So current utilization of entire plant is roughly around 95% or so, 95% to 97%. SteriPort Line 3, which we have commissioned in September, is running at roughly 55% capacity.

items.statement: SVP new line expected 40-50% utilization in first 2 quarters post-commissioning (Q1-Q2 FY28) due to product transfers and regulatory filings
items.quote: So because SVP line is specifically meant for inhalation products only. In initial stage, we hope -- we are hoping around 40% to 50% utilization for first 2 quarters because other products are being developed and they'll be transferred from one line to other line.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 21.6% despite polymer price volatility; absorbed cost increases via product/market mix and price hikes (~4-4.5%)
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is also up by about 22%, which is INR18 crore, and EBITDA margin has remained healthy at 21.6% despite all challenges of overhead and new raw material price pressure.

items.statement: Gross margin pressure from polymer price volatility (70%+ spike); expect normalization in 3-6 months; price hikes of INR0.70-1.80 per bottle (~4-4.5%) implemented
items.quote: I think the price hike varies from around INR0.70 per bottle to maybe around INR1.80 per bottle, depending upon the product. So average relation increase could be around roughly INR1.

items.statement: Captive 10.8 MW solar plant operational since end of Q1 FY27; expected INR9 crore annual power cost saving
items.quote: Captive solar is also expected to deliver about INR9 crore of annual power cost saving, and that will also help in EBITDA as well as bottom line improvement.

items.statement: SVP expansion dedicated to inhalation (6 products, 2 commercialized) and preservative-free ophthalmics; 20 products in pipeline (12 in SVP)
items.quote: So we have 20 products in the pipeline. Out of 20, roughly 12 are in SVP and that's split between inhalation and ophthalmics. So inhalation portfolio of 6 products, 2 are already commercialized, additional 6 products will be developed in due course.

items.statement: ~200-250 channel partners pan-India; SteriPort enabled nationwide distribution from earlier west/north focus
items.quote: We have roughly 200 to 250 channel partners across the country. Yes, yes and that is more than sufficient to absorb our capacity.

items.statement: ~32% revenue from international markets in Q2 FY27; targeting advanced markets (Australia, South Africa, Canada, Europe) via SVP inhalation/ophthalmic approvals over next 6 quarters
items.quote: In Q2 FY '27, approximately 32% of our revenue came from international markets.

items.statement: Regulatory filings for advanced markets to start Jan-Feb 2027 after SVP line samples available; MedSafe initiated for device-classified products
items.quote: So we have already initiated MedSafe, for instance. It's, for device, some products are classified under device category. So MedSafe is a precursor to most of the approvals. So that we have already initiated, and we are going -- we'll be going for the approvals also.

items.statement: Total borrowing ~INR190 crore (incl INR45 crore WC) as of Sep 2026; expect ~INR130 crore term + WC by FY27 end; annual repayment ~INR30-35 crore; target ~INR100 crore term + INR50 crore WC by FY28
items.quote: So as of September end, our total borrowing has been about INR190 crore, which includes about INR45 crore of working capital. So excluding that, about INR150 crore. And end of FY '27, we expect it to be about INR130 crore plus working capital, that is about INR175 crore, 180 crore.

items.statement: SteriPort Line 3 commercial production and sales started September 2026; SVP capex funded from IPO proceeds; solar plant generating since end Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our SteriPort Line 3 has already started, and commercial production as well as sales has been started from September itself.

items.statement: SteriPort market share ~6% (12 crore capacity in 190-200 crore unit IV fluid market); BFS additional 2.5-3%
items.quote: So with roughly 12 crore capacity, 11 crore to 12 crore capacity, we should be having 12 crore, would be what, roughly 6% market share SteriPort alone. BFS would be additional 2.5% to 3% market share.

items.statement: NPPA focus on reducing distribution margins, not manufacturer margins; impact on hospital retail margins, not Amanta bottom line directly
items.quote: So NPPA is very concerned about this MRP, et cetera., and their focus is on reducing the distribution margin, not manufacturer's margin. If they do it, it will be across the board. So distribution margin will get impacted not for Amanta, for everybody.

items.statement: Polymer price volatility (linked to oil) absorbed in Q2; expect normalization in 3-6 months; SVP ramp-up speculative due to tech transfer and regulatory variation timelines (6-9 months)
items.quote: The polymer price is linked to oil, as we know, and I think there was more than 70% increase, and it remained like that for roughly 1 month or so. Then it came down again, it has gone up again, it's coming down. So plastic prices have been very volatile.

items.statement: SteriPort Line 3 expected INR60 crore revenue in FY27; SVP line conservative estimate INR16 crore in FY28; inhalation portfolio potential INR35-60 crore but speculative
items.quote: So we expect it to contribute about INR60 crores in the current financial year, that is FY '27, in top line.

items.statement: Out-licensing/CDMO revenue ~INR25-30 crore annually (ophthalmic portfolio); classic contract manufacturing only 2-3% of revenue
items.quote: So that's where you will see a flavor of CDMO. But I think contract manufacturing, classic contract manufacturing, we don't do much. We hardly 2%, 3% of our revenue, but we do develop products and license out. So that is roughly -- I think this is INR25 crore to INR30 crore revenue.

items.statement: Polymer prices volatile (70%+ spike for ~1 month); price hikes of INR0.70-1.80 per bottle implemented to offset
items.quote: The polymer price is linked to oil, as we know, and I think there was more than 70% increase, and it remained like that for roughly 1 month or so.

items.statement: Strong SteriPort demand across onco, critical care, anesthesia, pediatrics; selling all production; hospital ICU/HDU space growing robustly
items.quote: SteriPort is built on advanced ISBM technology, continues to see strong customer acceptance for its advantages in stability, safety, and reduced patient risk with demand across high-value therapies such as onco care, critical care, anesthesia, and pediatrics.

items.statement: F&D team working on 20 products; validation batch for budesonide suspension completed; tech transfer to new SVP line to take 6-7 months
items.quote: So F&D is working on 20 products, as I mentioned earlier, and major emphasis is on inhalation portfolio. So in fact, yesterday only we did the validation batch for one suspension product, budesonide.

items.statement: Full-year consolidated revenue growth guidance maintained at ~30% including M&A contribution (<5%)
items.quote: In terms of overall guidance, the 30% is inclusive of these M&As which we have planned.

items.statement: Online business expected to continue strong growth; core online grew 34% in H1
items.quote: Our core business is stronger than ever. Our first half core online business grew at 34%.

items.statement: Offline Vidyapeeth expected to turn EBITDA positive this year; overall offline near breakeven
items.quote: We are on track. Last year to this year, Vidyapeeth has already turned profitable at a stand-alone entity and overall offline also will inch toward near breakeven is what we are guiding.

items.statement: PAT positive target for full year FY27
items.quote: As committed at the start of the year, we are holding ourselves accountable to closing the year at PAT positive for the full year.

items.statement: NEET demand delayed in Q1 appeared in Q2; online NEET collections up 27%, enrollments up >30%
items.quote: NEET demand that was delayed in Q1, result came out on 16 July, a month late, showed up in Q2. So, in Q2, we saw NEET demand. Online NEET collections up by 27% and enrollment up over 30%.

items.statement: Government exam enrollments down 24% due to vacancies and forms not released
items.quote: There is one miss, that is the government exams enrollment, down by 24% because of the vacancies and the forms not coming out.

items.statement: Categories beyond JEE/NEET contributed 73.8% of H1 enrollments vs 64.8% last year
items.quote: The base is broadening. Categories beyond JEE NEET contributed 73.8% of H1 enrollments, up from 64.8%.

items.statement: South India ~9% of H1 revenue; AI live translation in 12 Indic languages to drive organic growth
items.quote: Approximately 10% of the revenue, actually 9% of H1 revenue is coming from South.

items.statement: Q2 Pre-Ind AS EBITDA INR233 cr, up 45% YoY at 18.8% margin (+350 bps)
items.quote: Our EBITDA was again highest ever in the quarter at INR233 crores in Q2, pretty much in line with the highest revenue quarter that I just talked about. This is up 45% from INR161 crores from Q2 of last year, translating into 18.8% margin against 15.3% that we did in the same year, an expansion of 350 basis points.

items.statement: Online EBITDA margin 34.4% in Q2; management not reinvesting margins aggressively into marketing
items.quote: In terms of margin, online margins, we are confident that we will deliver as we guided. There are no aggressive plans to shift those margins into marketing.

items.statement: Employee cost (ex-ESOP) down 2.3% YoY in Q2; marketing spend as % of revenue improved 1.2% in H1
items.quote: Our employee costs without ESOP costs were lower by 2.3% as compared to last year quarter, and at H1 level, lower by 2.4%.

items.statement: Q2 unique enrollments up 12.9% to 1.5M; unique transacting users 3.44M vs 3.22M
items.quote: Q2 unique enrollments are up by 12.9% to 1.5 million and 3.44 million unique transacting users or students, up from 3.22 million.

items.statement: Infinity Pro collections up 32%, share of collections rose to 35% from 31%
items.quote: ACPU on unique enrollments up 9.2% to INR4,280 Infinity Pro collections up by 32%, with their share of collections rising to 35% from 31%.

items.statement: Skills enrollment up 10.3x to 1.69 lakh; CA enrollments up 19%; NEET PG enrollments 9,500 up 35%
items.quote: Skills enrollment up 10.3x to 1.69 lakh. CA enrollments up by 19%. NEET PG enrollments at 9,500, up by 35%.

items.statement: Offline H1 enrollments 4.13 lakh (highest ever); Vidyapeeth 66% of H1 offline revenue
items.quote: Offline, a calibrated scale-up, and now we are at 370 centers with the highest ever admission, 4.13 lakh enrollments in H1, delivered 66% of the H1 offline revenue comes from our Vidyapeeth.

items.statement: IPO proceeds INR1,800 cr to be utilized over 2 years; <USD20M allocated for M&A from unidentified bucket
items.quote: We now have INR1,800 crores of IPO proceeds that we will utilize over the next 2 years.

items.statement: Tech/AI spend H1 INR104 cr vs INR70 cr last year (+1% of revenue)
items.quote: Our overall tech spends for H1 were INR104 crores as compared to INR70 crores last year, an increase of 1% as compared to the first half of last year as a percentage of revenues.

items.statement: Offline centers at 370; Vidyapeeth centers 167 vs 117 last year; annual addition 25-30 centers for 2-3 years
items.quote: We are now almost like 167 centers against the 117 centers that we had Vidyapeeth last year.

items.statement: AI live batches to be available in 12 Indic languages next academic year; AI tutor (Tuto) live with 5,000+ learning hours
items.quote: A big breakthrough in AI is all of our important live batches will be available in 12 different Indic languages as we plan the next academic year batches.

items.statement: PW Digital University incorporated (notified Oct 29); will offer UG/PG degrees digitally; admission cycle July next year
items.quote: PW Digital University Incorporated, and it is India's first greenfield digital university, which will solve for our forward integration.

items.statement: AI tutor (Tuto) priced at ~2x ACPU of online batches; cost <INR20/hour tutoring; paid launch at Vishwas Diwas
items.quote: A broader guidance could be that it will be priced at double the ACPU of our online batches. But since we have very little monetization happening of this product in this year, it will be primarily experimental in nature

items.statement: 106M cumulative app downloads; 4.1M DAU with 98 min engagement
items.quote: Quick catch-up on funnel that we have 106 million cumulative app downloads and 4.1 million daily active users, with the engagement of 98 minutes.

items.statement: AI tutor seen as most superior product in learning outcome/engagement; differentiates via test-prep integration and AI-led curriculum
items.quote: In terms of product quality or experience, this is the most superior product in terms of learning outcome and engagement which we have ever seen.

items.statement: PW Digital University notified in Punjab Government Gazette effective Oct 29
items.quote: PWDU has now been officially notified in the Punjab Government Gazette with effect from October 29.

items.statement: Acquired 11% in Sarrthi IAS for INR71 cr; now largest in civil services by enrollments and collections
items.quote: We also acquired 11% in Sarrthi IAS, translating to INR71 crores, with that transaction getting consummated in this quarter.

items.statement: Active M&A discussions with several 100% online assets; advanced stages; expected to close a few in Q3
items.quote: Subject to SEBI disclosure norms, we are now in active discussions with quite a few of them and progressing well in terms of conversations with them. Depending on board approvals, we are confident of closing a few of them in this quarter.

items.statement: Treasury INR5,268 cr as of Sep 30 (incl. INR1,800 cr IPO proceeds); FinZ loan book sold for INR96 cr in Oct
items.quote: As of September 30 this year, our treasury is INR5,268 crores, including IPO proceeds of INR1,800 crores.

items.statement: FinZ NBFC sold entire loan book (INR96 cr) to Auxilo Finserve; exiting direct lending
items.quote: FinZ Finance, PW's wholly owned NBFC subsidiary, signed a deed of assignment on October 3 with Auxilo Finserve Private Limited, an RBI-registered education-focused NBFC, under which FinZ sold its entire loan book for a consolidated consideration of INR96 crores.

items.statement: Employee count declined sequentially in Q2 due to AI efficiencies in content, QC, test-making, evaluation teams
items.quote: Essentially, a lot of AI efficiencies wherein we have earlier also spoken around the content and the QC teams, the test-making team, all of that is now being. And even the gradations that we do in terms of evaluating our subjective copies, all of that is happening now through AI in a much more efficient way.

items.statement: Online ARPU (ACPU) up 9.2% to INR4,280 on unique enrollments
items.quote: ACPU on unique enrollments up 9.2% to INR4,280

items.statement: NEET full-cycle collections still 7% below last year; enrollments 13% lower; offline NEET enrollments 8% lower for academic year
items.quote: Full cycle online NEET collections are still 7% below last year, with enrollments 13% lower. Offline NEET enrollments for the academic year are 8% lower, and we expect this gap to be reflected in full year NEET numbers.

items.statement: Investor Day planned for Nov 18 in Mumbai to showcase AI Tuto, online/offline capabilities
items.quote: We are also planning our first Investor Day on November 18 in Bombay -- in Mumbai, commemorating our first 1 year of stock exchange listing.
