It will have some impact, but we will take time to sort of come back to you in terms of how this is playing as far as demand is concer

items.statement: Aspirational target of 20% revenue growth for Home Appliances in FY27
items.quote: Yes 20% growth isaspirational, but we would like to be somewhere close to that.

items.statement: Diwali shift from Q2 to Q3 muted Q2 growth to 10.5%; Q3 expected to be strong
items.quote: Second quarter, we grew 10.5%, and one of the reasons that you need to understand is t hat this year, there is a shift in Diwali. Diwali last year was on 20th of October, and this year it is on the 8th of November, and therefore there is a shift in Diwali and all other related things, whether it be Dhanteras and all those things

items.statement: Home Appliances PBDIT margin 6.01% in Q2 FY27 vs 7.73% last year; BOM cost up ~4.3% of net revenue
items.quote: PBDIT for the period was INR90.92 crores, and its percentage to revenue is 6.01% as compared to last year's INR102.50 crores, which was 7.73% on revenue.

items.statement: Engineering division achieved budget on top-line and bottom-line; expects same growth pattern if market stable
items.quote: As far as engineering division is concerned, we have achieved the budget in terms of top-line revenue as well as bottom line. This we expect to continue because we do not give guidance, but we expect to continue in the same fashion going forward if the market does not behave erratically or there is a sudden drop.

items.statement: Price hikes taken but not enough to offset commodity and forex driven BOM increase of ~4.3%
items.quote: The commodity increase is not 4%. I said the BOM increase. If you look at the percentage of net revenue of BOM, was about four odd percentage that is there. And we are nowhere close to that when it comes to our price setting figure.

items.statement: Engineering EV plant in Gujarat capex INR103 crore in two phases over FY27 and FY28
items.quote: The capex in Gujarat, where we will be making products for the EV four-wheeler, has a capex of INR103 crores.

items.statement: Steel division furnace annealing capacity increased from 1,500-1,700 to 2,800 tons per month
items.quote: The Steel division has gone for a capex and increased the furnace annealing capacity. So from a level of 1,500 -1,700 tons, we have moved to 2,800 tons per month.

items.statement: Total H1 FY27 capex INR28.58 crore; CWIP INR39.5 crore to be capitalized over 7-8 months
items.quote: Our total capex in the first half, quarter one was INR12.43 crores, and quarter two is INR16.15 crores, totally INR28.58 crores for the half year period.

items.statement: Engineering EV plant in Gujarat under construction; manufacturing to commence Sep-Oct 2027
items.quote: we have acquired land in Gujarat for the EV products that is absol utely 100% EV product. It is under construction now and expect manufacturing to commence by 2027, September, October onwards

items.statement: Engineering chain plant being set up to replace imports; will add to top and bottom line
items.quote: We are setting up our new chain plant because there are certain government guidelines for which we were unable to import chain. As a result, our businesses were affected. What we decided is we go for our own chain plant.

items.statement: Engineering order booking INR220 crore achieved against INR500 crore target; includes ICE, EV lucrative, EV profitable splits
items.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned, yes, sir, in INR220 crores, there are splits of ICE, EV lucrative, EV profitable. Those businesses are there.

items.statement: Engineering revenue mix: 50% two-wheeler, 40% four-wheeler, 10% electrical and three-wheeler combined
items.quote: As far as two-wheelers are concerned, it is around 50% As far as four-wheelers is concerned, it is around 40%. Electrical and three-wheelers all put together are another 10%.

items.statement: Steel division customer mix ~60% internal (IFB plants) and 40% external
items.quote: One is internal customer, that is IFB, different plants having requirements of steel. That is one. Parallelly, we are also scouting for orders which are for outside customers. So, it is a mixed bag. You can say it is around 60/40.

items.statement: Home Appliances maintained market share in washers, refrigerators, ACs; gained in microwave and dishwasher
items.quote: If you look at market shares on the washer, we have maintained our market shares or perhaps slightly gone up. On refrigerator and AC also, it is more or less a similar kind of situation. We have increased as far as microwave and dishwasher is concerned.

items.statement: Industrial washing machine segment: market leader with 20-25% share; market size INR400-500 crore
items.quote: According to the information, whatever we have, we are number one in that segment. Approximately about 20% -25% is the market share.

items.statement: Sales promotion + CSR spend fell to 4.58% of revenue in H1 FY27 from 5.92% last year
items.quote: Sales promotion expenditure, including CSR expenditure, from INR156 crores has come down to INR139 crores. In terms of percentage to revenue total, it is 4.58% in the current year as compared to last year 5.92%.

items.statement: Capital allocation policy 1:1 debt-equity for new projects; net cash positive historically; Battery Can project in Gujarat to follow 1:1
items.quote: Basically, in our company, basically, we are following a principle. Whenever some capex or project is going on, we are following a 1:1 thing, debt versus equity.

items.statement: Evaluated 72+ acquisition targets; seeking synergy, non-disruptive product lines, good customer base, future growth
items.quote: We have seen more than 72 companies till date. There are many more companies which are out for sale, et cetera. Our objective was always to go for a company which has synergy with our product line, number one. Number two, it should not be disruptive product line.

items.statement: Home Appliances revenue grew 14.04% YoY in Q2 FY27 to INR1,512 crore; H1 revenue up 15.34% to INR3,042 crore
items.quote: Revenue for the quarter was INR1,512 crores against last year INR1,327 crores, which is a growth of 14.04%.

items.statement: Lease rental principal paid rose from INR19 crore to INR57 crore in H1 due to Gujarat plant lease payments
items.quote: Out of that, whatever has increased, that is basically the lease rental paid for our Gujarat plant. Whatever we have paid INR37 crores, it is basically coming here. So INR18.99 crores has become INR57.45 crore.

items.statement: Advance tax paid INR11 crore in Q1 and INR14 crore in Q2 FY27 (45% of liability)
items.quote: Advance tax payment, I think we have paid INR11 crores in the first quarter, and second quarter we paid around INR14 crore.

items.statement: Associate IFB Refrigeration loss widened to INR6.23 crore in H1 FY27 from INR3.23 crore due to 8-10% material cost increase
items.quote: We have taken INR6.23 crores in the first half against last year INR3.23 crores. Basically, refrigeration has increased their loss because very high material cost. Material cost has gone up by 8%-10% because basically in their case, most of the materials are oil-based.

items.statement: Staff cost reduced in Q2 by not filling ~100 positions and replacing with less experienced hires
items.quote: We are close to about 100 odd positions we did not fill up. And then you also get the benefit of when somebody new is being brought in, you can bring in a more experienced person. If he's being replaced with a less experienced person, you get that benefit also.

items.statement: Chain plant being set up due to government guidelines restricting chain imports
items.quote: We are setting up our new chain plant because there are certain government guidelines for which we were unable to import chain. As a result, our businesses were affected.

items.statement: Material cost elevated due to commodity price hike and adverse forex impact in Q2 and H1 FY27
items.quote: The decline in PBDIT was primarily driven by an increase in material cost due to hike in commodity price and adverse forex impact.

items.statement: No plan to consolidate manufacturing facilities (3 in Goa, 3-4 in Bangalore, 3 in Kolkata/Howrah)
items.quote: As of now, there is no such planning to consolidate all the plants.

items.statement: No demerger of Engineering division planned currently; focus on executing pipeline projects first
items.quote: See, at this juncture, we don't want to demerge because we have our focus on many things. You might have seen that there are many projects which are already in pipeline, so we want to focus on that, streamline those, and then maybe in future, as we find it right, we will definitely think about your proposal.

items.statement: Expects 20% revenue growth for FY27
items.quote: We expect 20% growth on the revenue figures for this financial year.

items.statement: Targets EBITDA margin upwards of 25% for FY27
items.quote: We should be targeting EBITDA margins upwards of 25% on a total financial year basis.

items.statement: Expects average cost of debt to drop to 12.5% by end of FY27
items.quote: Average cost of debt today will be around 13%, and we expect that to drop down to around 12.5% by end of this financial year.

items.statement: Annuity income from hotel and Club 10 Gymkhana to start from FY30
items.quote: From FY30 onwards the annuity income should start contributing to our P&L.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 sales bookings of 236 units, 2.2 lakh sq ft, INR 173 crore value
items.quote: During the quarter, the company achieved sales bookings of 236 units equivalent to 2.2 lakh square feet of area amounting to INR173 crore in value.

items.statement: H1 FY27 sales bookings of 457 units, 4.52 lakh sq ft, INR 345.8 crore value
items.quote: The company achieved total sales bookings of 457 units equivalent to 4.52 lakh square feet of area amounting to INR345.8 crore in booking value.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 collections of INR 154.5 crore
items.quote: The collections for the quarter stood at INR154.5 crore.

items.statement: H1 FY27 collections of INR 316 crore
items.quote: The total collections for the half year stood at INR316 crore.

items.statement: Unsold ready inventory of 275 units valued at INR 53 crore
items.quote: Our inventory position remains comfortable with unsold ready inventory of around 275 units valued at INR53 crore.

items.statement: Average price per sq ft increased to INR 7,822 in Q2 FY27 from INR 7,500 in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The average price per square foot stood at INR7,822 compared to INR7,500 per square foot in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: Raw material costs increased 4-5% on total construction cost over last 8-9 months
items.quote: With respect to raw material costs, we have seen a total overall increment of 4% to 5% on the total construction cost from the last 8 to 9 months post the Asia war.

items.statement: All cost escalations built into estimate balance cost and updated quarterly
items.quote: We have built in all the escalations. We keep updating this figure every quarter, so as on today, whatever the costs have escalated are built in to our expenses and projected expenses going further.

items.statement: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.97% vs 27.44% YoY; Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin 21%
items.quote: For this half year, our operating revenue stood at INR 265 crore, representing a growth of about 9% year-on-year. EBITDA stands at INR 56 crore with a margin of 20.97%.

items.statement: World Villas hotel construction to take ~3 years, revenues from FY29; management contract with ITC Hotels
items.quote: Construction for the hotel should take about 3 years, and we expect revenues to start from FY29 onwards. It's a management contract model, so we are the owners of the property and ITC will be managing and operating the entire hotel.

items.statement: Club 10 Gymkhana first slab started; 800+ memberships gathered; 108-key budget hotel operator talks ongoing
items.quote: We have started with the first slab. And we've already gathered more than 800-plus memberships on that front. And we have also announced a 108 key budget hotel, for which we are in talks to finalize the operator shortly.

items.statement: Town Villas saleable area now ~58 lakh sq ft, GDV ~INR 4,800 crore; launch pushed to next financial year
items.quote: The total saleable portion is now around 58 lakh square feet of area, which approximately, will have a GDV of INR4,800 crore. Approvals are still under progress. We are seeing some movements, but the launch will get pushed up to the next financial year.

items.statement: World Villas Phase 1: 178 villas launched, ~60 sold; balance sales over next 2 years
items.quote: We have already started the sales and launch of Phase 1, which is about 178 villas. We have been able to sell about 60-odd Villas till date. And we are looking at this balance sales to happen over the next 2 years.

items.statement: Mid-income segment (INR 50L-1.5Cr) seeing good volumes at Kharghar, Panvel, Shilphata; luxury outperforming
items.quote: For us, mid-income segment is anything INR50 lakhs and above up to INR1.5 crore of ticket size. That's where we've seen good volumes happening across our sites at Kharghar, Panvel and Shilphata. That segment is doing well. Obviously, the luxury segment is performing better than these 2 segments as

items.statement: Demand steady over last year; prices rising in major markets; buyers moving up price ladder; supply running ahead of absorption
items.quote: We see that the demand has held steady over the last 1 year. Prices continue to rise in every major market, which tells us that end-user demand remains healthy. There are 2 standouts in this. First, buyers are moving up the price ladder, and second, the supply is running ahead of absorption.

items.statement: Affordable housing demand healthy but affordability and own contribution remain challenges; mid-income absorption good
items.quote: However, affordability and own cont ributions remain a challenge for the end user, the customer, the homebuyer , so that is what will have to be looked at going forward because disposable incomes are available, but they are being utilized for other purchases and not being prioritized by the affordable class to buy the first home

items.statement: Net debt INR 827 crore, unsecured loans INR 435 crore; average cost of debt ~13%
items.quote: The net worth of the company stood at INR47 5 crore, net debt at INR827 crore, and unsecured loans amounted to INR435 crore

items.statement: Reduced STCI debt, replaced with ICICI Bank at 8.6% vs earlier 11.75%
items.quote: Just for example, we have reduced our STCI debt and replaced with ICICI Bank. It was earlier at 11.75%. Today, it is at 8.6%, so we've been able to considerably reduce cost for certain loans that we have taken.

items.statement: Operating cash flows turned positive; hotel and Gymkhana in separate entity, financed separately; other projects cash flow positive
items.quote: Yes. The hotel is in a different entity. And even the revenue recognition method for the Gymkhana will be different. Obviously, these 2 assets are going to be financed for their construction going forward also, but the other projects are expecting and turning to be positive with respect to cash flows in terms of operations.

items.statement: Signed agreement with ITC Hotels for 227-room luxury hotel (44 suites) under Mementos brand at World Villas on 10-acre land parcel
items.quote: On 24th of September, we signed an agreement with ITC Hotels Limited to develop a 227-room luxury hotel, which includes 44 suites under the Mementos by ITC brand. This will sit on a total 10-acre land parcel within the 90-acre development at World Villas.

items.statement: Shilphata JV is 14% area sharing; landowner gets 14%, company retains 86%
items.quote: Shilphata JV is 14% area sharing JV. The landowner is getting 14% area, and the balance is to us for development.

items.statement: H1 FY27 average price per sq ft INR 7,650 vs INR 7,500 in H1 FY26
items.quote: The average price per square foot stood at INR7,650 per square feet in H1 FY27 compared to INR 7,500 per square feet in H1 FY26.

items.statement: Interest rates may spike another 25-50 bps in coming quarters; affordability challenge for affordable housing buyers
items.quote: And it may be spiked up more in the coming quarters as well by another 25 to 50 basis points. With respect to demand, there is good demand for affordable and mid-income housing. However, affordability and own cont ributions remain a challenge for the end user

items.statement: Q2 FY27 EBITDA decline due to project mix; gross margin impact from project mix not commodity inflation
items.quote: These numbers reported in the P&L are due to a project mix. With respect to raw material costs, we have seen a total overall increment of 4% to 5% on the total construction cost from the last 8 to 9 months post the Asia war.

items.statement: Total land under development 320 acres; 99.5 acres at Chowk (Town Villas), 7-8 acres at Panvel not yet started
items.quote: 99.5 acres at Chowk for Town Villas and another 7-8 acres at Panvel. That's the land bank we have, which has not started yet. And as a company, the total land that we are working on today is at 320 acres.

items.statement: Jodhpur portfolio steady; sell-and-build model; clubhouse completion driving better sales velocity
items.quote: a steady market, steady portfolio. We're seeing steady sales happening in that project, and land is already acquired, approvals are already in place. Our strategy is to develop 1 building at a time and take it forward in that way. We don't want to put in a lot of capex now. It's totally sell -and-build model

items.statement: Data center opportunities limited at Panvel outskirts due to inadequate electricity/water infrastructure; hospitality better suited for Chowk/Khalapur
items.quote: Well, the land that we are currently having where we can expand beyond residential are located in the outskirts of Panvel area, so data center opportunities are limited here because the infrastructure for data center with respect to electricity and water is still not adequate. With respect to hospitality, it is adequate.

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue growth guidance to 35-40% from earlier 30%
items.quote: But looking at the current demand scenario, we are revising our guidance to around 35% to 40% growth for the full year in FY27.

items.statement: FY28 revenue growth guidance of 55-60% over FY27
items.quote: And if we talk about in FY28, as you are asking, so that is, I think, a 60% growth, we can say 55% to 60% growth compared to FY27 in FY28

items.statement: H2 FY27 EBITDA margin expected around 18%
items.quote: So we can say earlier this -- our guidance of 30% growth for FY27. But looking at the current demand scenario, we are revising our guidance to around 35% to 40% growth for the full year in FY27.

items.statement: FY27 full year EBITDA margin expected around 16%
items.quote: And for the full year on an average basis, it would be around 16% and if you are asking for FY28, then in FY28 on a conservative basis, given the full year production of HFC-32, the EBITDA margin will be in the range of -- as an overall average would be around 24% to 26%.

items.statement: HFC-32 plant commissioning target Q3 FY27
items.quote: Our upcoming HFC-32 refrigerant gas project continues to progress as scheduled with target commissioning in Q3 FY27.

items.statement: HFC-32 utilization 20% in Q4 FY27, 95% in FY28, 90-100% thereafter
items.quote: So in this financial year, I think we are expecting to utilize about 20% of that utilization in the last quarter only because we'll get that benefit only in the last quarter, mainly. And next year, we expect about 95% of utilization.

items.statement: HFC-32 volume 2,000-3,000 tons in FY27, 85-90% capacity utilization in FY28
items.quote: We expect to be in the range of about 2,000 to 3,000 tons in FY27. So it depends on how fast we stabilize in 10 days or 20 days, that's the only difference. And then the coming financial year, we should be utilizing about 85% to 90% of our plant.

items.statement: FY27 total capex INR440-450 crores including INR360 crores spent on HFC-32
items.quote: So total capex would be in the range of INR440 crores to INR450 crores, including all.

items.statement: FY28 minimum capex INR250 crores for AHF and solar grade expansion
items.quote: Currently, on a conservative side, next year guidance would be INR250 crores for the AHF and solar grade DHF.

items.statement: Solar grade DHF capacity increased from 20,000 to 25,000 MTPA via debottlenecking
items.quote: During the q uarter, we increased our solar grade DHF manufacturing capacity from 20,000 metric ton per annum to 25,000 metric ton per annum through debottlenecking, representing a 25% increase in installed capacity by incurring nominal capital expenditure

items.statement: Plan to double solar grade DHF capacity to 50,000 MTPA
items.quote: Second is to double our solar grade capacity from existing 25,000 metric ton to 50,000 metric ton for the potential demand coming from the solar industry.

items.statement: Plan to expand AHF capacity from 30,000 to 45,000 MTPA by adding third plant
items.quote: While in near term, we are planning to expand our existing AHF capacity from 30,000 metric ton to 45,000 metric ton, so addition of 15,000 metric tons without cannibalizing our existing external sales with our captive raw material need for HFC-32.

items.statement: AHF capacity currently 30,000 MTPA (two 15,000 MTPA plants)
items.quote: If you see, total our AHF capacity is 30,000 metric ton. We have a 2 plant of 15,000 metric ton each. So we produced 30,000 metric ton AHF.

items.statement: Solar grade DHF demand robust, capacity utilization 90-95% in Q2
items.quote: During the quarter, demand for solar grade DHF remained robust, and we continue to focus on production ramp-up and fulfilling customer requirements.

items.statement: Indian solar cell capacity 30 GW expected to reach 100 GW in 3 years, driving solar grade DHF demand from 25,000 to 100,000 MTPA
items.quote: Because currently, if you see Indian solar cell manufacturing capacity is 30 gigawatt, which is expected to increase at 100 gigawatt in next 3 years due to which the solar grade demand, which is currently 25,000 metric ton, which is expected to grow to 1 lakh metric ton once all the capacity of solar comes on ground.

items.statement: Gross profit per ton stable in AHF; margin % moderated due to higher realizations increasing revenue base
items.quote: On the gross margin front, in our AHF business, our gross profit per ton has remained largely stable. The moderation in gross profit margin percentage is primarily attributable to higher product realizations, which have increased the revenue base and conse quently lowered the margin percentage despite stable gross profit per ton

items.statement: Q2 FY27 gross margin 32.5% vs 39% YoY and 37% QoQ
items.quote: Gross profit for Q2 FY27 stood at INR75 crores compared with INR66 crores in the corresponding quarter of last ye ar. However, gross margins moderated to 32.5% compared with 39% in Q2 of FY26 and 37% in the preceding quarter

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to normalize to 15-16% from Q3 FY27
items.quote: So we expect EBITDA margins to normalize back to 15% to 16% range from this quarter and with further substantial margin expansion anticipated once our value-added HFC-32 capacity achieves commercialization.

items.statement: Sulphur prices increased 5x from INR25/kg to INR120/kg over past year; now stabilizing
items.quote: So if you see in the sulphur prices in last 1 year, it is sulphur price has increased by 5x. I think if you see from INR25 in last October, November, sulphur price of INR25 per kg in November 2025. And if you see in the last month, in the month of September, it was around INR120 per kg.

items.statement: Sulphur price pass-through lag 30-45 days in contracts (monthly or quarterly weighted average)
items.quote: See, it is not immediately passed on. They are passed on with a lag. So the formula is generally worked in the contract with the quarter weighted average price basis or the monthly average price basis. With some customers, it's quarterly; with some customers, it is monthly. So generally, a 30-day lag is there where the prices before they have been passed on to the customers.

items.statement: HFC-32 contract prices now ~$7/kg (up from $5.5) due to raw material cost formula; spot at market
items.quote: Our contractual price is close to $7. And the spot price, the market which we have will play as per the market. So the market remains elevated at $7 plus, we'll sell at $7 plus. If it goes around $6.8, $6.7 levels, we'll go at that price.

items.statement: HFC-32 contract/spot mix ~65/35 to 60/40
items.quote: Should be 65%-35% kind of thing, yes, 65%-35%, 60%-40%. 5% here and there.

items.statement: Fluorspar inventory built to 6-7 months (from normal 3-4 months) due to geopolitical risk; INR50 crore increase offset by creditor increase
items.quote: So currently, due to this geopolitical environment currently, we have increased our normal inventory of fluo rspar was around 3 months. But now currently, we have imported one consignment. And due to this, our inventory has increased to around 6 to 7 months

items.statement: Fluorspar annual contract; current stock covers 6-7 months at preponed procurement
items.quote: For the fluorspar, we generally do the contract annually only. So currently, whatever is this pending quantity is that, they have taken, we have preponed and we have built at our factory only.

items.statement: MDC sourcing not a challenge: 8 domestic producers, 550,000 MTPA capacity vs 400,000 MTPA demand; contracts in place domestic and international
items.quote: Domestically, there are active -- about 8 MDC producers. And the capacity is huge. Chloromethane's capacity is huge. So MDC production is close to around -- they can -- actually installed capacity is around 550,000 metric tons. And demand is not more than 400,000 metric tons including the demand -- captive demand for HFCs also.

items.statement: MOU for 5,000 MTPA HFC-32 to convert to contract in 1-1.5 months before commercial production
items.quote: We'll get it done before this financial year gets closed and our commercial production starts. So in next 1, 1.5 months, you can expect that to convert into a contract.

items.statement: HFC-32 customer qualifications underway; some approved, some under evaluation; trade sales from December, OEM from January
items.quote: See, we have already started the qualifications with some customers. At a couple of places, we have already been qualified. And some places, the samples are under evaluation. So generally, it takes 2 to 3 months to get the evaluation and approval process done. So we are in process. And I think from January onwards or December onwards only, we'll start selling our commercial production in the marke

items.statement: Inventory days increased 48 to 64; payables days increased 13 to 33 offsetting inventory build
items.quote: Creditors, if you see inventory days increased from 48 days to 64 days. But there is a simultaneous increase in payables from 13 days to 36 (Errata: Actual number to be read as 33) days.

items.statement: HFC-32 project funded INR350 crores equity (QIP INR250 cr + preferential INR100 cr) and INR50 crores debt
items.quote: So if you see, out of this INR395 crores of -- out of which we have raised INR350 crores, INR250 crores by way of QIP and INR100 crores by preferential. So INR350 crores by way of equity and remaining around INR50 crores by way of debt.

items.statement: Raised INR350 crores in H1 FY27: QIP INR250 crores (June) + preferential INR100 crores (Sept) including INR61 crores from promoter Anupam Rasayan
items.quote: The successful completion of this fund raise has further strengthened our financial positions and provides us with greater flexibility to support our ongoing expansion plans and future growth initiatives.

items.statement: Promoter Anupam Rasayan invested INR61 crores in preferential issue
items.quote: including an investment of approximately INR61 crores from our promoter, Anupam Rasayan

items.statement: Adjusted ROE 18% and adjusted ROCE 19% for H1 FY27 (excluding fund raise proceeds)
items.quote: The company's adjusted return on equity for H1 FY27 stood at approximately 18%, while adjusted return on capital employed stood at approximately 19%.

items.statement: Fixed asset turnover 3.5x annualized H1 FY27 vs 3.4x FY26
items.quote: Our fixed asset turnover ratio stood at approximately 3.5x on an annualized basis for H1 FY27 compared with 3.4x in FY26, reflecting improved revenue generation relative to our fixed asset base.

items.statement: Unutilized QIP/preferential funds INR157 crores committed to ongoing projects, to be used by end FY27
items.quote: So if you see, unutilized amount is INR157 crores, which is mainly committed towards ongoing project, which will be utilized by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Geopolitical risk in West Asia prompting fluorspar buffer stock; lead times increased due to container availability
items.quote: Given the ongoing geopolitical developments in West Asia and the potential risk of disruption to international supply chains, we undertook bulk procurement of critical raw materials, primarily fluorspar towards the end of the quarter, leading to a higher-than-normal working capital.

items.statement: Target specialty mix 65-70% in FY28 and ~80% medium term; net debt reduction of Rs 300-500 crore over next two years
items.value: 65-70% specialty mix; Rs 300-500 cr debt reduction
items.quote: Our next year target should be anywhere between 65%-70% and in the medium term we would ideally like to take this number to close to 80%. The net debt we are expecting to reduce by roughly Rs. 300-500 crore over the next two years.

items.statement: FY27 effective tax rate expected at -6% to -7% (tax writeback)
items.quote: For FY27, we expect effective tax rate to be tax income in the range of -6% to -7% (tax writeback).

items.statement: US film business revenue target >$100 million in FY28
items.quote: We are anticipating this to grow even further next year and our target is to exceed $100 million target for the next year.

items.statement: Cosmo Consumer and Zigly projected >60% growth in FY27
items.quote: We continue to project more than 60% growth in both the businesses and I think we are very well on track on both the businesses to achieve that level of growth.

items.statement: Specialty chemicals medium-term revenue ~Rs 500 crore with 20%+ ROCE
items.quote: Our medium term, we see this business building at close to Rs. 500 crore revenue with a 20% plus ROCE supported by sustained growth across these three verticals.

items.statement: Film business ~90% utilized; 8-10% volume headroom remains
items.quote: From the volume perspective, we are roughly 90% utilized and we still have roughly 8-10% potential to increase our volumes further.

items.statement: Specialty + semi-specialty ~60% of total volume; H1 FY27 specialty volume grew 20%
items.quote: Our specialty and semi-specialty taken together is running close to 60% of total volume of the company which is growing by about 10% CAGR growth rate from last six years, although our H1'27 growth rate has improved to 20% on the specialty side.

items.statement: New coating and barrier sheet lines expected ~20%+ margins
items.quote: Both businesses have roughly 20 plus percent margins on it.

items.statement: Normalized Q2 FY27 EBITDA Rs 159 crore (24% YoY growth) after removing Rs 24.8 cr customs refund and Rs 7 cr inventory loss
items.quote: Excluding both items, EBITDA for the quarter would have been Rs. 159 crore, representi ng 24% year -on-year growth

items.statement: Cosmo Consumer H1 FY27 revenue 2.6x YoY; Zigly H1 FY27 revenue +58% YoY
items.quote: Both the consumer businesses, Cosmo Consumer, which is the window films, paint protection film and ceramic coatings and Zigly, our pet care business continue to scale up with 260% and 58% topline growth respectively in H1 '27 year-on-year basis.

items.statement: US film business Q2 FY27 volume +35% YoY; FY27 revenue ~$70 million
items.quote: US has grown 35% (volume terms) in the last quarter. It is expected to do roughly $70 million in this financial year.

items.statement: Net working capital increased Rs 148 cr in H1 FY27 due to higher RM prices post West Asia war
items.quote: Net debt at September 26 has reduced to Rs. 1057 crore which is 1.9 x to EBITDA. This is as against Rs. 1159 crore at March end and this reduction of close to Rs. 100 crore despite net working capital increase by Rs. 148 crore due to increased raw material prices post West Asia war.

items.statement: Renewable power to reach ~2/3 of requirement by next year; estimated annual power-cost savings Rs 25-30 cr
items.quote: By next year, renewable power is expected to account for approximately two-thirds of our power requirements. This will support our sustainability objectives and generate estimated annual power-cost savings of approximately Rs. 25 crore to Rs. 30 crore.

items.statement: Specialty focus areas: graphics, lidding, labels, synthetic paper, security films
items.quote: But our biggest focus lies in graphics, lidding, labels and synthetic paper. And in the times to come, we're also looking at security as one of the critical areas to focus upon.

items.statement: PPF dealer network expanded from 150 to 250 in Q2; window film dealers ~150 across 100+ cities; 4 Cosmo car care centres
items.quote: To capture this opportunity, we increased our paint protection film dealer network from 150 at the end of the previous quarter to 250 during the quarter. Our wind ow film network has also expanded to 150 dealers across more than 100 cities. We now operate four Cosmo car care centres

items.statement: Only one other competitor in India for barrier sheet line; among world's largest in films & coatings
items.quote: In fact as regards barrier sheet line, we have only one other competitor in India. We already have one barrier sheet line and we are adding the second one now. As far as coating is there, we are one of the largest players in the world when it comes to films and coatings

items.statement: Currency note tender participation confidential; NDAs prevent disclosure
items.quote: It is a confidential matter. Whatever is available in the public domain, it is there for the investors to look at. We have NDAs and we cannot share much on this.

items.statement: Port congestion situation fluctuates fortnightly; linked to West Asia crisis; Q2 slightly improved vs Q1
items.quote: The situation continues to change every fortnight. Conditions improved last quarter, but we have again encountered certain port-related challenges during the current quarter. We are monitoring the situation closely. As mentioned, it is linked primarily to the West Asia crisis and therefore remains difficult to predict.

items.statement: Raw material price volatility linked to West Asia crisis; timing of reversal unpredictable
items.quote: Raw material prices have increased further this month. The market remains highly volatile, and it is difficult to predict when a reversal may occur, as movements are currently linked to the West Asia crisis. Raw material prices may decline at some point, b ut the timing is difficult to predict

items.statement: Zigly transaction options under evaluation to unlock valuation; next growth phase should not weigh on Cosmo balance sheet
items.quote: See the reason for us to talk about the potential transaction was that we believe that the Zigly's valuation is not rightly reflected in the Cosmo First valuation. So we continue to evaluate ways to bring that out. We will come back to you and inform the exchanges when we have something concrete to talk about but we continue to explore options which help us achieve that objective. The key objectiv

items.statement: India PPF market ~Rs 500 cr, growing ~30% YoY; penetration 1-2% vs ~15% in China
items.quote: India's paint protection film market is estimated at approximately Rs. 500 crore and is growing by about 30% year on y ear. Industry penetration remains at only 1% to 2%, compared with approximately 15% in China

items.statement: Exit FY27 AUM target Rs 4,200 crore range
items.quote: On the question of AUM, we have crossed INR3,500 crores, and we would expect anywhere to end or exit the year closer to a Rs. 4,200 crores range.

items.statement: CV to break even by end FY27, used car by Q1 FY28
items.quote: Gradually, as these two businesses grow, we expect a CV to break even by the end of this year and car to break even by the first quarter of next year.

items.statement: Bank borrowing cost to fall another 10 bps by March 2027
items.quote: I am expecting another 0.10 to come down by March-end.

items.statement: Impairment cost to be arrested at up to 2% by March 2027
items.quote: So, we want to arrest that cost and it has to be up 2% as we close our March 2027 results.

items.statement: Industry 2W grew 16% in H1 FY27; company disbursements up 21% YoY in Q2
items.quote: Two-wheeler segment has recorded about 16% growth, and both passenger as well as commercial vehicle has registered very healthy growth rate in H1. And against this industry backdrop, we achieved a cumulative disbursement in excess of Rs. 1,200 crores.

items.statement: NII rose to Rs 94.46 crore in Q2 FY27 from Rs 72.15 crore YoY
items.quote: While in this quarter, it comes from Rs. 94.46 crores. So, there is an increase in the NII by 16.80 crores.

items.statement: Blended yield improved as co-lending share fell from 25% to near zero
items.quote: In last quarter, if you see Q2 of last year, my co-lending portion was around 25% of the entire book. So, the blended yield was only 18.5%. Now, as an incremental portion, it's almost zero now.

items.statement: AUM crossed Rs 3,530 crore, up 25% YoY
items.quote: So, in this quarter, the company has done fresh business of Rs. 677 crores. We will do a detail as well, which has taken the company overall AUM to Rs. 3530 Cr.. With these 25%s, year-on-year growth has been achieved by the company.

items.statement: Co-lending book down 52% YoY to Rs 382 crore
items.quote: The balance of the entire Co-Lending Book has been dropped down to Rs. 382 crores, while it was Rs. 791 crores, same time in last year. So, this has been dropped by 52%.

items.statement: CV/CE and used car disbursements grew over 100% YoY in H1
items.quote: Our commercial vehicle and construction equipment disbursements increased significantly by over 100%, and so has been the case with our used car financing.

items.statement: Target car and CV to reach 50-60% of book in two years
items.quote: For the next 2 years, car and CV should occupy more than 50% or closer to 60% of the overall book.

items.statement: GNPA 4.61%, NNPA 2.75%, PCR 50% in Q2 FY27
items.quote: the GNPA has been reported as 4.61 %, while the NNPA w as 2.75%. The company has an unchanged PCR, which is 50% as compared to the previous three quarters

items.statement: Forward flow to NPA fell to 0.50% from 0.78% YoY
items.quote: In the last year, we had a forward flow of about 0.78%, which has come down to 0.5%, which is a very, very significant improvement.

items.quote: The Kesh King Scalp First is again another, we wanted to expand Kesh King brand. This time it is a premium product, pricing almost in the range of INR500-INR1,000.

items.quote: On capital allocation, we completed our share buyback worth INR281 crores last month to buy back 73 lakh shares. The Board has also approved the first interim dividend of INR5 per share, which would amount to a payout of INR214 crores.

items.statement: Consolidated revenue grew 36% to INR1,088 crore; domestic volume growth 43%
items.quote: Our consolidated revenue grew by 36% to INR1,088 crores. Domestic sales grew by 49%, driven by volume growth of 43%.

items.quote: Looking at the first half of FY27, revenue stood at INR2,127 crores, up 25%. EBITDA was at INR449 crores, up 15%, and profit before tax INR388 crores, going by 15%.

items.statement: Healthcare grew 11% with pain management in teens and OTC in high teens; Medico steady single-digit
items.quote: Healthcare range grew by 11%, with pain management range growing in the teen s. OTC portfolio also performed well and grew in high teens. Medico range posted a steady single-digit growth.

items.statement: Management will review guidance in December; not revising now due to evolving West Asia situation
items.quote: We'll review our guidance in the month of December. Right now, we are just keeping quiet as far as guidance is concerned because the situation is evolving.

items.statement: EXIM throughput up 4.57% and domestic up 4.22% in H1 FY27; Nepal business up 138% to 107 rakes in Q2
items.quote: Throughput in the H1 in the EXIM segment has increased by 4.57% and domestic segment, 4.22%, total 4.48%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin on total income at 25.79% in Q2 FY27; rail freight margin 28.3%, overall operating margin ~31.5%
items.quote: So EBITDA, we have maintained a very handsome EBITDA if you consider total income, then the EBITDA is 25.79%.

items.statement: Reduced upper deck rates for EXIM traffic from Dadri to JNPT by 10-20% and EXIM rates at Tughlakabad by 10-20% to incentivize volumes
items.quote: Dadri, we have revised the upper deck prices, 40 feet container prices to get more double stack traffic. It is depending upon the stream and the circuit, it amounts to 10% to 20%.

items.statement: Capex INR299.75 cr in Q2, INR418.05 cr in H1; internal target INR945 cr for FY27, on track for INR900+ cr
items.quote: The capex, our MOU target is INR800 crores, but internal target is INR945 crores and in the first half, as I told you, we have done INR418 crores.

items.statement: Added 13 new rakes in Q2 (32 in H1), total rakes 456; added 414 containers and 7 reach stackers; 1,100 tank containers now, 2,000 in pipeline
items.quote: We have added 13 new rakes in the quarter, taking the total 32 in the half year. Total number of rakes now stands at 456.

items.statement: Signed contract with GAIL for fertilizer traffic expected from November end; new reefer services from Hyderabad to JNPT for pharma
items.quote: GAIL, we have signed a contract with them. Container Corporation of That traffic is expected towards November end, and it will add further volumes to our domestic market

items.quote: JNPT, we had the market share of 63.75% Mundra 34.65% and Pipavav 47.81%. This is as far as this quarter is concerned.

items.quote: The JNPT rail coefficient for the quarter was 12.88%. Actually, what has happened in the ports, the transshipments have increased.

items.statement: Average lead distance 817 km in Q2 (+4.9% YoY); EXIM lead 722 km, domestic lead 1,315 km
items.quote: The average lead in Q2 has increased to 817 kilometers from 779 kilometers, that is an increase of 4.9%.

items.statement: Empty running cost EXIM INR21.73 cr, domestic INR77.09 cr, total INR98.82 cr in Q2; EXIM down marginally, domestic up marginally
items.quote: Empty running cost for EXIM is in this quarter is INR21.73 crores and domestic is INR77.09 crores. Total is INR98.82 crores.

items.statement: Shipping revenue INR12 cr in H1 FY27; targeting INR50 cr for full year; coastal shipping on hold due to market turbulence
items.quote: In the first half in the H1, our turnover from the shipping activities was INR12 crores up to September -- April to September INR12 crores. We are hoping that in the next half, we'll have good turnover and we will end the year with about INR50 crores of revenue from the shipping activities.

items.statement: Declared dividend of INR1.9 per share in Q2; total H1 dividend INR3.5 per share
items.quote: We have announced a dividend of INR1.9 per share, and the total dividend has now gone up to INR3.5 per share in the first half.

items.statement: West Asia crisis disrupting trade routes; Strait of Hormuz closed for container traffic; shipping schedules erratic; empty container shortage
items.quote: As all of you are aware, a ceasefire, which was announced in the Gulf, it collapsed in a few days and the Strait of Hormuz for container traffic remains practically closed.

items.quote: The primary -- the reason of increase in operating expenses is a little bit of increase in staff expense, a little bit increase in our handling expenses because of fuel price rise and other general price rise.

items.quote: We are developing 2 new terminals. One is at Salawas near Jodhpur that is likely to be commissioned very shortly, maybe this month. And another terminal is at Pathri Haridwar that is getting commissioned maybe in this financial year itself.

items.quote: Right now, we hope that whatever guidance we have given in domestic, that will hold at least for the H2 part. Right now, I'm not -- we are not giving because it is not correct to give revised guidance so frequently then it loses its sanctity.

items.quote: In 1 day in Dadri, we loaded 8 trains and 7 trains have double stacked. Our volumes and performance in Dadri, Varnama, they have increased very significantly.

items.quote: The commodities, the pattern of tariff has shifted from the old system of slabs to GTKM-based slabs that is in bulk cement, fertilizer, fly ash and food grains.

items.quote: So whatever was the remaining volumes for that competition was there. So in order to keep our market share up and continue to carry the domestic volumes, we had to at places yields as far as our rates are concerned in some places.

items.quote: Bulk cement in tank containers, it has continued to increase. In this quarter, we have added 195 more containers. Total containers have increased to about 1,100 and the volume we have reported about 12,000 TEUs vis-a-vis the entire year of 14,000 TEUs last year.

items.statement: New LCL exports from Dadri to Dronagiri and JNPT; new EXIM long lead GCTK to IDBR; reefer exports up 18.48%, DPD exports up 7.48%, laden exports up 3.28%
items.quote: New EXIM long lead GCTK to IDBR. We have now got 18.48% growth in reefer exports. We have started new reefer services from Hyderabad to JNPT carrying pharma products.

items.statement: Standalone profit before tax INR462 cr in Q2 (INR154 cr/month); highest ever operating turnover INR2,373 cr and total income INR2,466 cr in Q2
items.quote: The profits -- stand-alone profit before tax has been INR462 crores, that is amounting INR154 crores per month, a very remarkable performance given the adverse circumstances through which we have gone.

items.statement: Reiterated full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance of more than 50% and medium-term target of 20-25% CAGR to cross ₹1,500+ crore by FY30 with 200-300 bps EBITDA margin expansion
items.quote: we reiterate our full-year guidance of more than 50% revenue growth in FY27. Over the medium term, we remain on track for a 20% to 25% revenue CAGR to cross ₹1,500+ crore by FY30, alongside a 200 to 300 basis points EBITDA margin expansion.

items.statement: Internal target of 22% EBITDA margin; expects Q3 FY27 margin between 19-20% and full-year FY27 blended margin above 19%
items.quote: The internal target is 22%. Next quarter, we think our revenue numbers should increase, and accordingly, margins should go up to between 19% to 20% in the next quarter. Fingers crossed for the last quarter.

items.statement: CDMO partnerships with Viatris and Aerotex on track to deliver ₹100-130 crore incremental revenue in FY27 and ₹200-220 crore over two years
items.quote: Commercial partnerships with major CDMO partners are progressing rapidly on track to del iver ₹100 to ₹130 crore in incremental revenue in FY27, and a total of ₹200 to ₹220 crore over two years.

items.statement: ₹250 crore growth capex covering Samba EU-GMP upgrade, Derabassi warehouse, new R&D infrastructure and capacity debottlenecking fully on track
items.quote: Our ₹250 crore growth capex, covering the Samba EU-GMP upgrade, Derabassi warehouse, new R&D infrastructure, and capacity debottlenecking is fully on track.

items.quote: Regarding utilization from the Jammu/Samba plant: since expansion is also happening, the production area is available for us, and I think we are utilizing it at 70% to 75% of our capacities.

items.quote: The land has already been acquired. The requisite approvals are in place now, construction has started, and we hope to shift our warehouse from the existing facility outside in the next 10 to 12 months.

items.statement: Samba EU-GMP/PIC/S upgrade on schedule; ANVISA (Brazil) inspection expected in Q4 FY27; European PIC/S approval expected anytime next year
items.quote: Currently, the capex is underway, and we are expecting the visit not from PIC/S, but from ANVISA (Brazil) probably in the last quarter. Regarding your query on the PIC/S European approval, we expect this to happen anytime next year.

items.quote: On new customers, approximately ₹80 to ₹90 crore this year has come from newly acquired customers.

items.statement: Working capital requirement estimated at ~₹350 crore at ₹1,500 crore revenue by FY30; current debtor cycle 75 days, target 60 days; inventory target minimum 90 days
items.quote: If we achieve a turnover of approximately ₹1,500 crore by FY30, the working capital requirement should be in the range of ₹350-odd crore.

items.quote: We remain completely net debt-free with robust cash and liquid reserves.

items.quote: Majority of key starting materials and APIs are sourced from Synthimed. China imports are limited to only one or two molecules. Total purchases from Synthimed in this financial year should be approximately ₹100 crore out of total raw material procurement of around ₹400 crore.

items.statement: Global product registrations crossed 900+ across 85 countries backed by 2,100+ filed dossiers; 330+ additional registrations expected in FY27; ~100-150 already secured in H1 FY27
items.quote: Global product registrations have crossed 900+ across 85 countries, backed by 2,100+ filed dossiers. Over 330 additional product registrations are expected in FY27.

items.quote: There are 11 molecules which should be ready by FY28–FY29, and in FY29-FY30 there are two molecules. They are in different therapeutic categories, mainly antibiotic, urology, anti protozoals, ulcerative colitis.

items.quote: We hold a 7.80% stake in Synthimed. The valuation depends on market transactions; we believe the business should be valued between ₹7,000 to ₹8,000 crore at this point in time.

items.quote: Raw Material Expenses declined to 45.15% of revenue from 49.38% a year ago, reflecting business mix optimization and operating leverage.

items.quote: In regulated markets, our CDMO supplies are partner -driven and non -competing with innovator partners. In semi -regulated markets, our long -standing brand presence, established distribution netwo rks, dedicated regional teams, and competitive pricing provide strong differentiation.

items.quote: We have seen consistent growth from Q1 to Q2, and expect this momentum to continue into Q3. As of now, orders are in hand, raw materials are lined up, and manufacturing facilities are equipped. The primary task is execution, to manufacture and deliver.

items.statement: No impact from NPPA price reductions as product portfolio does not fall under revised NPPA price control list

items.quote: In our own-branding business, we mostly work on advance or LC terms, so the working capital cycle is slightly lower in Own Brands as compared to the CDMO business.

items.quote: The revenue numbers for export in this quarter was approximately ₹190-odd crore. Out of this, CDMO revenue was approximately ₹65 crore, and ₹125 crore was for our own-branding products.

items.quote: Detailed information on capex can be separately shared via ConfideLeap Partners, as multiple capex initiatives are ongoing with different timelines.

items.quote: Different markets take different times. Generally, it takes 1 to 1.5 years for product registration, and commercial revenue generation typically scales from year two.

items.statement: CDMO contracts with Viatris structured on defined transfer pricing terms; technology for Ibuprofen shared by Viatris, cannot sell to other customers
items.quote: We have agreed on defined transfer pricing terms with them.

items.quote: Yes, there is no meaningful CapEx that is planned for the year. items.quote: The closing order book as of the 30th of September 2026 was ₹1,452 crores, which comprised of ₹404 crores of normal EPC and equipment orders and ₹1,048 crores of long -duration O&M contract orders.

items.quote: Yes, there is no meaningful CapEx that is planned for the year. What I can share with you is what we may look at is some steam improvement in efficiency measures, but again, nothing terribly significant.

items.quote: I think integrated and multi-feed sugar companies will be beneficiaries of this very constrained policy, which gives us the flexibility to be able to move between feedstocks. However, single feed plants, I think, will have a very uphill task in terms of trying to achieve profitability over the next ethanol supply year.

items.quote: The closing inventory as of the 30th of September 2026 stood at 1.03 lakh metric tonnes compared to 1.69 lakh metric tonnes a year ago, which also, of course, had an impact of reducing our working capital intensity. items.quote: The new labor code has forced us to revise our wage costs. items.statement: Management avoids providing formal revenue growth guidance but targets secular 3-4% quarterly growth to reach double-digit year-over-year growth
items.quote: Clearly, we avoid putting a guidance in place. So I would not go down the path of providing the guidance on that.

items.statement: AI PDLC replacing SDLC across clients; enterprises adopting agentic AI and legacy modernization driving pipeline quality
items.quote: AI PDLC, which is the AI in product development life cycle is fast replacing the SDLC as it used to be a software development life cycle across the board.

items.quote: The adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 124.4 crores or $13 million, which is at an all-time high of 20.2% as a percentage of revenue and records a year over year growth of 47.4%.

items.statement: Trailing 12-month ACV bookings at $82.9 million, flat for three quarters but with transformative deal mix shift
items.quote: We continued our momentum on bookings quarter-over-quarter, maintaining in this quarter, again. We have $82.9 million in TTM ACV of bookings.

items.statement: Investing in expanding AI talent bench and enterprise sales hiring; SG&A optimized via internal AI agentic operations
items.quote: We will further invest in expanding that team, maybe add to a little bit of bench on that so that we can continue to win and serve more and more projects in those spaces.

items.quote: As the company's strategy, we've continued to maintain our utilization above 80%, which we believe is healthy and for us, a great place to be in order to deliver sustained margin performance.

items.quote: It's not a discount ask. It's not a productivity ask because it's not compared to what they were paying yesterday for the same service, right?

items.quote: We are getting towards a place where we believe we are now well over 35% of our overall revenues coming through AI, which is a combination of AI, PDLC and all the agentic and machine learning work that we do.

items.quote: In 2 to 3 years, in order to really make it meaningful, we would assume that we should be above 25% i.e., 25% to 35% revenue coming from the enterprises so that we are reasonably derisked from the TMT side of things.
